programme.title: The forgotten battle of Nuštar 91. / Zaboravljena bitka Nuštar 91.
programme.desc: In the fall of 1991, Croatia was fighting a battle for survival. At the very beginning of November, the Slavonian village of Nuštar found itself in an almost hopeless situation as the only unconquered stronghold between the city on the Danube and the city on Bosut. And while the ring around Vukovar tightens more and more, and the enemy, occupying village after village, is getting closer to Vinkovci and the column of exiles is getting longer, it is uncertain how long the few and poorly armed defenders will be able to resist the aggressor. In those days, Nuštar lived through his most dramatic moments in history, and this is the story of a three-day forgotten battle, of despair and hope, of miraculous heroism and the victory of the heart over the armor. Nuštar had no choice, defeat would have written a different history. Animation: Mato Granić / U jesen 1991. godine Hrvatska bije bitku za opstanak. Na samom početku mjeseca studenoga slavonsko selo Nuštar našlo se u gotovo bezizlaznoj situaciji kao jedino neosvojeno uporište između grada na Dunavu i grada na Bosutu. I dok se sve više steže obruč oko Vukovara, a neprijatelj, zauzimajući selo za selom, sve se više približava Vinkovcima te je kolona prognanika sve duža, neizvjesno je koliko dugo će malobrojni i slabo naoružani branitelji moći odolijevati agresoru. Nuštar tih dana proživljava svoje najdramatičnije trenutke u povijesti, a ovo je priča o trodnevnoj zaboravljenoj bici, o očaju i nadi, o čudesnom junaštvu i pobjedi srca nad oklopom. Nuštar nije imao izbora, poraz bi pisao drugačiju povijest. Animacija: Mato Granić

programme.title: Dogs on a mission / Psi na zadatku
programme.desc: This documentary series reveals another side of our favorite four-legged friends. Through four exciting episodes, we dive deeper into the world of working dogs, exploring their jobs, but also their leisure time. By following their daily lives, we discover not only how they contribute to our society, but also listen to their thoughts about it through imaginative interpretations. ------ In the first episode, we will dive deeper into the world of Istrian truffles, but literally! Following Bubica, a curly-haired lagotti from Paladin, and her owner Ivana, we will find out the role of sniffing friends in finding this valuable food and what is hidden in the depths of the Istrian forests. Get ready for an exciting journey through the world of gourmet delights and incredible adventures with our four-legged truffle. / Ova dokumentarna serija otkriva nam drugu stranu naših omiljenih četveronožnih prijatelja. Kroz četiri uzbudljive epizode zaranjamo dublje u svijet radnih pasa, istražujući njihove poslove, ali i dokolicu. Prateći njihov svakodnevni život, otkrivamo ne samo kako oni doprinose našem društvu, već i kroz maštovite interpretacije slušamo njihova razmišljanja o tome. ------ U prvoj epizodi zaronit ćemo dublje u svijet istarskih tartufa, ali doslovno! Prateći Bubicu, kovrčavu lagotticu iz Paladina, i njezinu vlasnicu Ivanu, doznat ćemo koja je uloga njuškajućih prijatelja u pronalasku ove vrijedne namirnice i što se to krije u dubinama istarskih šuma. Pripremite se za uzbudljivo putovanje kroz svijet gurmanskih užitaka i nevjerojatnih pustolovina s našom četveronožnom tartufarkom.

programme.title: And she was / I bila je
programme.desc: Byrdie is a prolific screenwriter in her fifties. The problem is that none of the producers want to work with her. Even though she's just completed what is probably the best screenplay of her life, her agent isn't returning her calls, and none of the filmmakers want to read it. So he comes up with a plan to get revenge on them. Looking to revive her career, Byrdie enlists the help of her charming and attractive twentysomething nephew, a former used car salesman, Neil. Just like Cyrano de Bergerac, Byrdie writes screenplays and Neil pitches them to studios as his own. Thanks to Byrdie's giftedness and Neil's youthful charm, the duo achieve great success. Neil soon becomes one of the most sought after Hollywood screenwriters. While visiting the studios, he meets Andrea, the head of acquisitions and the only devotee of Byrdie's work, and falls in love with her. Byrdie and Neil feel guilty about lying to Andrea, but they're in too deep to back out now. Things get even more complicated when Byrdie's family, unaware of their prank, deduces that Byrdie has a drinking problem and organizes an intervention. Despite her fierce opposition, Byrdie is sent to rehab and unable to deliver the script to Neil. Neil tries to write on his own, but soon realizes that writing a screenplay is much more difficult than going to meetings. Does the 50-year-old have a chance to succeed in the ruthless world of Hollywood? And will the truth destroy her nephew's relationship? / Byrdie je plodna scenaristica na pragu pedesete. Problem je što nitko od producenata ne želi raditi s njom. Iako je upravo dovršila vjerojatno najbolji scenarij u svom životu, njezin joj agent ne uzvraća pozive, a nitko ga od filmaša ne želi pročitati. Stoga smisli plan kako da im se osveti. U želji da oživi svoju karijeru, Byrdie potraži pomoć svog šarmantnog i privlačnog dvadeset-i-nešto-godišnjeg nećaka, bivšeg prodavača rabljenih automobila, Neila. Baš poput Cyrana de Bergeraca, Byrdie piše scenarije, a Neil ih studijima nudi kao svoje. Zahvaljujući Byrdienoj darovitosti i Neilovom mladenačkom šarmu, dvojac postiže velik uspjeh. Neil ubrzo postaje jedan od najtraženijih holivudskih scenarista. Obilazeći studije upoznaje Andreu, voditeljicu akvizicija i jedinu poklonicu Byrdienog rada, te se zaljubljuje u nju. Byrdie i Neil imaju grižnju savjesti što lažu Andrei, no preduboko su se uvalili da bi se sad povukli. Stvari se dodatno zakompliciraju kad Byrdiena obitelj, koja ne zna za njihovu podvalu, zaključi da Byrdie ima problema s alkoholom i organizira intervenciju. Unatoč njezinu žestokom protivljenju, Byrdie pošalju na odvikavanje pa ne može Neilu dostaviti scenarij. Neil pokuša sam pisati, no ubrzo shvaća da je pisanje scenarija daleko teže od hodanja po sastancima. Ima li 50-godišnjakinja šanse uspjeti u nemilosrdnom svijetu Hollywooda? I hoće li istina uništiti vezu njezina nećaka?

programme.title: RIGHTS - promet info / HAK - promet info
programme.desc: Current information about road and ferry traffic, with announcements from the Croatian Auto Club. / Aktualne informacije o cestovnom i trajektnom prometu, uz javljanja iz Hrvatskog autokluba.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: A short overview of news from Croatia and the world. / Kratki pregled vijesti iz Hrvatske i svijeta.

programme.title: Regional diary / Regionalni dnevnik
programme.desc: HTV teams from all Croatian counties bring the most interesting current events and stories from all over the country, and there is also a detailed regional weather forecast. / Ekipe HTV-a iz svih hrvatskih županija donose najzanimljivije aktualne događaje i priče iz cijele zemlje, a tu je i detaljna regionalna vremenska prognoza.

programme.title: Call the midwife / Zovite babicu
programme.desc: This time, Jenny is not facing the beginning, but the end of her life. Frank, the brother of the cleaner Peggy of Nonnatus House, has cancer, and the sisters take care of him. Jenny thus gets to know better their difficult past and the relationship that was shaped by the childhood spent in the poorhouse. At the same time, the other residents of the house help Fred in his (somewhat unusual) business idea _ raising Evie the piglet. But the bacon-earning plan changes when Evie is left unborn. With that, the police find Sister Monica Joan wandering around the docks and bring her back to Nonnatus House. After recovering from pneumonia, she returns to her duties _ until she is accused of stealing... / Jenny se ovoga puta ne susreće s početkom, već s krajem života. Frank, brat čistačice Peggy iz Nonnatus Housea, obolio je od raka, a sestre se brinu o njemu. Jenny tako bolje upoznaje njihovu tešku prošlost i odnos koji je oblikovalo djetinjstvo provedeno u ubožnici. Paralelno, ostale stanovnice kuće pomažu Fredu u njegovoj (pomalo nesvakidašnjoj) poslovnoj ideji _ uzgoju prasice Evie. No plan o zaradi od slanine mijenja se kad Evie ostane skotna. Uz to policija pronalazi sestru Monicu Joan kako luta po dokovima i vraća je u Nonnatus House. Nakon oporavka od upale pluća, vraća se svojim obavezama _ sve dok je ne optuže za krađu...

programme.title: Time / Vrijeme
programme.desc: After Diary 1 comes the weather forecast, along with interesting weather and warnings about dangerous weather phenomena, and before Diary 2 a condensed weekly forecast. / Nakon Dnevnika 1 slijedi vremenska prognoza, uz meteozanimljivosti i upozorenja na opasne vremenske pojave, a uoči Dnevnika 2 sažeta tjedna prognoza.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: The most important news from the country and the world, numerous reports, guest appearances by prominent experts and commentators in Dnevnik 2, the most watched news show on HTV. In addition to sports news, see the detailed weather forecast for the following days. / Najvažnije vijesti iz zemlje i svijeta, brojne reportaže, gostovanja istaknutih stručnjaka i komentatora u Dnevniku 2, u najgledanijoj informativnoj emisiji HTV-a. Uz sportske aktualnosti pogledajte i detaljnu vremensku prognozu za sljedeće dane.

programme.title: Heart 7 / Loto 7
programme.desc: Follow the Lot 7 draw live. / Pratite izravno izvlačenje Lota 7.

programme.title: Rabbit embankment / Zečji nasip
programme.desc: In a village threatened by floods, the orderly life of the young athlete Marko is shaken by the return of Slaven, his boyhood's forbidden love. And while the whole village builds rabbit dykes to protect their homes, Marko will try to build a dyke around himself, defending himself from his own emotions. But water always finds a way. / U selu kojem prijete poplave, posložen život mladog sportaša Marka uzdrma povratak Slavena, njegove dječačke zabranjene ljubavi. I dok cijelo selo gradi zečje nasipe kako bi zaštitilo svoje domove, Marko će pokušati izgraditi nasip oko sebe, braneći se od vlastitih emocija. Ali voda uvijek nađe put.

programme.title: Before the court of the public / Pred sudom javnosti
programme.desc: After Talitha and Dhillon are charged with Hannah's murder, the legal teams begin preparing for the trial. Cleo and Brian find evidence that points to Dhillon, but Meera manages to dig up some more juicy details from Talitha's past and turn everything to her advantage. The reporters crucify Talitha. Can Cleo help her get rid of her bad image? / Nakon što Talithu i Dhillona optuže za Hannahino ubojstvo, pravni timovi počinju se pripremati za suđenje. Cleo i Brian pronalaze dokaze koji upućuju na Dhillona, no Meera uspijeva iskopati još neke sočne detalje iz Talithine prošlosti i sve preokrenuti u svoju korist. Novinari razapinju Talithu. Može li joj Cleo pomoći da se riješi svog lošeg imidža?

programme.title: Lewis / Lewis
programme.desc: The first season of the exciting detective series Lewis has four episodes, the main character is Robbie Lewis (Kevin Whately), the partner of the famous inspector Morse, from the multi-award-winning series of the same name that was shown by HTV. The Lewis series continues where the previous series left off _ five years after the death of his partner Morse, and after a two-year absence from Oxford due to a family tragedy, Lewis, now an inspector, returns to his workplace. But already at the airport, Lewis and his new partner, the young James Hathaway (Laurence Fox), are put into a police car and, under rotating lights, they are urgently transported to the crime scene in Oxford, where an American student was shot. New cases lead Lewis and Hathaway into student circles full of unexpected secrets. --- Morse's assistant Inspector Lewis returns to Oxford after several years away. In Oxford, he is greeted by the mysterious murder of a young girl, Regan, who is soon found to have been intimately connected with several members of the powerful Griffon automobile family. When members of that family start to die, Lewis and his assistant Inspector Hathaway will soon have to find out what secret the Griffon family is hiding and why Morse himself once dealt with a minor report related to Daniel Griffon's juvenile crime. / Prva sezona uzbudljive detektivske serije Lewis ima četiri epizode, glavni lik je Robbie Lewis (Kevin Whately), partner glasovitog inspektora Morsea, iz istoimene, mnogostruko nagrađivane serije koju je HTV prikazivao. Serija Lewis nastavlja se ondje gdje je prethodna serija stala _ pet godina poslije smrti svog partnera Morsea, te nakon dvogodišnjeg izbivanja iz Oxforda zbog obiteljske tragedije, Lewis, sada inspektor, vraća se na svoje radno mjesto. No već u zračnoj luci Lewisa i njegova novog partnera, mladog Jamesa Hathawaya (Laurence Fox), ubacuju u policijski automobil i pod rotirajućim svjetlima hitno prevoze na mjesto zločina u Oxfordu gdje je ustrijeljen američki student. Novi slučajevi vode Lewisa i Hathawayja u studentske krugove pune neočekivanih tajni. --- Morseov pomoćnik inspektor Lewis vraća se u Oxford nakon više godina izbivanja. U Oxfordu ga dočeka misteriozno ubojstvo mlade djevojke Regan za koju se ubrzo dozna da je bila intimno povezana s više članova moćne automobilističke obitelji Griffon. Kada počnu stradavati i članovi te obitelji, Lewis i njegov pomoćnik inspektor Hathaway morat će ubrzo otkriti kakvu tajnu skriva obitelj Griffon i zašto se i sam Morse nekad bavio sitnom prijavom vezanom uz maloljetnički zločin Daniela Griffona.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Beverly goes to Florida to clean up her father's apartment, but she gets an unpleasant surprise there. Erica's heroic act at the mall overshadows Barry's medical school admissions results. / Beverly odlazi na Floridu kako bi sredila očev stan, ali ondje je čeka neugodno iznenađenje. Ericin junački čin u trgovačkom centru zasjeni Barryjeve rezultate prijemnoga za studij medicine.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: As Adam's graduation approaches, Beverly ponders whether to remain a supervisor at William Penn Academy; Erica wants to end the long tradition of Sunday dinners at the Schwartz's. / Kako se Adamova matura bliži, Beverly razmišlja hoće li ostati nadzornica u akademiji Williama Penna; Erica želi prekinuti dugu tradiciju nedjeljnih večera kod Schwartzovih.

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: Night music program - videos / Noćni glazbeni program - spotovi
programme.desc: At night, we show new videos, recordings of concerts and festivals, and music shows from the HTV archive. / U noćnim satima prikazujemo nove spotove, snimke koncerata i festivala te glazbene emisije iz arhive HTV-a.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Discovering that they have mold in their apartment, Erica and Geoff have to stay with the Goldbergs for a while. Beverly senses tension in their relationship and takes the opportunity to give them some marriage advice. / Otkrivši da imaju plijesan u stanu, Erica i Geoff moraju neko vrijeme boraviti kod Goldbergovih. Beverly osjeti napetost u njihovu odnosu i iskoristi priliku da im da pokoji bračni savjet.

programme.title: The Goldberg family / Obitelj Goldberg
programme.desc: Adam has finally graduated and everyone is ready for the graduation ceremony; everyone except Beverly, who can't accept that her house will be empty. With Geoff's encouragement, Erica decides to take the stage again and sing backing vocals. / Adam je napokon maturirao i svi su spremni za dodjelu diploma; svi osim Beverly, koja ne može prihvatiti da će joj kuća biti prazna. Uz Geoffovo ohrabrenje, Erica odluči opet stati na pozornicu i pjevati prateći vokal.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because it's only important to them that it's close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house. / Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući.

programme.title: George Clarke - Wonderful ideas / George Clarke - Čudesne zamisli
programme.desc: An actor climbs the property ladder on four wheels _ he transforms a Luton truck into a two-bed luxury flat. We will also see an underground cafe covered with shells. And there's also a train car that functions as a pet-friendly rental space. / Jedan glumac uspinje se na nekretninskoj ljestvici na četiri kotača _ uređuje kamion modela Luton u dvokrevetni luksuzni stančić. Vidjet ćemo i podzemni kafić prekriven školjkama. A tu je i željeznički vagon koji funkcionira kao prostor za najam u kojemu su kućni ljubimci dobrodošli.

programme.title: Patina's Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: In Yaxunah, Pati discovers something specific to Yucatán. She joins the Amazonas softball team, made up of indigenous women, for their morning practice. Over time, they became a highly respected club and overcame stereotypes. / U Yaxunahu Pati otkriva nešto specifično za Yucatán. Pridružuje se softball timu Amazonas, sastavljenom od domorotkinja, na njihovom jutarnjem treningu. S vremenom su postale vrlo cijenjen klub i pobijedile stereotipe.

programme.title: UK: Garden of the Year / UK: Vrt godine
programme.desc: Judges Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde and Lachlan Rae compare contestants from Central England and the Midlands in this episode. They visit a garden in Cambridgeshire where the American owner has spared no effort to shape his vision of English rural perfection. In Nottinghamshire, they find tranquility in a garden arranged around a natural pond, and in Oxfordshire, they explore a garden on a plot in a city garden. The beautifully decorated space reflects the true gardening love and passion. And behind a seemingly ordinary home in the suburbs of Walsall, the jury discovers a garden that is anything but ordinary. / Članovi žirija Zoe Ball, Manoj Malde i Lachlan Rae u ovoj epizodi uspoređuju natjecatelje iz središnje Engleske i Midlandsa. Posjećuju vrt u Cambridgeshireu gdje vlasnik Amerikanac nije štedio truda kako bi oblikovao svoju viziju engleskog ruralnog savršenstva. U Nottinghamshireu pronalaze spokoj u vrtu koji je uređen oko prirodnog jezerca, a u Oxfordshireu razgledavaju vrt na parceli u gradskom vrtu. U krasno uređenom prostoru ogledaju se istinska vrtlarska ljubav i strast. A iza naizgled običnog doma u predgrađu u Walsallu žiri otkriva vrt koji je sve drugo nego običan.

programme.title: Michel Roux: Flavors of the South of France / Michel Roux: Okusi francuskog juga
programme.desc: In this episode, Michel will organize a real feast. A visit to a restaurant on the Mediterranean coast will inspire an appetizer based on smoked fish. Beef cheek stew will serve as the main course, and salted caramel tart with walnuts for dessert. / U ovoj epizodi Michel će organizirati pravu gozbu. Posjet restoranu na mediteranskoj obali nadahnut će predjelo na bazi dimljene ribe. Za glavno poslužit će gulaš od goveđih obraza, a za desert tart od slane karamele s orasima.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America. / Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku.

programme.title: Escape to the interior / Bijeg u unutrašnjost
programme.desc: The buyers in this episode want a new home in either Hampshire or Dorset because it's only important to them that it's close to what they love most, the sea. Denise Nurse will try to make them happy and also meet a family from Hampshire who live like a dream in an idyllic Georgian house. / Kupci u ovoj epizode žele novi dom bilo u Hampshireu ili Dorsetu jer važno im je samo da bude blizu onoga što najviše vole, mora. Denise Nurse će ih pokušati usrećiti, a također će upoznati obitelji iz Hampshirea koja živi kao u snu u idiličnoj georgijanskoj kući.
