programme.title: Edmond i Luce / Edmond i Luce
programme.desc: Winter came a little early and Mima did not finish all her preparations for the winter and snow season. Edmund and Luce do their best to help her. In the process, they discover how nature is preparing for a long cold winter. / Zima je malo uranila i Mima nije završila sve svoje pripreme za doba zime i snijega. Edmund i Luce daju sve od sebe kako bi joj pomogli. Tijekom toga, oni otkrivaju kako se priroda priprema za dugu hladnu zimu.

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: Blitz shows Vrck how to gather the dinosaurs, but the little dinosaur is overexcited and keeps scaring them instead of directing them. When the Dinoranchers discover that some parasaurs are lost in the High Forest, Vrcko can't wait to help and secretly sneaks in on their mission. When the Dinoranchers discover the hidden Vrcko, they tell him not to follow them, but Jon accidentally drops his dino whistle as he leaves, and Vrcko runs back into the forest to get it back. Deep in the misty forest, Vrcko finds Jon and returns his whistle so he can summon the parasaurs. When the moment comes to chase them back home, Jon and Blitz patiently allow Vrck to help them and see that the dinosaur has finally learned how not to scare the dinosaurs. All the Dinoranchers are glad they gave Vrck a second chance, because it turns out he just needed a little more practice. / Blitz pokazuje Vrcku kako okupiti dinosaure, ali mali dinosaur je preuzbuđen i neprestano ih plaši umjesto da ih usmjerava. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju da su se neki parasauri izgubili u Visokoj šumi, Vrcko jedva čeka pomoći i potajno se ušulja na njihov zadatak. Kad Dinorančeri otkriju skrivenog Vrcka, kažu mu da ne ide za njima, no Jon pri odlasku slučajno ispusti svoju dinozviždaljku, a Vrcko potrči natrag u šumu kako bi mu je vratio. Duboko u maglovitoj šumi, Vrcko pronalazi Jona i vraća mu zviždaljku kako bi mogao dozvati parasaure. Kad dođe trenutak da ih potjeraju natrag kući, Jon i Blitz strpljivo dopuste Vrcku da im pomogne i vide da je dinić napokon naučio kako ne uplašiti dinosaure. Svi Dinorančeri raduju se što su Vrcku dali drugu priliku, jer se ispostavilo da mu je trebalo samo malo više vježbe.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: The fearsome team has taken the bus on a jumping trip, and the Moto dogs have to rescue them from the High Winding Mountain. // Chase's cat allergies lead him to the desert, where he is captured by the Scary Squad. Moto dogs embark on an epic rescue! / Strašna ekipa krenula je autobusom na skakanje, a Moto psići ih moraju spasiti s Visoke vijugave gore. // Chaseove mačje alergije odvedu ga u pustinju, gdje ga zarobi Strašna ekipa. Moto psići kreću u epsko spašavanje!

programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: The worst witch / Najgora vještica
programme.desc: A stunning adaptation of Jill Murphy's favorite Mildred Hubble books. Now Mildred is back at Cackle and is a better witch than before. / Zadivljujuća prerada omiljenih knjiga Jill Murphy o Mildred Hubble. Sad se Mildred vratila u Cackle i bolja je vještica nego prije.

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Institute for the Croatian Language: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: I'm telling you a story / Pričam ti priču
programme.desc: The film "About people and stories" from the series "I'm telling you a story" is a very personal "story about a story" by director Mladen Santrić, and the last work of cinematographer Radovan Sredić. Inspired by the speech of the Nobel laureate Ivo Andrić, the author of the film sets out in search of the fate of the story today. Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras and Drago Grgić _ Godra lead us through the literary, filmic, artistic and musical aspects of their "stories". Although they are generations apart, they all have in common that they do not live on stories, but they could not live without them. / Film "O ljudima i pričama" iz ciklusa "Pričam ti priču" vrlo je osobna "priča o priči" redatelja Mladena Santrića, te posljednji rad snimatelja Radovana Sredića. Inspiriran govorom nobelovca Ive Andrića, autor filma kreće u potragu za sudbinom priče danas. Kroz književne, filmske, likovne i glazbene aspekte njihovih "priča" vode nas Snježana Janović Grković, Mladen Kušec, Ivica Šodan, Branka Kandić-Splavski, Zdenko Bašić, Noa Geras i Drago Grgić _ Godra. Iako generacijski udaljeni, svima je zajedničko da ne žive od priča, ali bez njih ne bi mogli živjeti.

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Touch of evil / Dodir zla
programme.desc: A high-ranking official in the Mexican government Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) is enjoying his honeymoon with his American wife Susan (J. Leigh). Their kiss in a small town on the US-Mexico border is interrupted by the explosion of the car in which the town's powerful man was. It is a skillfully planned murder, in which local police chief Hank Quinlan (O. Welles) takes over the investigation. As the crime took place at the border crossing itself, Quinlan is joined in the investigation by Vargas, who deals with exposing drug smugglers. A Mexican law enforcement officer will be targeted by Quinlan, who will not hesitate to cooperate with the gangster Joe Grandi aka Uncle (A. Tamiroff) in order to disable his colleague from Mexico... / Visokopozicionirani službenik u meksičkoj vladi Ramon Miguel Vargas (C. Vargas) uživa u medenom mjesecu sa svojom suprugom Amerikankom Susan (J. Leigh). Njihov poljubac u gradiću na američko-meksičkoj granici prekine eksplozija automobila u kojoj se nalazio gradski moćnik. Riječ je o vješto isplaniranom ubojstvu pri čemu istragu preuzme mjesni šef policije Hank Quinlan (O. Welles). Kako se zločin zbio na samom graničnom prijelazu, Quinlanu se u istrazi pridruži Vargas koji se bavi raskrinkavanjem krijumčara droge. Meksički čuvar zakona naći će se na meti Quinlana koji neće prezati ni od suradnje s gangsterom Joeom Grandijem zvanim Uncle (A. Tamiroff) kako bi onemogućio svog kolegu iz Meksika...

programme.title: From whisperer to spokesperson / Od šaptačice do glasnogovornika
programme.desc: There is no longer a so-called in any theater. shell for whisperers. That shell is a kind of symbol of the term "theatre". But time takes its toll and the whisperers, together with the shells _ disappear. Shells are deposited in warehouses of staged scenery, and whisperers cease to exist as a profession. Moreover, today most theater companies in Croatia do not have an official, paid, full-time whisperer. Although they still, mostly only at rehearsals, help with the creation of the play and do so in the way they know best _ by whispering. But even that is less and less. Many claim that this is the most obvious sign that the theater, and with it the world, has irrevocably changed. Namely, less and less texts are played in which it is important what was said by whom in the first place. There are fewer and fewer texts in verse and rhyme, so words have lost their importance. "Whisperers are dying out. People have less and less time to communicate. Life is becoming faster and more technologically modern day by day, people are more distant. There will come a day when there will be no time for whispering," says one professional whisperer. On the other hand, the fact is that the epochal mood of the 21st century needs noisemakers more than whisperers. It is in this modern tendency that the second layer of this story is hidden. So today, while whisperers are dying out, spokespeople are multiplying unstoppably... / Više ni u jednom kazalištu ne postoji tzv. školjka za šaptače. Ta je školjka svojevrsni simbol pojma "kazalište". No, vrijeme nosi svoje i šaptači, zajedno sa školjkama _ nestaju. Školjke se odlažu u skladišta izigranih scenografija, a šaptači kao zanimanje prestaju postojati. Štoviše, danas većina kazališnih kuća u Hrvatskoj nema službenog, na plaći, stalno zaposlenog šaptača. Mada još uvijek, uglavnom samo na probama, pomažu pri stvaranju predstave i to onako kako najbolje znaju _ šapćući. Ali i to sve rjeđe. Mnogi tvrde da je to najočitiji znak da se kazalište, a s njime i svijet, nepovratno promijenilo. Naime, sve se manje igraju tekstovi u kojima je važno što je tko uopće rekao. Sve je manje tekstova u stihu i rimi, pa su i riječi izgubile na važnosti. "Šaptači izumiru. Ljudi imaju sve manje vremena za komunikaciju. Život iz dana u dan postaje sve ubrzaniji i tehnološki suvremeniji, ljudi udaljeniji. Doći će dan kada neće biti vremena za šaptanje" _ kaže jedna profesionalna šaptačica. S druge strane, činjenica je da epohalni štimung 21. stoljeća više treba bukače nego li šaptače. Upravo u toj novovjekoj tendenciji krije se drugi sloj ove priče. Tako danas, dok šaptači izumiru, nezaustavljivo se množe glasnogovornici...

programme.title: ART / ART
programme.desc: Art _ your address for culture! Every week from Monday to Thursday at 20.10 we bring you the best from the world of art and ideas, stories that shape theater, art, literature, architecture, film, music. / Art _ vaša adresa za kulturu! Svaki tjedan od ponedjeljka do četvrtka u 20.10 donosimo vam najbolje iz svijeta umjetnosti i ideja, priče koje oblikuju kazalište, likovnost, književnost, arhitekturu, film, glazbu.

programme.title: A witness of reality and fantasy / Priča o stvarnosti i fantaziji
programme.desc: In the history of Croatian Radio and Television, some people gave their face to the small screen, so we all remember them. And some, behind the camera, created our cultural heritage as authors. We usually don't know much about them. When a man steps off the stage of his life, his story fades into oblivion. They say that some stories existed only to be forgotten. Thanks to the fragments of memories of colleagues and friends, preserved recordings and fragments of literary creativity, this one, at least for now, is not. More than four hundred works of all television formats and genres signed by director Dražen Piškorić are preserved in the HRT archive. This is the story of the "reality and fantasy" of his life. / U povijesti Hrvatske radiotelevizije neki ljudi su dali svoje lice malom ekranu, pa ih svi pamtimo. A neki su, iza kamere, kao autori stvarali našu kulturnu baštinu. O njima, obično, ne znamo mnogo. Kad čovjek siđe s pozornice svoga života, njegova priča nestaje u zaboravu. Kažu kako su neke priče postojale da bi bile zaboravljene. Zahvaljujući fragmentima sjećanja kolega i prijatelja, sačuvanim snimkama i ulomcima literarnog stvaralaštva, ova, barem zasad, nije. U arhivu HRT-a sačuvano je više od četiri stotine djela svih televizijskih formata i žanrova koje potpisuje redatelj Dražen Piškorić. Ovo je priča o "stvarnosti i fantaziji" njegova života.

programme.title: Legends of Parisian Romanticism / Legende Pariškog romantizma
programme.desc: Paris in 1827. The young generation of artists led by Hugo, Dumas and Delacroix is ​​determined to make a real revolution in the art field. These are the beginnings of romanticism in France. Delacroix creates "The Death of Sardanapalus", a picture that becomes a kind of manifesto of a new artistic movement that wants to break with conventions and create a completely new style of writing, painting and composing. "Hernani", "The Skin of Chagrin", "The Hunchback of Notre Dame" and "Fantastic Symphony" ensure the triumph of the romantic army whose soldiers are ready to risk everything to win the victory and defeat the classics. Their artistic commitment also gives a strong impetus to the new political consciousness. While on the streets of Paris the people demand and fight for the Republic, even the romantics will not stop until freedom reigns. / Pariz 1827. Mladi naraštaj umjetnika predvođen Hugoom, Dumasom i Delacroixom odlučan je u namjeri da na umjetničkom polju napravi pravu revoluciju. To su počeci romantizma u Francuskoj. Delacroix stvara "Sardanapalovu smrt", sliku koja postaje svojevrsni manifest novog umjetničkog pokreta koji želi raskinuti s konvencijama i osmisliti potpuno nov stil pisanja, slikanja i komponiranja. "Hernani", "Chagrinska koža", "Zvonar crkve Notre Dame" i "Fantastična simfonija" osiguravaju trijumf romantičarske vojske čiji su vojnici spremni sve riskirati kako bi odnijeli pobjedu i pobijedili klasike. Njihova umjetnička angažiranost daje snažan poticaj i novoj političkoj svijesti. Dok na pariškim ulicama narod zahtijeva i bori se za Republiku, ni romantičari neće stati sve dok ne zavlada sloboda.

programme.title: Countries, people, adventures / Zemlje, ljudi, pustolovine
programme.desc: Gomera is the second smallest island of the Canary Islands, greener, more natural and wilder than the large islands of this Spanish archipelago in the Atlantic. On it, the trade winds stop in the mountains, providing precious moisture to the thousand-year-old evergreen misty forest. To this day, the island has remained spared from mass tourism because there is no direct air line with the European continent. Thus, Gomera became a secret destination for mountaineers and nature lovers. The Canary Islands are located 100 km off the African coast, and as a Spanish territory they are part of the European Union. It was this small, idyllic island that was the starting point of the legendary research trip of Christopher Columbus, who set out from here in search of India and accidentally discovered America. / Gomera je drugi najmanji otok Kanara, zeleniji, prirodniji i divljiji od velikih otoka ovog španjolskog arhipelaga u Atlantiku. Na njoj se u gorju zaustavljaju pasatni oblaci pružajući dragocjenu vlagu tisućljetnoj zimzelenoj maglovitoj šumi. Otok je do danas ostao pošteđen masovnog turizma jer ne postoji izravna zrakoplovna linija s europskim kontinentom. Tako je Gomera postala tajno odredište planinara i ljubitelja prirode. Kanarski otoci smješteni su 100 km ispred afričke obale, a kao španjolski teritorij dio su Europske unije. Upravo je taj mali, idilični otok bio polazna točka legendarnog istraživačkog putovanja Kristofa Kolumba koji je odavde krenuo u potragu za Indijom i slučajno otkrio Ameriku.

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: The unknown island of St. Klement - Hell Islands / Nepoznati otok Sv. Klement - Pakleni otoci
programme.desc: The film depicts the life of "škojari" Tonči Matijević. He talks about the traditions and way of life of his family on the island since 1482. Tonči believes that one should continue to live naturally, according to the conditions provided by the island _ from fishing, farming and tourism. The island also abounds in forgotten excavations such as Roman baths and remains of Illyrian graves. The love for tradition and that way of life that only well-bred Tonči brings to the younger generation. / Film prikazuje život "škojara" Tončija Matijevića. On govori o tradiciji i načinu života svoje obitelji na otoku još od 1482. godine. Tonči smatra da se i nadalje treba živjeti prirodno, prema uvjetima koje pruža otok _ od ribarenja, obrađivanja zemlje i od turizma. Otok obiluje i zaboravljenim iskopinama kao što su rimske terme i ostaci ilirskih grobova. Ljubav prema tradiciji i tom načinu života koji donosi samo dobrobriti Tonči prenosi i na mlađu generaciju.

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic under the direction of renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal _ bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: Box and / Peti dan
programme.desc: A weekly show in which given topics from science, art and culture, as well as social and political events that directly affect our lives, are considered by intellectuals, with moderation. / Tjedna emisija u kojoj zadane teme iz znanosti, umjetnosti i kulture te društvena i politička zbivanja koja izravno utječu na naš život promišljaju intelektualci, uz moderiranje.

programme.title: Salvation for Venice / Spas za Veneciju
programme.desc: Venice is one of the most famous cities in the world. Her accommodation is a stimulus for her economic progress, but it also exposes her to floods. The first settlers drove wooden stakes into the soft mud of the lagoon and thus achieved sufficient strength for the soil to bear more weight. The whole city rests on this technique. Samples of thousand-year-old stakes show that the sludge slows down the rotting of wood, but increasingly frequent floods are a new threat. Restorers hurriedly remove the salt from the city's monuments, which, when it remains after evaporation, crystallizes and weakens the structure of the walls. After a decade of construction, MOSE, a multi-billion euro flood barrier system, is ready to protect the city. Passages have been built across three narrow bays that connect the lagoon to the open sea. In the control room, we monitor barrier raising operations as a devastating storm approaches the city. Despite the failure of the safety valves, the team manages to solve the problem and raise the door in time. The city is safe, but MOSE can only be used in exceptional circumstances because the barriers prevent the tides, which are necessary to remove pollution and human waste from the city. Engineers are working on plans to balance the two problems, including a groundbreaking project to pump billions of liters of seawater into aquifers deep beneath the city to raise the water level there by 25cm. Venice's relationship with the lagoon is crucial to the city's future and explains its current difficulties. In the 15th century, while the lagoon was getting clogged, large-scale engineering efforts prevented the lagoon from turning into dry land, but because of this, floods became more frequent. New routes to North and South America reduced Venice's trading power. In order to survive, the city was repurposed as an important tourist destination. Today, Venice attracts millions of tourists annually. Large cruisers and cargo ships crowd the canal west of the city, and the waves from these large vessels erode the salt marshes at an alarming rate and increase the risk of flooding, while smaller motorboats damage the canal walls. Events such as Regatta Storica celebrate the town without motorboats. Faced with the possibility of losing their city due to climate change, the Venetians turn to revolutionary engineering: the restoration of the natural environment and the knowledge of the past. Only by applying multiple approaches can they hope to save Venice. / Venecija je jedan od najpoznatijih gradova na svijetu. Njezin smještaj poticajan je za njezin gospodarski napredak, ali je zbog njega istodobno izložena poplavama. Prvi doseljenici zabijali su drvene kolce u meki mulj lagune i tako postigli dovoljnu čvrstoću da tlo podnese veću težinu. Na toj tehnici počiva cijeli grad. Uzorci kolaca starih tisuću godina pokazuju kako mulj usporava truljenje drva, ali sve češće poplave nova su prijetnja. Restauratori žurno uklanjaju sol s gradskih spomenika koja, kad ostane nakon isparavanja, kristalizira i slabi strukturu zidova. Nakon desetljeća izgradnje, MOSE, sustav poplavnih barijera vrijedan više milijardi eura, spreman je za zaštitu grada. Preko tri uske uvale koje povezuju lagunu s otvorenim morem izgrađeni su prolazi. U kontrolnoj sobi pratimo operacije podizanja barijera dok se gradu približava razorna oluja. Unatoč kvaru sigurnosnih ventila, ekipa uspijeva riješiti problem i na vrijeme podići vrata. Grad je siguran, ali MOSE se može primijeniti samo u iznimnim okolnostima jer barijere sprečavaju plimu i oseku, koje su nužne za uklanjanje onečišćenja i ljudskog otpada iz grada. Inženjeri rade na planovima za uravnoteženje ova dva problema, uključujući revolucionarni projekt ispumpavanja milijardi litara morske vode u vodonosnike duboko ispod grada kako bi se razina ondje podignula za 25 cm. Odnos Venecije s lagunom ključan je za budućnost grada i objašnjava njegove trenutne poteškoće. U 15. stoljeću, dok se laguna začepljivala, krupnim inženjerskim pothvatima spriječeno je pretvaranje lagune u suho tlo, ali zato su poplave postale učestalije. Nove rute prema Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi smanjile su trgovačku moć Venecije. Da bi preživio, grad je prenamijenjen u važnu turističku destinaciju. Danas Venecija privlači milijune turista godišnje. Veliki krstaši i teretni brodovi naguravaju se u kanalu zapadno od grada, a valovi s tih velikih plovila uzrokuju eroziju slanih močvara alarmantnom brzinom i povećavaju rizik od poplava, dok manji motorni čamci oštećuju stjenke kanala. Događaji kao što je Regatta Storica slave grad bez motornih čamaca. Pred mogućnošću da zbog klimatskih promjena izgube grad, Venecijanci se okreću revolucionarnom inženjerstvu: obnovi prirodnog okoliša i znanjima iz prošlosti. Samo se primjenom višestrukih pristupa mogu nadati da će spasiti Veneciju.

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: The Shanghai Triad / Šangajska trijada
programme.desc: At the beginning of the thirties of the 20th century, Tang (L. Baotian) is the most powerful criminal in Shanghai, and he created an "empire" by selling opium. His lover Xiao Jingbao _ "Bijou" (L. Gong) _ is once a prostitute and now a singer in the biggest Shanghai night club owned by Tang of course. Fourteen-year-old peasant Shuisheng (W. Xiaoxiao) is brought to Shanghai by his uncle, Tang's cousin and servant. The boy will be Bijou's servant and will obediently fulfill her every wish. She lives in a large, luxurious house given to her by Tang. Tang has two assistants _ his "right hand" Song (S. Chun) and favorite Zheng (F. Biao). Song is Bijou's secret lover, which a stunned Shuisheng discovers in the first days. Fat Yu (L. Jiang) is Tang's main competitor who kills several of his men, among them Shuisheng's uncle... / Početkom tridesetih godina 20. stoljeća Tang (L. Baotian) je najmoćniji šangajski kriminalac, a "carstvo" je stvorio prodajući opijum. Njegova je ljubavnica Xiao Jingbao _ "Bijou" (L. Gong) _ nekoć prostitutka, a sad pjevačica u najvećem šangajskom noćnom klubu čiji je vlasnik dakako Tang. Četrnaestogodišnjeg seljačića Shuishenga (W. Xiaoxiao) dovede u Šangaj njegov stric, Tangov rođak i sluga. Dječak će biti sluga kod Bijou i ispunjavat će poslušno svaku njezinu želju. Ona stanuje u velikoj raskošnoj kući koju joj je poklonio Tang. Tang ima dvojicu pomoćnika _ svoju "desnu ruku" Songa (S. Chun) i miljenika Zhenga (F. Biao). Song je tajni ljubavnik Bijou što zapanjeni Shuisheng otkrije već prvih dana. Debeli Yu (L. Jiang) glavni je Tangov konkurent koji pobije nekoliko njegovih ljudi, među njima i Shuishengovog strica...

programme.title: Free zone / Slobodna zona
programme.desc: Rebecca (Natalie Portman) is a young American who has been living in Jerusalem for several months. She just broke up with the Jew Breitberg, after he confessed to her that he raped a Palestinian woman while he was in the army. Rebecca's father is Jewish, and her mother is non-Jewish, so, despite her Jewish upbringing, she is not considered Jewish according to religious tradition. A tearful Rebecca gets into a taxi driven by Israeli Hanna (Hanna Laslo), whose parents survived the Holocaust. Rebecca agrees to go with Hanna, who is headed to a free trade zone not far from the Jordanian border to collect money owed to her husband, who was wounded in a recent rocket attack. There they meet Laila (Hiam Abbass), a Palestinian woman who is supposed to connect them with Hanna's husband's black market partner, a man they call "The American". The three women embark on a perilous journey to recover Hanna's money and find "The American's" son, Walid, who they believe ran off with the money. / Rebecca (Natalie Portman) je mlada Amerikanka koja već nekoliko mjeseci živi u Jeruzalemu. Upravo je prekinula vezu sa Židovom Breitbergom, nakon što joj je priznao da je silovao Palestinku dok je bio u vojsci. Rebeccin je otac Židov, a majka nežidovka pa se, unatoč židovskom odgoju, ne smatra Židovkom prema vjerskoj tradiciji. Uplakana Rebecca ulijeće u taksi kojim upravlja Izraelka Hanna (Hanna Laslo), čiji su roditelji preživjeli holokaust. Rebecca pristaje poći s Hannom koja se uputila prema slobodnoj trgovačkoj zoni nedaleko od jordanske granice kako bi utjerala novac koji duguju njezinom suprugu, ranjenom u nedavnom raketnom napadu. Ondje se nađu s Lailom (Hiam Abbass), Palestinkom koja ih treba povezati s partnerom Hannina supruga na crnom tržištu, muškarcem kojeg zovu "Amerikanac". Tri žene kreću na opasno putovanje kako bi utjerale Hannin novac i pronašle "Amerikančeva" sina Walida, za kojeg vjeruju da je pobjegao s novcem.

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic under the direction of renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal _ bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: Photography in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Sven Stilinović's photography, from early, large-format black-and-white photographic collages to strong structurally saturated color works, is characterized by unconventionality, anarchism and the idea of ​​the absurd. Stilinović treats photography as an intuitive and intellectual process and uses the method of a permanent experiment whose changes become a complex collage of the unpredictable and never defined nature of art. / Fotografija Svena Stilinovića, od ranih, crno-bijelih fotografskih kolaža velikog formata do snažnih strukturalno zasićenih kolorističkih radova, karakterizira nekonvencionalnost, anarhizam i ideja apsurda. Stilinović tretira fotografiju kao intuitivni i intelektualni proces te se koristi metodom permanentnog eksperimenta čije mijene postaju složeni kolaž nepredvidive i nikad dorečene prirode umjetnosti.

programme.title: Boy / Boy
programme.desc: The story of Boy takes place in 1984 on the rural east coast of New Zealand, and is inspired by the Oscar-nominated short film Two Cars, One Night. Boy is a hilarious and honest story about growing up and heroes. Boy is a dreamer who loves Michael Jackson and lives with his brother Rocky, a bunch of abandoned cousins ​​and his grandmother. Boy has a hero, and that is his father Alamein, about whom the boy fantasizes. He imagines him as a deep-sea diver, a war hero and a close relative of Michael Jackson (he even dances like him). In reality, Alamein is an incompetent moneylender who was imprisoned for robbery. When Alamein returns home after seven years away, Boy is confronted with the man he thought he knew and the realization that he is not the hero he thought he was. / Priča filma Boy odvija se 1984. na ruralnoj istočnoj obali Novog Zelanda, a nadahnuta je kratkim filmom Dva automobila, jedna noć, koji je bio nominiran za Oscara. Boy je urnebesna i iskrena priča o odrastanju i junacima. Boy je sanjar koji voli Michaela Jacksona i živi s bratom Rockyjem, hrpom napuštenih rođaka i bakom. Boy ima junaka, a to je njegov otac Alamein o kojemu dječak mašta. Zamišlja ga kao dubinskog ronioca, ratnog junaka i bliskog rođaka Michaela Jacksona (čak i pleše poput njega). U stvarnosti, Alamein je nesposoban niškoristi koji je bio u zatvoru zbog pljačke. Kad se Alamein vrati kući nakon sedam godina izbivanja, Boy se suočava s čovjekom za kojeg je mislio da ga poznaje i spoznajom da nije junak kakvim ga je zamišljao.

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: The partner country of the festival in 2016 was the Kingdom of Spain, and the opening ceremony went to one of the most respected ensembles specializing in early music _ La Ritirata. Under the artistic direction of the brilliant cellist, also the founder of the ensemble, Josetxu Obregon, La Ritirata becomes an unavoidable musical and cultural delicacy of many festivals and concert halls. At our oldest baroque art festival in Varaždin, members of the ensemble perform arias and instrumental excerpts from two operas based on Miguel de Cervantes, by the Italian baroque composer Antonio Caldara. On the occasion of the 400th anniversary of the death of that great Spanish writer, the musical evening was inspired by his masterpiece, the novel The Fair Knight Don Quixote of Mancha. / Zemlja _ partner festivala 2016. godine bila je Kraljevina Španjolska, a svečanost otvorenja pripala je jednom od najuglednijih ansambala specijaliziranih za ranu glazbu _ La Ritirata. Pod umjetničkim vodstvom briljantnog čelista, ujedno i utemeljitelja ansambla, Josetxua Obregona, La Ritirata postaje nezaobilazna glazbena i kulturna poslastica mnogih festivala i koncertnih dvorana. Na našem najstarijem festivalu barokne umjetnosti u Varaždinu, članovi ansambla izvode arije i instrumentalne ulomke iz dviju opera prema Miguelu de Cervantesu, talijanskog baroknog skladatelja Antonija Caldare. U povodu 400. godišnjice smrti toga velikog španjolskog pisca, glazbena večer nadahnuta je njegovim remek-djelom, romanom Bistri vitez Don Quijote od Manche.

programme.title: Skitations / Skitancije
programme.desc: Young biologist Goran Šafarek travels through the famous Baranja triangle Kopački rit _ Danube _ Drava in search of deer roar. He found himself in this area during a severe drought, which makes his journey even more exciting; where he is walking now, the water was high until recently, so he walks between scattered shells. Along the way, he meets interesting people, nature and river guardians, rare inhabitants of ethnic villages that are beautiful and eerily empty, an enthusiastic potter who makes jewelry from Drava stone, which he calls precious stone because of its value for the ecosystem. With a group of young ecologists, he sails down the Danube to a white sandbar that sometimes disappears, sometimes appears in a new, wonderful form. His mission is to help preserve rivers, without unnecessarily interfering with their flow and the life around them, as he likes to say: "Let the rivers breathe." / Mladi biolog Goran Šafarek putuje glasovitim baranjskim trokutom Kopački rit _ Dunav _ Drava u potrazi za rikom jelena. U ovom području našao se za vrijeme velike suše što njegovo putovanje čini još uzbudljivijim; tamo gdje sada hoda do nedavno je bila visoka voda, pa prolazi između rasutih školjki. Putem susreće zanimljive ljude, čuvare prirode i čuvare rijeka, rijetke stanovnike etnosela koja su prelijepa i sablasno prazna, zanesenog keramičara koji izrađuje nakit iz dravskog kamena koji naziva dragi kamen zbog njegove vrijednosti za ekosustav. S grupom mladih ekologa Dunavom plovi do bijelog pješčanog spruda koji čas nestaje, čas se pojavljuje u nekom uvijek novom divnom obliku. Njegova je misija pomoći očuvanju rijeka, bez nepotrebnog upletanja u njihov tok i život oko njih, kako on to voli reći: "Pustite rijeke da dišu."

programme.title: As they say / Kako se kaže
programme.desc: The Department of Education and Science of HTV, in cooperation with the Institute for the Croatian Language, recorded about thirty videos in which, in addition to language advice, other interesting things from the Croatian language, such as the language of the young and foreign words in the Croatian language, are covered. We are also talking about the Kajkavian, Štokavian and Čakavian dialects and unusual place names, but also about common and unusual personal names and surnames. The leader of the conversation is Croatian language teacher Katarina Marjanović, who gives language advice to numerous followers on Instagram. Her interlocutors are experts from the Croatian Language Institute: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod and Goranka Blagus Bartolec. / Odjel Obrazovanje i znanost HTV-a u suradnji s Institutom za hrvatski jezik snimio je tridesetak videa u kojima se uz jezične savjete obrađuju i druge zanimljivosti iz hrvatskog jezika poput jezika mladih te stranih riječi u hrvatskom jeziku. Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. Voditeljica razgovora je profesorica hrvatskog jezika Katarina Marjanović koja na Instagramu brojnim pratiteljima daje jezične savjete. Njezini sugovornici su stručnjaci s Instituta za hrvatski jezik: Maja Matijević, Kristian Lewis, Domagoj Vidović, Ivana Kurtović Budja, Perina Vukša Nahod i Goranka Blagus Bartolec.

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Sound collector / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sixty short stories about sound, heard through the ears of a small but very active creature called the "Sound Collector", who has a passion for sound and all concepts related to sound, despite the fact that he is very hard of hearing. This little creature spends his days discovering and learning the new sounds he finds on his adventures: these are mostly the sounds of the sea, sounds made by creatures in the sea, sounds made by insects, including the snoring of his best friend and pet Myrtle. / Šezdeset kratkih pričica o zvuku, koje se čuju kroz uši malog, ali vrlo aktivnog bića zvanog "Sakupljač zvukova", koji ima strast za zvuk i sve pojmove vezane uz zvuk, unatoč činjenici da on vrlo slabo čuje. To malo biće provodi svoje dane otkrivajući i učeći nove zvukove koje pronalazi na svojim pustolovinama: to su najčešće zvukovi mora, zvuklovi koje proizvode bića u moru, zvukovi koje proizvode kukci, uključujući i hrkanje njegove najbolje prijateljice i kućnog ljubimca Mirte.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: When Francois accidentally breaks the diving bell, the Dogs on Patrol must rescue him, Dogfish, and a fleet of whales. // When Wingnut's scrap pile and Oscar disappear at the same time, Chase and the team set out to solve the mystery. / Kada Francois slučajno razbije ronilačko zvono, Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti njega, Psićribu i plovu kitova. // Kada Wingnutova hrpa otpada i Oscar nestanu u isto vrijeme, Chase i ekipa kreću u rješavanje misterije.

programme.title: Time for Timmy / Vrijeme je za Timmyja
programme.desc: Timmy is a little lamb eager for new knowledge. He has just turned three years old, and since he is the only lamb in the flock, he is used to having everything his way. But now he is going to kindergarten with other cubs and will have to learn to behave in the company of his peers. Each episode shows one day in kindergarten. The daily routine is disturbed only by the antics of the little ones. Through various accidents and mishaps, Timmy and his friends learn about life and friendship. / Timmy je malo janje željno novih znanja. Upravo je navršio tri godine, a budući da je jedino janje u stadu, navikao je da sve bude po njegovom. No sad kreće u vrtić s drugim mladuncima i morat će se naučiti ponašati u društvu svojih vršnjaka. U svakoj se epizodi prikazuje jedan dan u vrtiću. Svakodnevnu rutinu remete jedino ludorije mališana. Kroz razne zgode i nezgode, Timmy i njegovi prijatelji uče o životu i prijateljstvu.

programme.title: Kreki / Krceki
programme.desc: Krcek are a small family: squirrel, acorn, coconut and peanut. They live together in Krcograd and love adventures. Because of their curiosity, they get into various troubles, and in order to solve the problem they always invent some kind of machine. The machine doesn't always work the way they imagined and many funny and unforeseen situations arise. We wish you great fun with Krcek! Songs and a computer game also await you! / Krceki su mala obitelj: vjeverica, žir, kokos i kikiriki. Žive zajedno u Krcogradu i vole avanture. Zbog svoje znatiželje upadaju u razne nevolje, a kako bi riješili problem izmisle uvijek neki stroj. Stroj ne radi uvijek onako kako su zamislili i nastanu mnoge šaljive i nepredviđene situacije. Želimo vam odličnu zabavu s Krcekima! Također vas očekuju i pjesmice i računalna igra!

programme.title: Krceki - a song / Krceki - pjesmica
programme.desc: Along with the animated series Krceki, we also have seven songs: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljko and Hrabrica. Each song sings about the characteristics of a character from the Krceki series. Music, lyrics, performance: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Series authors: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Editor: Sanja Nakić / Uz animiranu seriju Krceki stiže nam i sedam pjesmica: Hvalisavac, Plačko, Pametnica, Dobrica, Ljutko, Sramežljivko i Hrabrica. Svaka pjesmica pjeva o osobinama jednog lika iz serijala Krceki. Glazba, stihovi, izvedba: David Vurdelja _ Baby Dooks Autori serije: Denis Alenti, Vjekoslav Živković, Marija Ivšić Urednica: Sanja Nakić

programme.title: Lu and the merry band / Lu i vesela družina
programme.desc: Lu is disappointed when her xylophone playing doesn't get the reaction she'd hoped for. / Lu je razočarana kad njeno sviranje ksilofona ne postigne reakciju kakvoj se nadala.

programme.title: Hi Day / Hej Dagi
programme.desc: Meet Dagi, a big and adorable dog who leads the preschool club and encourages children to have fun, be full of energy and _ most of all _ to do anything! Each episode of this colorful and sometimes surreal animated series begins with Dagi welcoming the Squirrels, a group of curious little ones left at the club by their parents. Then there is laughter and learning as the Squirrels discover something new about the world around them, and Dagi patiently watches over them. / Upoznajte Dagija, velikog i dražesnog psa koji vodi klub predškolaca i potiče djecu da se zabave, budu puna energije i _ više od svega _ da svašta rade! Svaka epizoda ove šarene i katkad nadrealne animirane serije počinje tako da Dagi dočeka Vjeverice, skupinu malenih znatiželjnika koje u klubu ostave njihovi roditelji. Zatim slijedi smijeh i učenje dok Vjeverice otkrivaju nešto novo o svijetu koji ih okružuje, a Dagi strpljivo pazi na njih.

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Bluey / Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is a charming and tireless little six-year-old Australian Cattle dog who lives with her mom, dad and younger sister Bingo. Bluey loves to play and draws his whole family and whole neighborhood into his world of fun and play. / Bluey je dražesna i neumorna mala šestogodišnja kujica australskog govedara koja živi sa svojom mamom, tatom i mlađom sestrom Bingo. Three fun songs await you in the series! programme.title: Oggy Oggy / Oggy Oggy
programme.desc: Oggy Oggy is a computer-animated series for preschoolers by Jean Cayrol and Cedric Guarneri. The series follows the kitten Oggy who goes on an adventure with his friends Mallow and Sporty in a world where everything is made of children's toys. / Oggy Oggy je kompjuterski animirana serija za predškolsku dob autora Jeana Cayrola i Cedrica Guarnerija, Serija prati mačića Oggyja koji kreće u avanturu s prijateljima Mallow i Sporty u svijet gdje je sve napravljeno od dječjih igračaka.

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Counter cubes / Kockice brojalice
programme.desc: The "Counter's Cubes" series follows the adventures of cute characters in the form of wooden blocks. The number of blocks determines what number they carry. The series helps young children learn to count and solve simple math problems more easily. / Serija "Kockice brojalice" prati avanture simpatičnih likova u obliku drvenih blokova. Broj blokova određuje koji broj nose. Serija pomaže maloj djeci da lakše nauče brojati i rješavati jednostavne matematičke zadatke.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, while using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. / Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123.

programme.title: The best day / Najbolji dan
programme.desc: Paula is a tiny five-year-old, timid and shy. She is single, she doesn't have a pet, but she has a favorite doll, Danica. Paula imagines that she and Danica are princesses, that her room is a castle and her bed is a carriage. The parents want to take their princess to the dentist for the first time. It's a great challenge. Paula is very afraid of the white coat. DigiDigi is urgently needed. / Paula je sićušna petogodišnjakinja, plaha i sramežljiva. Jedinica je, nema kućnog ljubimca, ali ima najdražu lutku Danicu. Paula zamišlja da su Danica i ona princeze, da je njezina soba dvorac, a krevet kočija. Roditelji svoju princezu žele prvi put odvesti zubaru. Strašan je to izazov. Paula se jako boji bijele kute. Hitno treba DigiDigija.

programme.title: A love monster / Ljubavno čudovište
programme.desc: The Little Bunny and the Love Monster come to the conclusion that a good idea is easier to come up with in two. / Malena Zečica i Ljubavno Čudovište dolaze do zaključka je dobru ideju lakše osmisliti u dvoje.

programme.title: Bitz i Bob / Bitz i Bob
programme.desc: Bitz, Bob and Pearl are looking for treasure in a big hot desert. / Bitz, Bob i Bisera u potrazi su za blagom u velikoj vrućoj pustinji.

programme.title: It's at the hotel / Ho ho ho hotel
programme.desc: HO HO HO HOTEL This fall, we invite you to a hotel like you've never seen before! What kind of guests will be welcomed by the best and funniest hosts of Hotel Ruža i Franc and what funny, silly and impossible wishes and problems will be faced by their guests - you will see in 20 episodes of the new humorous and educational series for children! Ruža and Franc can solve any problem, but in their own special and funny way. Dramatic-educational series of 20 ten-minute episodes produced by the Program for Children and Young People takes place in a hotel with the most unusual, best and sweetest hosts Ruža and Franco and their guests with even more unusual crazy wishes and problems! Through the funny and silly incidents of a clumsy magician, a silly scientist, an opera diva who lost her voice and many others, we will learn what is warm and what is cold, what is quiet and what is loud, fast or slow, big or small, high or low, near or far, heavy or light, visible or invisible! In the main series / HO HO HO HOTEL Ove vas jeseni pozivamo u hotel kakav još nikada niste vidjeli! Kakve će sve goste dočekati najbolji i i najzabavniji domaćini Hotela Ruža i Franc i koje će smiješne, šašave i nemoguće želje i probleme imati njihovi gosti- vidjet ćete u 20 epizoda nove humoristično- edukativne serije za djecu ! Ruža i Franc mogu riješiti svaki problem, ali , na a svoj posebni i smiješni način. Igrano- edukativna serija od 20 desetominutnih epizoda u produkciji Programa za djecu i mlade događa se u hotelu s najneobičnijim, najboljim i najsješnijim domaćinima Ružom i Francom te njihovim gostima s još neobičnijim luckastim željama i problemima! Kroz smiješne i šašave zgode nespretnog mađioničara, šašavog znanstvenika, operne dive koja je ostala bez glasa i mnogih drugih, naučit ćemo što je toplo, a što hladno, što tiho, a što glasno, brzo ili sporo, veliko il malo, visoko i nisko, blizu ili daleko, teško ili lagano, vidljivo ili nevidljivo! U seriji glavne

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song I'll do it all by myself, you'll meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and do on their own _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: How Elmo got a puppy / Kako je Elmo dobio psića
programme.desc: In this hilarious TV special that teaches us how to love and care for our furry friends, Elmo and Grover help a cute stray dog ​​find a new, permanent home. One day, on Sesame Street, just as Elmo is about to spend the day playing with his friend, Grover, they hear Oskar complaining about a puppy living in a box near his trash can. Elmo and Grover befriend the puppy and soon help him find the right home, where he will stay forever. Yes, it's a great episode. As Sesame Street always teaches us something, this animated special shows us how to take care of our pets. But maybe he could introduce the children more to the responsibilities they have towards a pet (he shows us only the basic, but not the more complex obligations such as training and going to the vet, although that could be the topic of the next special or episode). But the songs are really great (Keksomlat's song about dog treats is a standout), and the story is great, as are the actors who voice the characters. / U ovom veselom TV-specijalu, koji nas uči kako da volimo i brinemo se o našim čupavim prijateljima, Elmo i Grover pomažu slatkome psiću lutalici da pronađe novi, stalni dom. Jednoga dana, u ulici Sezama, baš kada se Elmo sprema provesti dan u igri sa svojim prijateljem, Groverom, začuju Oskara kako se žali na psića koji živi u kutiji blizu njegove kante za smeće. Elmo i Grover sprijatelje se s psićem i ubrzo mu pomognu pronaći pravi dom, u kojemu će zauvijek ostati. Da, riječ je o sjajnoj epizodi. Kako nas Ulica Sezama uvijek o nečemu uči, ovaj nam animirani specijal pokazuje kako da se brinemo o svojim ljubimcima. No, možda bi djecu mogao i više upoznati s odgovornostima koje imaju prema kućnome ljubimcu (pokazuje nam samo osnovne, ali ne i složenije obveze kao što su dresura i odlazak veterinaru, premda bi to mogla biti tema idućega specijala ili epizode). No, pjesme su doista sjajne (izdvaja se Keksomlatova pjesma o psećim poslasticama), a priča je odlična, kao i glumci koji likovima daju glasove.

programme.title: Dinoranch / Dinoranč
programme.desc: The dinoranchers are about to take nutritious watermelons to the herds of wild dinosaurs, but suddenly a tiny wild microraptor appears and manages to scare even Biscuit! Bo and Jane explain that the microraptors are the only dinosaurs the T. rex are afraid of, and that they snack on anything they find in search of food. Jon and Blitz volunteer to catch the microraptor before it eats their entire supply of watermelons, but the little mischievous is so cunning that he outsmarts them every time. It's only when a microraptor scares Biscuit and steals a dino rattle full of watermelons that Blitz finally admits that he needs help catching the tiny raptor. He and the Dinoranchers set off in pursuit of the frightened Rumble-toting Biscuit, and together they manage to catch the microraptor and deliver their watermelon harvest to the wild dinosaurs who need it most. / Dinorančeri se spremaju odnijeti hranjive apatolubenice stadima divljih dinosaura, no iznenada se pojavi sićušni divlji mikroraptor koji uspije prestrašiti čak i Biskvita! Bo i Jane objašnjavaju da su mikroraptori jedini dinosauri kojih se T. rexovi boje te da grickaju sve što pronađu u potrazi za hranom. Jon i Blitz dobrovoljno se javljaju da uhvate mikroraptora prije nego što im izgrize cijelu zalihu apatolubenica, ali taj je mali nestaško toliko lukav da ih svaki put nadmudri. Tek kad mikroraptor prestraši Biskvita i ukrade dinotutnjalicu punu apatolubenica, Blitz napokon priznaje da mu treba pomoć pri hvatanju tog sićušnog raptora. On i Dinorančeri kreću u potjeru za preplašenim Biskvitom koji vuče tutnjalicu, i udruženim snagama uspijevaju uhvatiti mikroraptora te isporučiti svoju berbu lubenica divljim dinosaurima kojima je najpotrebnija.

programme.title: Shasavi Hotel / Šašavi hotel
programme.desc: Silly Hotel is a British-American-Canadian series made for CBeebies (the BBC's pre-school programme). After the adventures of Sesame Street, Elmo and Keksomlat move to England to help Elmo's aunt and uncle run a "half-star" hotel, whose staff are especially good at solving problems. The hotel is run by members of the Šašava-Frka family with the help of Elmo and Keksomlat, who left Sesame Street to help solve the problems faced by the guests of the Šašava Hotel. / Šašavi Hotel je britansko-američko-kanadska serija snimljena za CBeebies (BBC-jev program za predškolsku dob). Nakon dogodovština u Ulici Sezam, Elmo i Keksomlat sele se u Englesku pomoći Elmovoj teti i tetku voditi hotel "s pola zvjezdice", čije osoblje posebno dobro zna rješavati probleme. Hotel vode članovi obitelji Šašava-Frka uz pomoć Elma i Keksomlata, koji su napustili Ulicu Sezam da bi pomogli rješavati probleme s kojima se suočavaju gosti Šašavog hotela.

programme.title: Superteta / Superteta
programme.desc: We know you know all sorts of super heroes! And we know that all of them are great! But we're sure you still haven't met SuperTeta _ a truly special superheroine who helps only and only children! Especially for kindergarteners! / Znamo da poznajete najrazličitije super junake! I znamo da su svi od reda super! Ali smo sigurni da još uvijek niste upoznali SuperTetu _ uistinu posebnu superjunakinju koja pomaže samo i jedino djeci! Osobito vrtićarcima!

programme.title: A colorful pot / Šareni lonac
programme.desc: We are cooking again! Chef Mario Mihelj and his little helpers are cooking and having a good time! In each episode they cook or make one dish. Cook with us too! / Opet kuhamo! Chef Mario Mihelj i njegovi mali pomoćnici kuhaju i pritom se dobro zabavljaju! U svakoj epizodi skuhaju ili naprave po jedno jelo. Kuhaj i ti s nama!

programme.title: Daniel the tiger's neighborhood / Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela
programme.desc: "Daniel the Tiger's Neighborhood" is an animated series for preschoolers ages two to four based on the groundbreaking PBS series "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood." / "Susjedstvo tigrića Daniela" animirana je serija za djecu predškolske dobi od dvije do četiri godine koja se temelji na revolucionarnoj PBS-ovoj seriji "Susjedstvo gospodina Rogersa".

programme.title: Pancake song / Pjesmica Palačinke
programme.desc: Sing and dance to the new song Pancakes. A cheerful family of dogs and a silly cook enjoy preparing sweet and savory pancakes. And they have a great time. Music and lyrics: Srđan Gulić Gul Singers: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animation, direction, screenplay: Vjekoslav Živković / Zapjevajte i zaplešite uz novu pjesmicu Palačinke. Vesela obitelj psića i jedan šašavi kuhar uživaju u pripremi slatkih i slanih palačinki. I odlično se zabavljaju. Glazba i stihovi: Srđan Gulić Gul Pjevaju: Monika Jager, Bernard Jager, Srđan Gulić Animacija, režija, scenarij: Vjekoslav Živković

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!
