programme.title: I love zoo animals / Volim životinje ZOO
programme.desc: In the series I LOVE ZOO ANIMALS, we get to know the animals in the zoo. Volunteer Marko learns about the animal world by helping in the zoo. Every day is a new challenge for him, because he is given a special task that he cannot complete if he does not learn something about the daily activities in the zoo _ feeding, cleaning and arranging the enclosures, playing, training or treating the animals. In the second episode, Marko was given the task of making toys for Egyptian letips and capuchin monkeys. But before that, they will need to find out how animals play and how to enrich their living space so that they don't get bored. / U serijalu VOLIM ŽIVOTINJE ZOO upoznajemo životinje u zoološkom vrtu. Volonter Marko uči o životinjskom svijetu pomažući u zoološkom vrtu. Svaki dan za njega je novi izazov, jer dobiva poseban zadatak koji ne može izvršiti ako ne nauči ponešto o svakodnevnim aktivnostima u zoološkom vrtu _ prehrani, čišćenju i uređenju nastambi, igranju, treniranju ili liječenju životinja. U drugoj epizodi Marko je dobio zadatak napraviti igračke za egipatskog letipsa i majmune kapucine. Ali prije toga trebat će doznati kako se životinje igraju i kako obogatiti njihov životni prostor da im ne bude dosadno.

programme.title: The song Red / Pjesmica Crvena
programme.desc: Red We will go on a winter walk and get to know the magic of the color red. / Crvena Poći ćemo u jednu zimsku šetnju i upoznati čaroliju crvene boje.

programme.title: Pepa Piglet / Pepa Praščić
programme.desc: "Peppa Pig" is a British animated TV series intended for preschool children. This long-running children's series follows the adventures of Peppa and her friends, her brother Georg, their parents and other animal families living in their town. / "Peppa Praščić" je britanska animirana TV serija namijenjena djeci predškolskog uzrasta. Ova dugovječna serija za djecu prati zgode i nezgode Peppe i njezinih prijatelja, njezinog brata Georga, njihovih roditelja i drugih životinjskih obitelji koje žive u njihovom gradu.

programme.title: Simon / Simon
programme.desc: Simon is an adorable little rabbit bursting with childhood vitality. It is the age when little bunnies (as well as little children) grow into people and experience challenges in their relationship with their parents, start school, learn about the world in general, face authority figures and, of course, learn their own language. Children can take Simon as an example of standing up for themselves, they can learn from him and from his dislikes, from situations in which Simon should give in to his insistence and pampering, while always remaining polite and witty. Simon is a French animated television series based on the books by Stephanie Blake published by the French publisher LEcole des loisirs. The television series was directed by Julien Cayot and produced by GO-N Productions. The series premiered in France on December 17, 2016 on the France 5 channel, and then spread around the world. / Simon je preslatki mali zec koji pršti vitalnošću djetinjstva. U dobu je kad maleni zečići (kao i malena djeca) stasaju u osobe i doživljavaju izazove u odnosu s roditeljima, kreću u školu, uče općenito o svijetu, suočavaju se s autoritetima i, naravno, uče svoj jezik. Djeca mogu uzeti Simona za primjer zauzimanja za sebe, mogu učiti od njega i iz njegovih nepodopština, iz situacija u kojima Simon treba popustiti u svom insistiranju i razmaženosti, a pritom uvijek ostati pristojan i duhovit. Simon je francuska animirana televizijska serija utemeljena na knjigama Stephanie Blake u izdanju francuskog izdavača LEcole des loisirs. Televizijsku seriju režirao je Julien Cayot, a producirala ju je GO-N Productions. Serija je u Francuskoj imala premijeru 17. prosinca 2016. na kanalu France 5, a potom se proširila diljem svijeta.

programme.title: 123 Numerals / 123 Brojčići
programme.desc: Best friends Paula, Tin and Boris are a team that reacts quickly and rushes to help anyone who needs it, while using numbers, counting, shapes and sequences. This unique series brings preschoolers fast-paced and funny adventures where they can learn and laugh while also exploring topics crucial to social and emotional development such as the importance of sharing, resilience, teamwork and friendship. Lights flash, sirens play, their playroom transforms and they become... Numbers 123. / Najbolji prijatelji Paula, Tin i Boris tim su koji brzo reagira i juri u pomoć svakome kome je ona potrebna, a pritom se koriste brojevima, prebrojavanjem, oblicima i nizovima. Ova jedinstvena serija predškolcima donosi brze i duhovite pustolovine uz koje mogu učiti i smijati se te također istraživati teme ključne za društveni i emocionalni razvoj poput važnosti dijeljenja, otpornosti, timskog rada i prijateljstva. Svjetla blješte, sviraju sirene, njihova igraonica se preobražava i oni postaju... Brojčići 123.

programme.title: Pablo / Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo has two cones that he taps on things, which are actually explorers. They take the whole Animal Book gang on a journey to discover sounds and textures, and Ljama creates an entire auditory map of the journey. / Pablo ima dva češera kojima lupka po stvarima, a koji su zapravo istraživači. Oni cijelu družinu iz Knjige životinja povedu na putovanje u otkrivanje zvukova i tekstura, a Ljama izradi cijeli slušni zemljovid putovanja.

programme.title: Little ones / Mališani
programme.desc: In the twenty two-minute episodes of the series, you will be treated to unprecedented events and adventures: how to wash your puppy's paws, how to feed him, how to put the laundry to dry and beat the hooks, take the dishes out of the washing machine, prepare orange juice, sweep the house, plant plants in the garden or pack for a trip alone. Spend the morning in the company of two-year-olds! / U dvadeset dvominutnih epizoda serije čekaju vas do sada neviđene zgode i postolovine: kako oprati šape svome psiću, kako ga nahraniti, kako staviti rublje na sušenje i pobijediti kvačice, izvaditi suđe iz perilice, pripremiti sok od naranče, pomesti kuću, posaditi biljke u vrtu ili se sam samcat spakirati za izlet. Provedite jutro u društvu dvogodišnjaka!

programme.title: Grizzly bear and small attacks / Medo Grizli i male napasti
programme.desc: "Medo Grizzly and Small Attacks" is a French animated series created by Josselin Charier and produced by Studio Harry for France Televisions and Boomerang France. The series follows the adventures of the Grizzly bear and the little lemmings, who live in a forest ranger's log cabin while he is away. / "Medo Grizli i male napasti" francuska je animirana serija koju je osmislio Josselin Charier, a producirao Studio Hari za France Televisions i Boomerang France. Serija prati dogodovštine medvjeda Grizlija i malih napasti _ leminga, koji žive u brvnari šumskog rendžera dok je on odsutan.

programme.title: Dogs on patrol / Psići u ophodnji
programme.desc: When Francois accidentally breaks the diving bell, the Dogs on Patrol must rescue him, Dogfish, and a fleet of whales. // When Wingnut's scrap pile and Oscar disappear at the same time, Chase and the team set out to solve the mystery. / Kada Francois slučajno razbije ronilačko zvono, Psići u ophodnji moraju spasiti njega, Psićribu i plovu kitova. // Kada Wingnutova hrpa otpada i Oscar nestanu u isto vrijeme, Chase i ekipa kreću u rješavanje misterije.

programme.title: The song I'll do everything myself / Pjesmica Sve ću sam/a
programme.desc: In the witty song "I'll do it all by myself" you will meet a girl and a boy who proudly sing about what they love, can and know how to do by themselves _ without the help of adults. And they are great at that. They know how to skillfully put on shoes, peel a banana, brush their teeth, go down a slide and much more. They are curious, love to learn and want to send an important message _ that they can do it themselves. And besides, they have a great time! / U duhovitoj pjesmici Sve ću sam/a upoznat ćete djevojčicu i dječaka koji ponosno pjevaju o onome što vole, mogu i znaju napraviti sami _ bez pomoći odraslih. I u tome su odlični. Znaju spretno obuti cipelice, oguliti bananu, oprati zubiće, spustiti se niz tobogan i još mnogo toga. Znatiželjni su, vole učiti i žele poslati važnu poruku _ da mogu sami. I uz to se odlično zabavljaju!

programme.title: Juhuhu / Juhuhu
programme.desc: In Juhuhu, we explore and discover the world around us together, learn about ourselves and others. We learn through play, songs and stories. All this with a lot of laughter, because learning is the most fun thing in the world. Juhuhu every morning, every day from 6:30 a.m. to 1 p.m. / U Juhuhuu zajedno istražujemo i otkrivamo svijet oko nas, učimo o sebi i drugima. Učimo u igri, u pjesmama i pričama. Sve to s puno smijeha, jer učenje je najzabavnija stvar na svijetu. Juhuhu svako jutro, svaki dan od 6.30 do 13 sati.

programme.title: Skitations / Skitancije
programme.desc: Young biologist Goran Šafarek travels through the famous Baranja triangle Kopački rit _ Danube _ Drava in search of deer roar. He found himself in this area during a severe drought, which makes his journey even more exciting; where he is walking now, the water was high until recently, so he walks between scattered shells. Along the way, he meets interesting people, nature and river guardians, rare inhabitants of ethnic villages that are beautiful and eerily empty, an enthusiastic potter who makes jewelry from Drava stone, which he calls precious stone because of its value for the ecosystem. With a group of young ecologists, he sails down the Danube to a white sandbar that sometimes disappears, sometimes appears in a new, wonderful form. His mission is to help preserve rivers, without unnecessarily interfering with their flow and the life around them, as he likes to say: "Let the rivers breathe." / Mladi biolog Goran Šafarek putuje glasovitim baranjskim trokutom Kopački rit _ Dunav _ Drava u potrazi za rikom jelena. U ovom području našao se za vrijeme velike suše što njegovo putovanje čini još uzbudljivijim; tamo gdje sada hoda do nedavno je bila visoka voda, pa prolazi između rasutih školjki. Putem susreće zanimljive ljude, čuvare prirode i čuvare rijeka, rijetke stanovnike etnosela koja su prelijepa i sablasno prazna, zanesenog keramičara koji izrađuje nakit iz dravskog kamena koji naziva dragi kamen zbog njegove vrijednosti za ekosustav. S grupom mladih ekologa Dunavom plovi do bijelog pješčanog spruda koji čas nestaje, čas se pojavljuje u nekom uvijek novom divnom obliku. Njegova je misija pomoći očuvanju rijeka, bez nepotrebnog upletanja u njihov tok i život oko njih, kako on to voli reći: "Pustite rijeke da dišu."

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Salvation for Venice / Spas za Veneciju
programme.desc: Venice is one of the most famous cities in the world. Her accommodation is a stimulus for her economic progress, but it also exposes her to floods. The first settlers drove wooden stakes into the soft mud of the lagoon and thus achieved sufficient strength for the soil to bear more weight. The whole city rests on this technique. Samples of thousand-year-old stakes show that the sludge slows down the rotting of wood, but increasingly frequent floods are a new threat. Restorers hurriedly remove the salt from the city's monuments, which, when it remains after evaporation, crystallizes and weakens the structure of the walls. After a decade of construction, MOSE, a multi-billion euro flood barrier system, is ready to protect the city. Passages have been built across three narrow bays that connect the lagoon to the open sea. In the control room, we monitor barrier raising operations as a devastating storm approaches the city. Despite the failure of the safety valves, the team manages to solve the problem and raise the door in time. The city is safe, but MOSE can only be used in exceptional circumstances because the barriers prevent the tides, which are necessary to remove pollution and human waste from the city. Engineers are working on plans to balance the two problems, including a groundbreaking project to pump billions of liters of seawater into aquifers deep beneath the city to raise the water level there by 25cm. Venice's relationship with the lagoon is crucial to the city's future and explains its current difficulties. In the 15th century, while the lagoon was getting clogged, large-scale engineering efforts prevented the lagoon from turning into dry land, but because of this, floods became more frequent. New routes to North and South America reduced Venice's trading power. In order to survive, the city was repurposed as an important tourist destination. Today, Venice attracts millions of tourists annually. Large cruisers and cargo ships crowd the canal west of the city, and the waves from these large vessels erode the salt marshes at an alarming rate and increase the risk of flooding, while smaller motorboats damage the canal walls. Events such as Regatta Storica celebrate the town without motorboats. Faced with the possibility of losing their city due to climate change, the Venetians turn to revolutionary engineering: the restoration of the natural environment and the knowledge of the past. Only by applying multiple approaches can they hope to save Venice. / Venecija je jedan od najpoznatijih gradova na svijetu. Njezin smještaj poticajan je za njezin gospodarski napredak, ali je zbog njega istodobno izložena poplavama. Prvi doseljenici zabijali su drvene kolce u meki mulj lagune i tako postigli dovoljnu čvrstoću da tlo podnese veću težinu. Na toj tehnici počiva cijeli grad. Uzorci kolaca starih tisuću godina pokazuju kako mulj usporava truljenje drva, ali sve češće poplave nova su prijetnja. Restauratori žurno uklanjaju sol s gradskih spomenika koja, kad ostane nakon isparavanja, kristalizira i slabi strukturu zidova. Nakon desetljeća izgradnje, MOSE, sustav poplavnih barijera vrijedan više milijardi eura, spreman je za zaštitu grada. Preko tri uske uvale koje povezuju lagunu s otvorenim morem izgrađeni su prolazi. U kontrolnoj sobi pratimo operacije podizanja barijera dok se gradu približava razorna oluja. Unatoč kvaru sigurnosnih ventila, ekipa uspijeva riješiti problem i na vrijeme podići vrata. Grad je siguran, ali MOSE se može primijeniti samo u iznimnim okolnostima jer barijere sprečavaju plimu i oseku, koje su nužne za uklanjanje onečišćenja i ljudskog otpada iz grada. Inženjeri rade na planovima za uravnoteženje ova dva problema, uključujući revolucionarni projekt ispumpavanja milijardi litara morske vode u vodonosnike duboko ispod grada kako bi se razina ondje podignula za 25 cm. Odnos Venecije s lagunom ključan je za budućnost grada i objašnjava njegove trenutne poteškoće. U 15. stoljeću, dok se laguna začepljivala, krupnim inženjerskim pothvatima spriječeno je pretvaranje lagune u suho tlo, ali zato su poplave postale učestalije. Nove rute prema Sjevernoj i Južnoj Americi smanjile su trgovačku moć Venecije. Da bi preživio, grad je prenamijenjen u važnu turističku destinaciju. Danas Venecija privlači milijune turista godišnje. Veliki krstaši i teretni brodovi naguravaju se u kanalu zapadno od grada, a valovi s tih velikih plovila uzrokuju eroziju slanih močvara alarmantnom brzinom i povećavaju rizik od poplava, dok manji motorni čamci oštećuju stjenke kanala. Događaji kao što je Regatta Storica slave grad bez motornih čamaca. Pred mogućnošću da zbog klimatskih promjena izgube grad, Venecijanci se okreću revolucionarnom inženjerstvu: obnovi prirodnog okoliša i znanjima iz prošlosti. Samo se primjenom višestrukih pristupa mogu nadati da će spasiti Veneciju.

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Watch the recording of the second part of the traditional summer concert of the Vienna Philharmonic under the direction of renowned maestro Tugan Sokhijev from the unique Schonbrunn Palace Park in Vienna. On the open stage, in a carefully selected program, they will be joined by tenor Piotr Beczala, a well-known guest of world stages, and for the first time, one of the most famous children's choirs, the Viennese Boys. The basis of the program of the concert is the performance of popular arias from operas and operettas, as well as works from the rich cultural heritage of Europe. With this free concert in the unique setting of Schonbrunn Palace in Vienna, which has been held since 2004, this brilliant orchestra continues to pursue a specific cultural goal _ bringing classical music closer to a wide range of listeners and arousing interest beyond its usual audience. Enjoy the spectacle produced by ORF television, which is followed by millions of viewers around the world in eighty countries. / Iz jedinstvenog dvorskog perivoja Schonbrunn u Beču pogledajte snimku drugog dijela tradicionalnog ljetnog koncerta Bečke filharmonije pod ravnanjem renomiranog maestra Tugana Sokhijeva. Na otvorenoj pozornici, u brižljivo odabranom programu, pridružit će im se rado viđeni gost svjetskih pozornica tenor Piotr Beczala te prvi put i jedan od najpoznatijih dječjih zborova, Bečki dječaci. Programska osnova koncerta je izvođenje popularnih arija iz opera i opereta te djela iz bogatog kulturnog europskog nasljeđa. Ovim besplatnim koncertnom u jedinstvenom ambijentu perivoja palače Schonbrunn u Beču, koji se održava još od 2004. godine, ovaj briljantni orkestar nastavlja slijediti specifičan kulturni cilj _ približavanje klasične glazbe širokom spektru slušatelja i pobuđivanje zanimanja izvan svoje uobičajene publike. Uživajte u spektaklu koji producira televizija ORF, a koji prate milijuni gledatelja diljem svijeta u osamdeset zemalja.

programme.title: No signal area / Područje bez signala
programme.desc: After a night spent with Tanja (L. Barić), foreman Branoš (G. Bogdan) is greeted at home not only by the jealous wife of Josip (A. Ramljak) but also by bad news. After an attack on his doorstep, engineer Janda (I. Bajrović) ended up in the hospital and is in serious condition. Branoš tries to restrain Erol (S. Radoja) to whom Janda was like a father and who intends to deal with his real father Ragan (S. Štimac). Nikola (K. Mikić) and Oleg (R. Bitorajac) clash again over the uncertain future of the factory... / Nakon noći provedene s Tanjom (L. Barić) predradnika Branoša (G. Bogdan) kod kuće ne dočekuje samo ljubomorna supruga Josipa (A. Ramljak) nego i loše vijesti. Nakon napada na svom kućnom pragu, inženjer Janda (I. Bajrović) završio je u bolnici i u teškom je stanju. Branoš pokušava obuzdati Erola (S. Radoja) kojemu je Janda bio kao otac i koji se namjerava obračunati sa svojim pravim ocem Raganom (S. Štimac). Nikola (K. Mikić) i Oleg (R. Bitorajac) ponovno se sukobljavaju oko neizvjesne budućnosti tvornice...

programme.title: No signal area / Područje bez signala
programme.desc: The client of the turbine stopped answering and Oleg (R. Bitorajac) travels to his home country in Africa. Oleg also took Lipša (T. Lazović), now they are seriously in love. Riots have just broken out in the country, tourists are leaving the capital again and again. Oleg manages to find the client in the city and is forced to travel deeper into the desert where the fighting is going on. Lipša returns to Nuštin and conveys dramatic news to the workers and director Nikola (K. Mikić). The workers decide to complete the turbine no matter what... / Naručitelj turbine prestao se javljati i Oleg (R. Bitorajac) putuje u njegovu matičnu afričku državu. Oleg je poveo i Lipšu (T. Lazović), sad su već ozbiljno zaljubljeni. U državi su upravo izbili nemiri, turisti navrat-nanos napuštaju glavni grad. Oleg na uspijeva pronaći naručitelja u gradu i prisiljen je otputiti se dublje u pustinju gdje se vode borbe. Lipša se vraća u Nuštin i prenosi radnicima i direktoru Nikoli (K. Mikić) dramatične vijesti. Radnici odlučuju dovršiti turbinu bez obzira na sve...

programme.title: AieeeeeIio oi oaoh / AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu
programme.desc: Starting from five vowels and the gesture of coloring the screen through a self-portrait, the TV performance AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu plays with the relationship between voice, image, subjectivity and perception in the contemporary media environment, offering at the same time a meditative pause and a space for critical reflection of the usual pace and content. Karl Štefanek's work is broadcast as part of the 60th edition of the Zagreb Salon. / Polazeći od pet samoglasnika i geste bojanja ekrana preko autoportreta, TV performans AaaaEeeeIiiiOoooUuuu poigrava se odnosom glasa, slike, subjektiviteta i percepcije u suvremenom medijskom okruženju, nudeći istodobno meditativnu stanku i prostor kritičkog promišljanja uobičajenog tempa i sadržaja. Rad Karla Štefaneka emitira se u sklopu 60. izdanja Zagrebačkog salona.

programme.title: Chess commentary / Šahovski komentar
programme.desc: Analysis of the best chess games with comments by Grandmaster Alojzij Janković. / Analiza najboljih šahovskih partija uz komentare velemajstora Alojzija Jankovića.

programme.title: Annie Hall / Annie Hall
programme.desc: Neurotic comedian Alvy Singer (W. Allen) wistfully remembers his greatest love Annie Hall (D. Keaton), looking for the reason for their breakup a year ago. Alvy has been visiting a psychiatrist regularly for 15 years. Even as a boy, he fell into unexplained depressions and thought that his classmates were jerks. He was married twice, one marriage falling apart because he and his wife, a liberal (C. Kane), could not agree on how J.F. Kennedy was killed. However, his greatest love was Annie Hall, a simple and confused girl he met at tennis. As he fell more and more in love with Annie, Alvy slowly managed to persuade her to devote herself seriously to her hobby _ singing, start reading and attend evening lectures. When Annie developed from a girl to a woman, her relationship with Alvy became tight... / Neurotični komičar Alvy Singer (W. Allen) prisjeća se sa sjetom svoje najveće ljubavi Annie Hall (D. Keaton) tražeći razlog njihovog prekida od prije godinu dana. Već 15 godina Alvy redovito posjećuje psihijatra. Još kao dječak padao je u bezrazložne depresije i smatrao kako su njegovi razredni kolege kreteni. Bio je dvaput oženjen, jedan brak mu se raspao zato što se on i supruga, liberalka (C. Kane), nisu mogli složiti oko toga kako je ubijen J. F. Kennedy. Ipak, njegova najveća ljubav bila je Annie Hall, priprosta i zbunjena djevojka koju je upoznao na tenisu. Kako se sve više zajubljivao u Annie, Alvy ju je polako uspio nagovoriti da se ozbiljno posveti svom hobiju _ pjevanju, počne čitati i pohađati večernja predavanja. Kada se Annie razvila iz djevojke u ženu, veza s Alvyjem postala joj je tijesna...

programme.title: Special accessories / Posebni dodaci
programme.desc: The weekly show follows attractive movie marathons until the early hours of the morning with our best film critics and film experts. / Tjedna emisija, prati atraktivne filmske maratone do ranih jutarnjih sati uz naše najbolje filmske kritičare i filmologe.

programme.title: Overview of the day / Pregled dana
programme.desc: Overview of content from the country and the world shown in the show Studio 4. Broadcasts, live broadcasts, analyzes and conversations with guests from all areas of public activity. Politics, culture, sports and current affairs from social life. / Pregled sadržaja iz zemlje i svijeta prikazanih u emisiji Studio 4. Prijenosi, javljanja uživo, analize i razgovori s gostima iz svih područja javnog djelovanja. Politika, kultura, sport i aktualnosti iz društvenog života.

programme.title: The world of science / Svijet znanosti
programme.desc: Medicines are printed in China, amber is sought on the shores of the Baltic Sea. The Sami people in Sweden are fighting for the survival of the reindeer. Plans to open mines on ancient reindeer migration routes threaten the source of livelihood for many. Do high fashion and dirt go together? / U Kini se printaju lijekovi, na obalama Baltičkog mora traži se jantar. Narod Sami u Švedskoj bori se za opstanak sobova. Planovi za otvaranje rudnika na drevnim migracijskim rutama sobova mnogima ugrožavaju izvor egzistencije. Idu li zajedno visoka moda i prljavština?

programme.title: Global 3000 / Global 3000
programme.desc: Eight billion people live on Earth and we are more connected than ever before. New ideas on how to make the best use of it, brought by Global Us. / Osam milijardi ljudi živi na Zemlji i povezani smo bolje no što je to bilo ikada prije. Nove ideje o tome kako to najbolje iskoristiti, donosi Global Us.

programme.title: No comment / Bez komentara
programme.desc: News and interesting things from Croatia and the world without additional comments. / Aktualnosti i zanimljivosti iz Hrvatske i svijeta bez dodatnih komentara.

programme.title: Studio 4: Green Line / Studio 4: Zelena linija
programme.desc: Weekly 20 green minutes of conversation about all aspects of environmental protection, nature and sustainable development. / Tjednih 20 zelenih minuta razgovora o svim aspektima zaštite okoliša, prirode i održivog razvoja.

programme.title: No comment / Bez komentara

programme.title: Ekpona / Eko zona
programme.desc: Works on the revitalization of the Arboretum Opeka in the municipality of Vinica near Varaždin are underway. After the restoration of the Opeka castle, built in the Baroque style in the second half of the 17th century, which had been deteriorating for decades, sediment was removed from the small artificial lake and the planting of indigenous and rare species is planned. On the occasion of that project, an introductory conference was recently held. Jaškovo is a small settlement within the town of Ozlje in Karlovac County. It was first mentioned in historical records as far back as 1433, when Prince Bartol Frankopan gave the people of Jaškov the pasture around the Dobra River for their use. It is in this ancient region that the Kovač family's farm is located, which has high-mountain Scottish cattle in free-range pastures. In addition to cattle, the family also grows pumpkins, walnuts and hazelnuts in an ecological way. We also bring foreign news. The pearly series of islands and islets called Pakleni otoci has been a protected natural monument in the category of significant landscape since 1968. Posidonia meadows still grow in its bays and straits. / U tijeku su radovi na revitalizaciji Arboretuma Opeka u općini Vinica pokraj Varaždina. Nakon obnove dvorca Opeka, izgrađenog u baroknom stilu još u 2. polovici 17. stoljeća koji je desetljećima propadao, izvađen je sediment iz malenog umjetnog jezera te se planira sadnja autohtonih i rijetkih vrsta. U povodu tog projekta nedavno je održana i uvodna konferencija. Jaškovo je maleno naselje u sastavu grada Ozlja u Karlovačkoj županiji. Prvi se put spominje u povijesnim zapisima još davne 1433. kad knez Bartol Frankopan daruje Jaškovljanima paše oko rijeke Dobre na korištenje. Upravo se u tom drevnom kraju smjestilo gospodarstvo obitelji Kovač koja na otvorenim pašnjacima u slobodnom uzgoju ima visokoplaninsko škotsko govedo. Osim goveda na ekološki način obitelj uzgaja i tikve, orahe i lješnjake. Donosimo i strane vijesti. Biserni niz otoka i otočića nazvan Pakleni otoci zaštićeni je spomenik prirode u kategoriji značajnog krajolika još od 1968. godine. U njegovim uvalama i tjesnacima i danas još rastu livade posidonije.

programme.desc: In today's show, we meet Oskar, an unusual pet, a dwarf goat. programme.desc: In the half-hour "Interview of the Week", relevant interlocutors from all spheres of social and political life talk about current and interesting topics, events and news. / U polusatnom "Intervju tjedna" o aktualnim i zanimljivim temama, događajima i vijestima govore relevantni sugovornici iz svih sfera društvenog i političkog života.

programme.title: Talents of EU regions / Talenti EU regija
programme.desc: How do European Union member regions respond to demographic challenges? How to stop emigration and how to reward the creativity of talents? Answers to questions about the increasingly pronounced problem of brain drain and growing differences in development are provided by the show "Talents of the EU Region". In 26 short stories of Television Slovenia, examples of good practices from 11 European countries are presented. The project "Talents of the EU region" shows the results of the cohesion policy of the European Union _ one of the key pillars of European development. / Kako regije članica Europske unije odgovaraju na demografske izazove? Kako zaustaviti emigraciju i kako nagraditi kreativnost talenata? Odgovore na pitanja o sve izraženijem problemu odljeva mozgova i rastućim razlikama u razvijenosti donosi emisija "Talenti EU regija". U 26 kratkih priča Televizije Slovenije predstavljaju se primjeri dobrih praksi iz 11 europskih zemalja. Projekt "Talenti EU regija" prikazuje rezultate kohezijske politike Europske unije _ jednog od ključnih stupova europskog razvoja.

programme.desc: The series is based on real cases. Mitchell is a gym owner but is serving a short sentence. His girlfriend Tilly runs the business, not realizing that one of the young customers is not only having an affair with him, but is also carrying his baby. In a moment of rage, she kills the young girl. / Поредицата е създадена по действителни случаи. Мичъл е собственик на фитнес, но излежава кратка присъда. Приятелката му Тили движи бизнеса, без да предполага, че една от младите клиентки не само има връзка с него, но и носи бебето му. В момент на ярост, тя убива младото момиче.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Germany / Колоездене: Обиколка на Германия
programme.desc: The Tour of Germany is one of the biggest and most prestigious cycling races in Germany. It is a multi-day race that usually takes place at the end of summer and attracts top cyclists from all over the world. Germany is known for its beautiful and varied routes that offer both flat stages and serious mountain climbs, making the race extremely exciting and challenging. / Обиколката на Германия е едно от най-големите и престижни състезания по колоездене в Германия. Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. Германия е известна със своите красиви и разнообразни маршрути, които предлагат както равнинни етапи, така и сериозни планински изкачвания, което прави състезанието изключително вълнуващо и оспорвано.

The last one wins / Последният печели
programme.desc: "Last One Wins" is a fun-informative, family-friendly quiz show featuring four players. It consists of three rounds with different spheres of knowledge, in which the questions are of different point value. At the end of each round, one participant is eliminated, and the winner earns the right to compete in the next episode and play until someone else manages to defeat them. / "Последният печели" е забавно-познавателно, семейно куиз шоу, в което участват четирима играчи. Състои се от три кръга с различни сфери на познанието, в които въпросите са с различна точкова стойност. След края на всеки кръг отпада по един участник, а победителят печели правото да се състезава и в следващия епизод и играе, докато някой друг не успее да го победи.

programme.title: Through the Corridors of Time with Morgan Freeman / През коридорите на времето с Морган Фрийман
programme.desc: Join Academy Award-winner Morgan Freeman to learn more about intelligent design theory and compare it to the latest empirical evidence. / Присъединете се към носителя на Оскар Морган Фрийман, за да научите повече за теорията на интелигентния дизайн и да я сравните с най-новите емпирични доказателства.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evladia Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a column in which we present the most famous faces from the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. programme.title: Football - Europa League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. From that season, the competition was officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a competition by groups was introduced, followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year... / UEFA Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

The Vienna crime thriller: Blindly investigated - ghosts of the past / Der Wien-Krimi: Blind ermittelt - Geister der Vergangenheit
programme.desc: When Alex Haller (Philipp Hochmair) happily gets into a taxi after a night at the club, a horror trip begins for the blind investigator. The driver gives him water with anesthetic and knocking noises come from the trunk. With the last of her strength, Alex manages to free himself. His fragments of memory later only contain the saying "Freud's mistake" - and a quote that Chief Inspector Mia Markovic (Claudia Kottal) immediately recognizes: "Justice is the right of the weaker!" This sentence leads to Alex's former colleague Grischka Tanner (Ursula Strauss), who years ago had to go to prison because of a statement made by Alex after a police operation in which a murderer was killed. The ex-commissioner now runs a psychoanalytic practice for female victims of violence. The investigator believes that Grischka recently met his companion Niko Falk (Andreas Guenther) is no more a coincidence than her date with Niko at the time of the kidnapping. To understand his role in an opaque plan, Alex relies on the knowledge of Freud expert Anna Bernays (Dennenesch Zoude). When he realizes what he is accused of, Alex is already in great danger... / Als Alex Haller (Philipp Hochmair) nach einer Clubnacht gluckbeseelt in ein Taxi steigt, beginnt fur den blinden Ermittler ein Horrortrip. Die Fahrerin gibt ihm Wasser mit Betaubungsmittel und aus dem Kofferraum dringen Klopfgerausche. Mit letzter Kraft gelingt es Alex, sich zu befreien. Seine Erinnerungsfetzen geben spater nur den Ausspruch "Freuds Fehler" her - und ein Zitat, das Hauptkommissarin Mia Markovic (Claudia Kottal) sofort wiedererkennt: "Gerechtigkeit ist das Recht der Schwacheren!" Dieser Satz fuhrt zu Alex fruherer Kollegin Grischka Tanner (Ursula Strauss), die vor Jahren nach einem Polizeieinsatz, bei dem ein Morder ums Leben kam, wegen einer Aussage von Alex ins Gefangnis musste. Jetzt fuhrt die Ex-Kommissarin eine psychoanalytische Praxis fur weibliche Gewaltopfer. Dass Grischka seinen Gefahrten Niko Falk (Andreas Guenther) vor Kurzem kennengelernt hat, halt der Ermittler daher genauso wenig fur einen Zufall wie ihr Date mit Niko zum Zeitpunkt der Entfuhrung. Um seine Rolle in einem undurchsichtigen Plan zu verstehen, setzt Alex auf das Wissen der Freud-Expertin Anna Bernays (Dennenesch Zoude). Als er erkennt, was ihm angelastet wird, befindet sich Alex bereits in groSSter Gefahr ...

programme.desc: All too often, German politics offers opportunities for ridicule and criticism. programme.title: Strater's problem areas / Straters Problemzonen
programme.desc: Can't stop, won't stop! In this episode of "Staters Problem Zones" Torsten Strater once again throws everything into the balance to straighten out the world a little bit. Olaf Schubert strengthens the comedy task force and embarks on a breakneck "Mission Possible": He secretly tries to replace a missing Tupperware container and thus save a broken mother-son relationship. Olaf doesn't even shy away from a little break-in - dramatic, action-packed, minimally criminal and maximally funny. Torsten welcomes the model and It-girl Lorena Rae as a studio guest. The two coolest people on German TV compete in an exciting round of “embarrassment poker” and prove that there is actually a way out of every situation, no matter how unpleasant. And because the best stories come from the heart of life, Strater is once again listening very carefully when passers-by enter his complaint chair. There, real people reveal what really annoys them in everyday life - from small dramas to big life questions. / Cant stop, wont stop! Auch in dieser Folge von "Staters Problemzonen" wirft Torsten Strater wieder alles in die Waagschale, um die Welt ein kleines bisschen geraderzurucken. Dabei verstarkt Olaf Schubert die Comedy Taskforce und begibt sich auf eine halsbrecherische "Mission Possible": Er versucht heimlich eine verschwundene Tupperdose zu ersetzen und so ein zerruttetes Mutter-Sohn-Verhaltnis zu retten. Dafur schreckt Olaf nicht mal vor einem kleinen Einbruch zuruck - dramatisch, actionreich, minimal kriminell und maximal lustig.Als Studiogast begruSSt Torsten das Model und It-Girl Lorena Rae. Die beiden coolsten Menschen im deutschen TV messen sich in einer spannenden Runde "Peinlichkeits-Poker" und beweisen: Es gibt tatsachlich einen Ausweg aus jeder noch so unangenehmen Situation.Und weil die besten Geschichten mitten aus dem Leben kommen, hort Strater auch dieses Mal ganz genau hin, wenn Passant:innen seinen Beschwerdestuhl betreten. Dort verraten echte Menschen, was sie im Alltag so richtig auf die Palme bringt - von kleinen Dramen bis zu groSSen Lebensfragen.

programme.title: Inspector LaBrea - Death trauma at Montparnasse / Kommissar LaBrea - Todestraume am Montparnasse
programme.desc: The murder of ex-convict Pascal Masson (Rudiger Kuhmstedt) puzzles Inspector LaBrea (Francis Fulton-Smith). The tied up victim bled to death after being mutilated in the genital area. At the crime scene, the police find a music cassette with Ravel's "Bolero" - a message? The inspector receives a tip about a similar case from his colleague Franck Zechira (Oliver Bootz). A rapist hanged himself in custody after falling into the hands of a group of radical feminists who practice vigilante justice with paint that is difficult to remove. Although the unknown women have so far limited themselves to symbolic castrations, LaBrea cannot rule them out as suspects. When searching for the members of the group, he repeatedly comes across Christine Payan (Sabine Vitua). The well-known psychologist is committed to caring for rape victims and knows more about this group than she says. While LaBrea initially struggles with the aloof Madame Payan, his relationship with the enchanting neighbor Celine (Valerie Niehaus) becomes ever closer. But since the anniversary of his wife's death is approaching, he doesn't dare to admit his feelings - also out of consideration for his daughter Jenny (Leonie Brill). With another murder of Stefan Vlankovic (Jorg Becker), who was apparently in hiding in Paris, carried out according to the same pattern, a hot lead finally emerges: the Serb Vlankovic and ex-Foreign Legionnaire Masson knew each other from that Balkan War. The European Court of Justice in The Hague has a thick file on Vlankovic for various war crimes. However, the solution to the case brings a painful surprise for LaBrea and his colleague Franck Zechira (Oliver Bootz). / Die Ermordung des Ex-Straflings Pascal Masson (Rudiger Kuhmstedt) gibt Kommissar LaBrea (Francis Fulton-Smith) Ratsel auf. Das gefesselte Opfer verblutete, nachdem es im Genitalbereich verstummelt wurde. Am Tatort findet die Polizei eine Musikkassette mit Ravels "Bolero" - eine Botschaft? Von seinem Kollegen Franck Zechira (Oliver Bootz) erhalt der Kommissar den Hinweis auf einen ahnlichen Fall. Ein Vergewaltiger hatte sich in der U-Haft erhangt, nachdem er zuvor einer Gruppe radikaler Feministinnen in die Hande gefallen war, die mit schwer entfernbarer Farbe Selbstjustiz uben. Obwohl sich die unbekannten Frauen bislang auf symbolische Kastrationen beschrankten, kann LaBrea sie als Verdachtige nicht ausschlieSSen. Bei der Suche nach den Mitgliedern der Gruppe stoSSt er immer wieder auf Christine Payan (Sabine Vitua). Die namhafte Psychologin engagiert sich in der Betreuung von Vergewaltigungsopfern und weiSS mehr uber diese Gruppe, als sie sagt. Wahrend LaBrea sich an der unnahbaren Madame Payan zunachst die Zahne ausbeiSSt, wird seine Beziehung zu der zauberhaften Nachbarin Celine (Valerie Niehaus) immer enger. Doch da der Todestag seiner Frau bevorsteht, wagt er es nicht, zu seinen Gefuhlen zu stehen - auch aus Rucksicht auf seine Tochter Jenny (Leonie Brill).Mit einem weiteren Mord an dem offensichtlich in Paris untergetauchten Stefan Vlankovic (Jorg Becker), ausgefuhrt nach demselben Muster, ergibt sich endlich eine heiSSe Spur: Der Serbe Vlankovic und Ex-Fremdenlegionar Masson kannten sich aus dem Balkankrieg. Über Vlankovic fuhrt der Europaische Gerichtshof in Den Haag eine dicke Akte wegen diverser Kriegsverbrechen. Die Losung des Falles birgt allerdings eine schmerzliche Überraschung fur LaBrea und seinen Kollegen Franck Zechira (Oliver Bootz).

programme.title: Strater's problem areas / Straters Problemzonen
programme.desc: Torsten Strater would like to have your problems - for his new show! In "Strater's Problem Zones" the comedian devotes himself, with his usual dry humor, to exactly the things that no one else feels responsible for: everyday absurdities, small crises, big life questions. And with the necessary seriousness. No matter whether it's about collecting debts amounting to € 3.75, canceling your gym membership for a long time or confessing that your partner's pasta salad is inedible - together with prominent guests such as Martina Hill, Olaf Schubert, Katrin Bauerfeind or Siegfried and Joy, Torsten transforms every seemingly banal topic into an epic one Adventure. The mission of the superheroes: to make the world a little bit better. / Ihre Probleme hatte Torsten Strater gerne - und zwar fur seine neue Sendung! Bei "Straters Problemzonen" widmet sich der Komiker mit gewohnt trockenem Humor genau den Dingen, fur die sich sonst keiner zustandig fuhlt: alltagliche Absurditaten, kleine Krisen, groSSe Lebensfragen. Und zwar mit dem notigen Ernst.Egal ob es um das Eintreiben von Schulden in Hohe von € 3,75 geht, die langst fallige Kundigung der Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft oder die Beichte, dass der Nudelsalat des Partners ungenieSSbar ist - gemeinsam mit prominenten Gasten wie Martina Hill, Olaf Schubert, Katrin Bauerfeind oder Siegfried and Joy verwandelt Torsten jedes vermeintlich banale Thema in ein episches Abenteuer. programme.title: Hubert without Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
programme.desc: Leonard Zirngibl, senior owner of the Zirngibl quality butcher shop, dies after falling from his perch. Unfortunately, he falls on the young hitchhiker Lea, who is then taken to the hospital with a concussion. Not only does the man's autopsy prove foul play, Lea also turns out to be Dr. Fox daughter. According to her statement, two men were arguing on the stand and she is convinced that she would recognize the second man's voice. Hubert and Girwidz go through Wolfratshausen with their cell phones in dictation position to catch votes - and soon there are two main suspects. / Leonard Zirngibl, Seniorinhaber der Qualitatsmetzgerei Zirngibl, kommt durch einen Sturz von seinem Hochsitz ums Leben. Bedauerlicherweise sturzt er auf die junge Tramperin Lea, die daraufhin mit einer Gehirnerschutterung ins Krankenhaus gebracht wird. Nicht nur, dass die Obduktion des Mannes ein Fremdverschulden nachweist, Lea entpuppt sich auch noch als Dr. Fuchs Tochter. Laut ihrer Aussage haben sich zwei Manner auf dem Hochsitz gestritten und sie ist fest davon uberzeugt, dass sie die Stimme des Zweiten wiederkennen wurde. Hubert und Girwidz gehen mit ihren Handys in Diktier-Position auf Stimmenfang durch Wolfratshausen - und schon bald gibt es zwei Hauptverdachtige.

programme.title: WaPo Elbe / WaPo Elbe
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead on the banks of the Elbe. The autopsy reveals that Lina Hilpert died of an overdose of the new fad drug “White Lightning”. She probably consumed the substance in the trendy Stestí club just across the Czech border. The WaPo investigation initially focuses on the members of a drug self-help group, which also included Lina and her mentally disturbed ex-boyfriend Oli. Is Lina's death the sad end to a relationship drama? For the director, Marie Liu, the tragedy is, first and foremost, further evidence of a scandalous failure by the authorities. "White Lightning" is freely available due to a loophole in the law! And then there is the dropout Frieder Mertens, in whose caravan Lina was apparently before her death. Did she have an affair with him? And why did Lina's ex-boyfriend Oli escape from the psychiatric hospital on the day of her death? Little by little, the investigators piece together the mysterious puzzle and in the end have to realize that everything was completely different than expected: perpetrators become victims and victims become perpetrators. / Eine junge Frau wird tot am Ufer der Elbe gefunden. Die Obduktion ergibt, dass Lina Hilpert an einer Überdosis der neuen Modedroge "White Lightning" gestorben ist. Vermutlich hat sie den Stoff im Szeneclub Stestí gleich hinter der tschechischen Grenze konsumiert. Die Ermittlungen der WaPo fokussieren sich zunachst auf die Mitglieder einer Drogenselbsthilfegruppe, in der auch Lina und ihr psychisch auffalliger Exfreund Oli waren. Ist Linas Tod das traurige Ende eines Beziehungsdramas? Fur die Leiterin Marie Liu ist die Tragodie in erster Linie der neuerliche Beweis fur ein skandaloses Behordenversagen. "White Lightning" ist aufgrund einer Gesetzeslucke frei erhaltlich! Und dann ist da noch der Aussteiger Frieder Mertens, in dessen Wohnwagen Lina vor ihrem Tod offensichtlich war. Hatte sie eine Affare mit ihm? Und warum ist Linas Exfreund Oli ausgerechnet am Tag ihres Todes aus der Psychiatrie geflohen? Nach und nach setzen die Ermittler:innen das mysteriose Puzzle zusammen und mussen am Ende erkennen, dass alles ganz anders war als gedacht: Aus Tatern werden Opfer und aus Opfern Tater.

programme.title: Master of everyday life / Meister des Alltags
programme.desc: Does medical confidentiality also apply to married couples? Can you visit a Maultaschen museum in Baden-Wurttemberg? And can you easily remove the stalk from a tomato with a paper clip? These and many other exciting and curious questions about everyday life can be found in the SWR knowledge quiz! Moderator Florian Weber puts his prominent candidates' suitability for everyday use to the test on "Masters of Everyday Life". Cabaret artist Christoph Sonntag and actress Alice Hoffmann compete against comedian Bodo Bach and presenter Enie van de Meiklokjes. Creativity and inventiveness are required when guessing the tricky questions from everyday life. Both teams play for projects run by the Herzenssache children's charity - and the winning team's winnings are doubled! / Gilt auch bei Eheleuten die arztliche Schweigepflicht? Kann man in Baden-Wurttemberg ein Maultaschenmuseum besuchen? Und lasst sich mit einer Buroklammer ganz einfach der Strunk einer Tomate entfernen? Diese und viele weitere spannende und kuriose Fragen rund um den ganz normalen Alltag gibt es im SWR-Wissensquiz! Moderator Florian Weber stellt bei "Meister des Alltags" die Alltagstauglichkeit seiner prominenten Kandidaten auf die Probe. Kabarettist Christoph Sonntag und Schauspielerin Alice Hoffmann treten gegen Comedian Bodo Bach und Moderatorin Enie van de Meiklokjes an. Kreativitat und Ideenreichtum sind gefragt beim Erraten der kniffligen Fragen aus dem taglichen Leben. Beide Teams spielen jeweils fur Projekte der Kinderhilfsaktion Herzenssache - und die erspielte Summe des Siegerteams wird verdoppelt!

programme.title: Storm of love / Sturm der Liebe
programme.desc: When Fritz noticed that a well-known basketball player was staying at the hotel, he would like an autograph for his father, but employees are not supposed to approach celebrities. Fanny overcomes her shyness and still gets him his autograph because she believes Fritz is on good terms with his father. When she gives Fritz the autograph, she realizes that Fritz and she have a lot in common. Greta learns from Hildegard that the LUIS is now advertised for sale, but forbids herself to think about it. When Kilian notices that Greta is not considering buying Lui's restaurant, he thinks about it himself. At the same time, Miro got a tip from Alfons about renting an apartment. He was just about to tell Greta about it when she confessed to him that she was thinking about buying the restaurant again. In order to surprise the bride and groom at the wedding, Werner commissions Erik to organize a carriage. But he incorrectly assumes that it is a different wedding and the bride and groom are happy about the mistaken surprise. / Als Fritz mitbekommt, dass ein bekannter Basketballer im Hotel abgestiegen ist, hatte er gerne ein Autogramm fur seinen Vater, doch Angestellte sollen Prominente nicht ansprechen. Fanny uberwindet ihre Schuchternheit und besorgt ihm dennoch das Autogramm, da sie Fritz gutes Verhaltnis zu seinem Vater ruhrt. Als sie Fritz das Autogramm uberreicht, muss sie feststellen, dass Fritz und sie eine groSSe Gemeinsamkeit haben.Greta erfahrt von Hildegard, dass das LUIS nun zum Verkauf ausgeschrieben ist, verbietet sich aber den Gedanken daran. Als Kilian mitbekommt, dass Greta den Kauf von Luis Restaurant nicht in Betracht zieht, denkt er selbst daruber nach. Gleichzeitig hat Miro von Alfons den Tipp fur eine Mietwohnung bekommen. Gerade will er Greta davon erzahlen, da gesteht sie ihm, dass sie doch wieder uber den Kauf des Restaurants nachdenkt.Um das Brautpaar bei der Hochzeit uberraschen, beauftragt Werner Erik damit, eine Kutsche zu organisieren. Doch der geht falschlicherweise von einer anderen Hochzeit aus und das entsprechende Brautpaar freut sich uber die irrtumliche Überraschung.

programme.title: Kidnapping for beginners / Entfuhren fur Anfanger
programme.desc: The glamorous Evelyn Moser (Andrea Sawatzki) has long been the star of her husband Rob Moser's (Fritz Karl) beauty empire. The vain plastic surgeon initiates a generational change - in agreement with Evelyn, of course. At a media event he introduces Lene (Hedi Honert), whom he has perfected himself, as the new brand face! The fact that the much younger influencer is also supposed to inherit her predecessor privately is Rob's well-guarded company secret. However, the accountant Adam Lansky (Christian Berkel), whom the beauty magnate unsentimentally exchanges for the AI ​​after almost four decades, relies on the image of Moser's dream marriage from the tabloid press. When he kidnaps Evelyn from the party, Adam expects to get a hefty ransom in no time. But not only the impulsive nature of his tough hostage, but also her husband's strange disinterest causes the blackmailer's plan to falter. Evelyn realizes that her unfaithful husband wanted to get rid of her. While Adam wants to give up, her fighting spirit awakens. Now the dupe takes charge to clean out Rob's offshore accounts... / Die glamourose Evelyn Moser (Andrea Sawatzki) ist seit Langem der Star des Beauty-Imperiums ihres Mannes Rob Moser (Fritz Karl). Der eitle Schonheitschirurg leitet - naturlich im Einvernehmen mit Evelyn - einen Generationenwechsel ein. Bei einem Medienevent stellt er die von ihm eigenhandig perfektionierte Lene (Hedi Honert) als neues Markengesicht vor! Dass die deutlich jungere Influencerin auch privat ihre Vorgangerin beerben soll, ist Robs wohl gehutetes Firmengeheimnis. Der Buchhalter Adam Lansky (Christian Berkel), den der Beauty-Magnat nach fast vier Jahrzehnten unsentimental gegen die KI austauscht, vertraut jedoch auf das Image der Moser-Traumehe aus der Klatschpresse. Als er Evelyn von der Party entfuhrt, rechnet Adam mit einem satten Losegeld im Handumdrehen. Doch nicht nur die impulsive Art seiner taffen Geisel, sondern auch das seltsame Desinteresse ihres Mannes bringt den Plan des Erpressers ins Wanken. Evelyn erkennt, dass ihr untreuer Mann sie loswerden mochte. Wahrend Adam aufgeben will, erwacht ihr Kampfgeist. Nun ubernimmt die Betrogene das Kommando, um Robs Offshore-Konten auszuraumen ...

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: After a traffic accident in Lubeck's old town, the driver threatened a passer-by with a pistol and fled unrecognized. His passenger, the doctor's wife Silvia Walden, is taken to the hospital unconscious, operated on and put into an artificial coma. Blood and a cartridge case in the car suggest that the escapee was injured by a gunshot. The detectives can quickly determine the man's identity: he is the wanted murderer Rene Kruse. When it turns out that the weapon did not come from Kruse, but had been bought shortly before by Silvia Walden, the investigators are surprised. Why would an innocent woman buy a pistol? And what does she have to do with Kruse anyway? Only slowly do the inspectors discover the secret - and on the trail of a great tragedy. / Nach einem Verkehrsunfall in der Lubecker Altstadt bedroht der Fahrer eine Passantin mit einer Pistole und flieht unerkannt. Seine Beifahrerin, die Arztgattin Silvia Walden, wird bewusstlos ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert, operiert und ins kunstliche Koma versetzt. Blut und eine Patronenhulse im Auto legen den Verdacht nahe, dass der Fluchtige durch einen Schuss verletzt wurde. Die Kommissare konnen die Identitat des Mannes schnell ermitteln: Es handelt sich um den gesuchten Morder Rene Kruse. Als herauskommt, dass die Waffe nicht von Kruse stammt, sondern kurz zuvor von Silvia Walden gekauft wurde, sind die Ermittler uberrascht. Warum kauft sich eine unbescholtene Frau eine Pistole? Und was hat sie uberhaupt mit Kruse zu tun? Nur langsam kommen die Kommissare hinter das Geheimnis - und auf die Spur einer groSSen Tragodie.

programme.title: Brokenwood - Mord in Neuseeland / Brokenwood - Mord in Neuseeland
programme.desc: In Brokenwood's "museum village" the clock appears to have stopped in 1861. With great attention to detail, life is portrayed as it was in Queen Victoria's time, including the postal worker (David van Horn), the village priest (Edward Newborn), the blacksmith (Scott Wills) and even two soldiers armed with muskets (Dan Veint, Geoff Houtman). When the body of the operator Charity (Jacqueline Nairn) is found in the school building with an arrowhead in her forehead, the idyll is over. It doesn't take long for Detective Mike Shepherd (Neill Rea) to spot the first clue in the murder case. The message "Thou shalt not kill!" is written cryptically on the classroom blackboard. But who is meant by this fifth commandment? During their investigation, Shepherd, his assistant Sims (Fern Sutherland) and D.C. Breen (Nic Sampson) uncover another crime. Seven years ago, Charity's husband disappeared. What seemed like suicide at the time now appears in a different light. Near the museum village, Shepherd makes a surprising find. The skeleton of the missing man lies in a closed septic tank. However, the investigator breaks his leg during the action and Kristin Sims is allowed to lead the investigation into the connected murder cases for the first time. / In Brokenwoods "Museumsdorf" scheint die Uhr im Jahr 1861 stehen geblieben zu sein. Mit viel Liebe zum Detail wird das Leben wie zu Zeiten Queen Victorias dargestellt, samt Postbeamtem (David van Horn), Dorfpfarrer (Edward Newborn), Schmied (Scott Wills) und sogar zwei mit Musketen bewaffneten Soldaten (Dan Veint, Geoff Houtman). Als im Schulhaus die Leiche der Betreiberin Charity (Jacqueline Nairn) mit einer Pfeilspitze in der Stirn gefunden wird, ist es jedoch vorbei mit der Idylle. Detective Mike Shepherd (Neill Rea) braucht nicht lange, bis er einen ersten Hinweis in dem Mordfall erkennt. Auf der Tafel des Klassenzimmers steht kryptisch die Botschaft "Du sollst nicht toten!" Doch wer ist mit diesem funften Gebot gemeint? Bei ihren Ermittlungen kommen Shepherd, seine Assistentin Sims (Fern Sutherland) und D. C. Breen (Nic Sampson) einem weiteren Verbrechen auf die Spur. Vor sieben Jahren ist Charitys Ehemann verschwunden. Was damals wie ein Suizid aussah, erscheint nun in einem anderen Licht. In der Nahe des Museumsdorfes macht Shepherd einen uberraschenden Fund. In einer verschlossenen Sickergrube liegt das Skelett des Vermissten. Bei der Aktion bricht sich der Ermittler jedoch das Bein und Kristin Sims darf erstmalig die Ermittlungen der miteinander verbundenen Mordfalle leiten.

Dass die deutlich jungere Influencerin auch privat ihre Vorgangerin beerben soll, ist Robs wohl gehutetes Firmengeheimnis. Der Buchhalter Adam Lansky (Christian Berkel), den der Beauty-Magnat nach fast vier Jahrzehnten unsentimental gegen die KI austauscht, vertraut jedoch auf das Image der Moser-Traumehe aus der Klatschpresse. Als er Evelyn von der Party entfuhrt, rechnet Adam mit einem satten Losegeld im Handumdrehen. Doch nicht nur die impulsive Art seiner taffen Geisel, sondern auch das seltsame Desinteresse ihres Mannes bringt den Plan des Erpressers ins Wanken. Evelyn erkennt, dass ihr untreuer Mann sie loswerden mochte. Wahrend Adam aufgeben will, erwacht ihr Kampfgeist. Nun ubernimmt die Betrogene das Kommando, um Robs Offshore-Konten auszuraumen ...

programme.title: Brokenwood - Mord in Neuseeland / Brokenwood - Mord in Neuseeland
programme.desc: In Brokenwood's "museum village" the clock appears to have stopped in 1861. With great attention to detail, life is portrayed as it was in Queen Victoria's time, including the postal worker (David van Horn), the village priest (Edward Newborn), the blacksmith (Scott Wills) and even two soldiers armed with muskets (Dan Veint, Geoff Houtman). When the body of the operator Charity (Jacqueline Nairn) is found in the school building with an arrowhead in her forehead, the idyll is over. It doesn't take long for Detective Mike Shepherd (Neill Rea) to spot the first clue in the murder case. The message "Thou shalt not kill!" is written cryptically on the classroom blackboard. But who is meant by this fifth commandment? During their investigation, Shepherd, his assistant Sims (Fern Sutherland) and D.C. Breen (Nic Sampson) uncover another crime. Seven years ago, Charity's husband disappeared. What seemed like suicide at the time now appears in a different light. Near the museum village, Shepherd makes a surprising find. The skeleton of the missing man lies in a closed septic tank. However, the investigator breaks his leg during the action and Kristin Sims is allowed to lead the investigation into the connected murder cases for the first time. / In Brokenwoods "Museumsdorf" scheint die Uhr im Jahr 1861 stehen geblieben zu sein. Mit viel Liebe zum Detail wird das Leben wie zu Zeiten Queen Victorias dargestellt, samt Postbeamtem (David van Horn), Dorfpfarrer (Edward Newborn), Schmied (Scott Wills) und sogar zwei mit Musketen bewaffneten Soldaten (Dan Veint, Geoff Houtman). Als im Schulhaus die Leiche der Betreiberin Charity (Jacqueline Nairn) mit einer Pfeilspitze in der Stirn gefunden wird, ist es jedoch vorbei mit der Idylle. Detective Mike Shepherd (Neill Rea) braucht nicht lange, bis er einen ersten Hinweis in dem Mordfall erkennt. Auf der Tafel des Klassenzimmers steht kryptisch die Botschaft "Du sollst nicht toten!" Doch wer ist mit diesem funften Gebot gemeint? Bei ihren Ermittlungen kommen Shepherd, seine Assistentin Sims (Fern Sutherland) und D. C. Breen (Nic Sampson) einem weiteren Verbrechen auf die Spur. Vor sieben Jahren ist Charitys Ehemann verschwunden. Was damals wie ein Suizid aussah, erscheint nun in einem anderen Licht. In der Nahe des Museumsdorfes macht Shepherd einen uberraschenden Fund. In einer verschlossenen Sickergrube liegt das Skelett des Vermissten. Bei der Aktion bricht sich der Ermittler jedoch das Bein und Kristin Sims darf erstmalig die Ermittlungen der miteinander verbundenen Mordfalle leiten.

programme.title: Pictures of Germany / Deutschlandbilder
programme.desc: Traveling with the camera: The program shows the most beautiful sides of German cities and landscapes in quiet, uncommented recordings accompanied by music. / Mit der Kamera auf Reisen: Die Sendung zeigt in ruhigen, unkommentierten und mit Musik untermalten Aufnahmen die schonsten Seiten deutscher Stadte und Landschaften.

programme.title: Hubert without Staller / Hubert ohne Staller
The Wild Animal Orphanage / Das Waisenhaus fur wilde Tiere
programme.desc: Bio-Bordering is the name of the experiment that volunteer Jessica and Harnas employee Caro are trying out today. Baboons are escape kings and Harnas therefore has to invest a lot of time and money in fences. Today an attempt is being made to scare the baboons away with leopard droppings. Does that work? There is also a warm reunion: the painter and former employee Annika is visiting her favorites, the Lions Zion and Trust. Even after three years, the lion brothers immediately recognize Annika and become real cuddly animals. Volunteer Moritz has to deal with smaller journeymen. He is building a course for the mongoose pack on the Lappa. There are even traffic jams in the tunnel. / Bio-Bordering heiSSt das Experiment, das Volontarin Jessica und Harnas-Mitarbeiterin Caro heute ausprobieren. Paviane sind Ausbrecherkonige und Harnas muss deshalb viel Zeit und Geld in Zaune investieren. Heute soll versucht werden, die Paviane mit Leoparden-Kot abzuschrecken. Ob das funktioniert? AuSSerdem gibt es ein herzliches Wiedersehen: Die Malerin und ehemalige Mitarbeiterin Annika ist zu Besuch bei ihren Lieblingen, den Lowen Zion und Trust. Auch nach drei Jahren erkennen die Lowenbruder Annika sofort wieder und werden zu regelrechten Schmusetieren. Mit kleineren Gesellen hat es Volontar Moritz zu tun. Er baut einen Parcours fur das Mangusten-Rudel auf der Lappa. Im Tunnel gibt es sogar Stau.

programme.title: The camp in the wilderness / Das Camp in der Wildnis
programme.desc: During a visit to the husky farm, the cuddly sled dogs drive away Niklas's first feelings of homesickness. Leyla is knocked out by the corner of a window, but Kaja is hit even harder: she has to stay in bed because of Corona while her friends set off on their first hiking tour. But the mountainous terrain not only provides great views, but also the first conflicts. Can Max and his motivational team save the day? / Beim Besuch auf der Huskyfarm vertreiben die kuscheligen Schlittenhunde bei Niklas die ersten Anfluge von Heimweh. Leyla wird von einer Fensterecke ausgeknockt, aber Kaja trifft es noch harter: Sie muss wegen Corona im Bett bleiben, wahrend ihre Freundinnen zur ersten Wandertour aufbrechen. Doch das bergige Gelande sorgt nicht nur fur tolle Ausblicke, sondern auch fur erste Konflikte. Konnen Max und sein Motivationsteam die Lage retten?

programme.title: The camp in the wilderness / Das Camp in der Wildnis
programme.desc: In the Norwegian wilderness, Maxi and everyone else make an unfortunate choice while searching for a place to sleep. And then breakfast gets completely out of control: semolina porridge alarm with crawly snacks. Back at camp things get romantic: Rule number one when writing love letters in Norwegian: Don't start with the "rumpe" right away! And the announced room inspection puts everyone in complete stress. / In der norwegischen Wildnis treffen Maxi und alle anderen bei der Suche nach einem Schlafplatz eine ungluckliche Wahl. Und dann gerat auch noch das Fruhstuck vollig auSSer Kontrolle: Griesbrei-Alarm mit krabbeligen Snacks. Zuruck im Camp wird es dann romantisch: Regel Nummer eins beim Liebesbriefe schreiben auf Norwegisch: Nicht gleich mit dem "rumpe" starten! Und die angekundigte Zimmerinspektion versetzt alle in Vollstress.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep / Shaun das Schaf
programme.desc: The farmer tries his hand at being a painter: the house and hill are quickly on the canvas, in contrast to the sheep. Every time he targets them, they have changed position. When the first sheep are finally painted, the white paint runs out. The farmer gets supplies, Bitzer takes over the artist's part and ruins the painting. Now it's up to Master Shaun: Together with the other sheep, he creates a picture in the style of great action painting artists. The farmer is shocked - but only until he gets a lot of money for the picture. / Der Farmer versucht sich als Maler: Haus und Hugel sind schnell auf der Leinwand, im Gegensatz zu den Schafen. Jedes Mal, wenn er sie ins Visier nimmt, haben sie ihre Position geandert. Als endlich die ersten Schafe gemalt sind, wird die weiSSe Farbe leer. Der Farmer holt Nachschub, Bitzer ubernimmt den Kunstlerpart und ruiniert das Gemalde. Jetzt muss Meister Shaun ran: Gemeinsam mit den anderen Schafen kreiert er ein Bild im Stil groSSer Action-Painting-Kunstler. Der Farmer ist schockiert - allerdings nur so lang, bis er fur das Bild eine Menge Geld bekommt.

programme.title: Pia and wild nature / Pia und die wilde Natur
programme.desc: In the Hainich National Park, Pia learns how dying beech trees are decomposed by many insects and other creatures and that a fungus plays an important role in this. She also tries, with the help of expert Thomas, to photograph a wild cat with a camera trap. Biologist Alisa shows Pia how insects cause the carcass of a large wild animal to almost disappear into thin air within 30 days. / Im Nationalpark Hainich lernt Pia, wie sterbende Buchen von ganz vielen Insekten und anderen Lebewesen zersetzt werden und dass dabei ein Pilz eine wichtige Rolle spielt. AuSSerdem versucht sie, unter Mithilfe von Experte Thomas, eine wilde Wildkatze mit einer Kamerafalle zu fotografieren. Biologin Alisa zeigt Pia, wie Insekten dafur sorgen, dass sich der Kadaver eines groSSen Wildtiers innerhalb von 30 Tagen fast in Luft auflost.

programme.title: Anna and the pets / Anna und die Haustiere
programme.desc: Every dog ​​should be able to follow the commands “sit”, “down” and “come”. But there is a lot more to learn at a dog school. Today Anna is spending a day with dog trainer Constanze and her four-legged students. Of course, the animal reporter is most looking forward to the lessons with the puppies. Playing and running around is also part of the curriculum. This is actually very important so that the little ones can learn to understand each other. But people and dogs also often need help when it comes to communication, especially when it comes to body language. Anna trains with puppies, young dogs and adult four-legged friends, and she quickly realizes that it's not just the dogs that have a lot to learn. For the owners too, it's practice, practice, practice... / Die Befehle "Sitz", "Platz" und "Komm" sollte jeder Hund befolgen konnen. In einer Hundeschule gibt es aber noch viel mehr zu lernen. Anna verbringt heute einen Tag bei Hundetrainerin Constanze und ihren vierbeinigen Schulern.Am meisten freut sich die Tierreporterin naturlich auf den Unterricht mit den Welpen. Spielen und Toben steht namlich auch auf dem Lehrplan. Das ist sogar sehr wichtig, damit sich die Kleinen untereinander verstehen lernen.Aber auch Mensch und Hund brauchen oft Nachhilfe in Sachen Verstandigung, vor allem, was die Korpersprache betrifft. Anna trainiert mit Welpen, Junghunden und erwachsenen Vierbeinern, und dabei merkt sie schnell, dass nicht nur die Hunde viel lernen mussen. Auch fur die Besitzer heiSSt es uben, uben, uben ...

programme.title: Checker Tobi / Checker Tobi
programme.desc: Laughing makes you happy! At least that's what they say. That's why Tobi today is all about laughter. Tobi figures out how to make an entire audience giggle. To do this he meets the clown Tonito. In the Munich pedestrian zone, Tobi starts a joke experiment with psychologist Laura: They translate Tobi's favorite joke into different languages ​​and ask passers-by from all over the world whether they find the joke funny. Finally, Tobi meets pediatrician and cabaret artist Omar in Vienna. He explains to Tobi what happens to the body when we laugh. / Lachen macht froh! Sagt man zumindest so. Deshalb dreht sich bei Tobi heute alles ums Thema Lachen. Tobi findet raus, wie man ein ganzes Publikum zum Kichern bringt. Dafur trifft er den Clown Tonito. In der Munchner FuSSgangerzone startet Tobi mit Psychologin Laura ein Witze-Experiment: Sie ubersetzen Tobis Lieblingswitz in verschiedene Sprachen und fragen Passanten aus der ganzen Welt, ob sie den Witz lustig finden. Zum Schluss trifft Tobi in Wien Kinderarzt und Kabarettist Omar. Er erklart Tobi, was beim Lachen im Korper passiert.

programme.title: Knowledge makes Ah! / Wissen macht Ah!
programme.desc: Clarissa and Tarkan are doing digital detox in nature today: no smartphones, no internet, no technology, but fishing on the lake - completely analogue. While the two of them talk about flounder, hagfish and catfish and clarify the question of whether fish actually drink, they miss their smartphones a little every now and then. And you can't take selfies either... At least there's enough time to answer the five questions in the show. Why do you always look like shit in photos? Why is this the case and can something be done about it? Tarkan knows what role your own reflection plays in this and what hacks you can use to get the perfect selfie in the end. Why do memes spread so quickly and what makes them so funny? Why do I spend so long on social media and what is a "rabbit hole"? Why do I constantly want to use my smartphone? How does voice control work? / Clarissa und Tarkan machen heute Digital Detox in der Natur: keine Smartphones, kein Internet, keine Technik, dafur Angeln auf dem See - ganz analog. Wahrend die beiden uber Flundern, Schleimaale und Welse sprechen und die Frage klaren, ob Fische eigentlich trinken, vermissen sie ihre Smartphones doch hin und wieder schon ein wenig. Und Selfies kann man auch nicht machen ... Immerhin bleibt genug Zeit fur Antworten auf die funf Fragen der Sendung.Warum sieht man auf Fotos immer kacke aus?GroSSe Nase und uberhaupt irgendwie kacke: Auf Selfies findet man sich oft gar nicht gut getroffen. Warum ist das so, und kann man etwas dagegen tun? Welche Rolle das eigene Spiegelbild dabei spielt und mit welchen Hacks man am Ende doch das perfekte Selfie hinbekommt, weiSS Tarkan.Warum verbreiten sich Memes so schnell und was macht sie so witzig?Warum hange ich so lang auf Social Media ab und was ist ein "Rabbit Hole"?Warum will ich standig das Smartphone in die Hand nehmen?Wie funktioniert Sprachsteuerung?

programme.title: nine and a half - for you right in the middle / neuneinhalb - fur dich mittendrin
programme.desc: nine and a half is your current show every Sunday on Kika and online. Why are there no strawberries in strawberry yogurt? Who protects us from terrorist attacks? How can I snowboard without destroying the Alps? Can I eat factory farmed chicken? In nine and a half minutes, your nine and a half reporters Malin, Johannes and Siham get to the heart of social and political issues and look for answers to your questions. Of course, this also applies to current events such as the nuclear accident in Fukushima or the shooting rampage in Winnenden. If something seems strange to you or you don't understand something, we'll find out for you what's going wrong and what you can do yourself to actively change something. Because you are the future and you help shape the world we live in. Be curious, open and active with us! Further information, games on the show's topics and much more - like a news school - can be found on the show's website at www.9halb.de. The current show is offered and streamed as a podcast. There is also a time-limited guestbook for each topic in which you can express your opinion on the topic or the program. / neuneinhalb ist jeden Sonntag deine aktuelle Sendung bei Kika und im Netz. Warum sind keine Erdbeeren im Erdbeerjogurt? Wer schutzt uns vor Terroranschlagen? Wie kann ich Snowboard fahren ohne die Alpen zu zerstoren? Darf ich Huhnchen aus Massentierhaltung essen? In neuneinhalb Minuten bringen deine neuneinhalb Reporter Malin, Johannes und Siham Themen aus Gesellschaft und Politik auf den Punkt und suchen Antworten auf deine Fragen. Das gilt naturlich auch bei aktuellen Ereignissen wie dem Atomunfall in Fukushima oder dem Amoklauf in Winnenden. Wenn dir etwas komisch vorkommt oder du etwas nicht verstehst, finden wir fur dich heraus was falsch lauft und was du selbst tun kannst um aktiv etwas zu andern. Denn du bist die Zukunft und gestaltest die Welt in der wir leben mit. Sei mit uns neugierig, offen und aktiv!Weitere Infos, Spiele zu den Sendungsthemen und noch viel mehr - wie eine Nachrichtenschule- gibt es auf den Internetseiten zur Sendung unter www.9einhalb.de. Die aktuelle Sendung wird als Podcast angeboten und gestreamt. Zudem gibt es zu jedem Thema ein zeitlich begrenztes Gastebuch, in dem du deine Meinung zum Thema oder zur Sendung auSSern kannst.

programme.title: The peppercorns / Die Pfefferkorner
programme.desc: Lisha distributes leaflets for the casting of new peppercorns. A girl dances at her. Eleven-year-old Nele warns her: Be careful, pickpocket! Lisha and Nele give chase and discover the Moro gang's meeting place. Their leader punishes Kira for the failed coup. Why does she put up with this? The two pass Kira at an opportune moment. Nele promises to help her. Kira refuses. So far no one has dared to leave the gang. / Lisha verteilt Flugblatter fur das Casting neuer Pfefferkorner. Dabei wird sie von einem Madchen angetanzt. Die elfjahrige Nele warnt sie: Vorsicht, Taschendiebin! Lisha und Nele nehmen die Verfolgung auf und entdecken den Treffpunkt der Moro-Gang. Ihr Leader bestraft Kira fur den misslungenen Coup. Warum lasst sie sich das gefallen? Die zwei passen Kira in einem gunstigen Moment ab. Nele verspricht, ihr zu helfen. Kira lehnt ab. Bisher hat sich noch keiner getraut, aus der Gang auszusteigen.

programme.title: The peppercorns / Die Pfefferkorner
programme.desc: Nele is kidnapped in front of the Elbphilharmonie together with the musical prodigy Kim Soo-Ri. Shortly afterwards they manage to escape, but the kidnappers remain on their heels. Levin promises his mother that he will find his sister. Kira, Tayo and Femi help him, but there is no trace. Until Levin suddenly discovers large quantities of candies on the street. They must come from Nele! A scavenger hunt through the harbor begins. But will the peppercorns find Nele and Kim before the kidnappers do? / Nele wird gemeinsam mit dem musikalischen Wunderkind Kim Soo-Ri vor der Elbphilharmonie entfuhrt. Kurz darauf gelingt ihnen die Flucht, aber die Entfuhrer bleiben ihnen auf den Fersen. Levin verspricht seiner Mutter, seine Schwester zu finden. Kira, Tayo und Femi helfen ihm, aber es fehlt jegliche Spur. Bis Levin plotzlich Bonbons in rauen Mengen auf der StraSSe entdeckt. Die mussen von Nele stammen! Eine Schnitzeljagd durch den Hafen beginnt. Aber werden die Pfefferkorner Nele und Kim finden, bevor die Entfuhrer es tun?
