programme.title: Football - Scottish League: Falkirk - Rangers / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Falkirk - Rangers
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship started its first season in 1890, and even then a rarity was established. The two teams then shared the championship title due to the same number of points at the end of the season. These were today's world-famous Glasgow Rangers, a team with more than 50 championship titles, and today's relatively unknown Dumbarton club. The league itself has changed names and format on a couple of occasions over the years, but since 2013 it is officially called the Scottish Professional Football League and is the highest level of Scottish football. The league is also marked by one of the biggest derbies in football history between two Glasgow teams, Celtic and Rangers. / Škotsko fudbalsko prvenstvo u svoju prvu sezonu su krenuli 1890. godine i već tada je postavljen jedan raritet. Dve ekipe su tada podelile šampionsku titulu zbog istog broja bodova na kraju sezone. To su bili danas svetski poznati Glazgov Rendžersi, ekipa sa više od 50 šampionskih titula i danas relativno nepoznati klub Dumbarton. Sama liga je kroz godine u par navrata menjala nazive i format, no od 2013. se službeno zove Scottish Professional Football League i najviši je rang škotskog fudbala. Ligu isto obeležava jedan od najvećih derbija u istoriji fudbala između dve glazgovske ekipe Seltika i Rendžersa.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: A show for all fans of this sport, who are fed up with industrial, high-budget football, for those who are fed up with tactics and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third tier of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one game from all four groups of the Serbian league, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting contributions. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos / Košarka - Euroleague: Efes - Panathinaikos
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Bejzbole - MLB: Los Angeles Dodgers - Millwaukee Brewers, Game 3 / Bejzbol - MLB: Los Angeles Dodgers - Milwaukee Brewers, Game 3
programme.desc: MLB or Major League Baseball is the highest level of baseball leagues in North America. The beginnings of the league date back to the end of the 19th century, more precisely in 1876, when the first season of the then National League was played. In 1903, the current structure was formed with the first edition of the World Series. The regular season lasts from April to August and each team plays 162 games. Out of a total of eight teams that win the playoffs, the best two play in the World Series finals. The winner is the first to reach four wins in the series. / MLB ili Major League Baseball je najviši rang bejzbolskih liga na području Severne Amerike. Početci lige datitraju već pred kraj 19. veka, tačnije 1876. kada je odigrana prva sezona tadašnje Nešnal lige. 1903. godine oformljena je današnja struktura sa prvim izdanjem World Seriesa. Regularna sezona traje od aprila do avgusta te svaka ekipa odigra 162 utakmice. Od ukupno osam ekipa koje izbore plejof dve najbolje igraju World Series finale. Pobednik je onaj ko prvi stigne do četiri pobede u seriji.

programme.title: Football - Polish League: Motor - GKS Katowice / Fudbal - Poljska liga: Motor - GKS Katowice
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league in Poland. The first football league of Poland was founded in 1927. This league is organized by the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league. The champion directly wins the title of Polish champion. The number of teams changed over the years, 18 participated in the 90s, and only 10 in the 30s. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu, osnovana je 1927. godine. Ovu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno, u ligi učestvuje 16 ekipa. Prvak direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona. Broj ekipa se sa godinama menjao, 90-ih učestvovalo ih je 18, a 30-ih samo 10.

programme.title: Fudbal - Championship: Middlesbrough - Ipswich / Fudbal - Championship: Middlesbrough - Ipswich
programme.desc: Somewhere beyond the multi-million dollar contracts and the glittering lights of media popularity lies the Championship, the English league it once was. Hard, fast, solid, modest, visited and most importantly, special. The second league of English football has 24 teams in the fight for the holy goal, entry into the Premiership. The specialty of the Championship is that, with an average attendance of about 15,000 people, it is the second most watched league in the world. For real football fans, it is a must stop for sports weekend entertainment. / Negde izvan multimilionskih ugovora i blještavih svetla medijske popularnosti smestio se Čempionšip, engleska liga kakva je nekada bila. Tvrda, brza, čvrsta, skromna, posećena i ono najvažnije, posebna. Druga liga engleskog fudbala broji 24 ekipa u borbi za svetim ciljem, ulaskom u Premieršip. Posebnost Čempionšipa je i u tome što je sa prosečnom posećenošću od oko 15000 ljudi najgledanija druga liga na svetu. Pravim ljubiteljima fudbala nezaobilazna je stanica sportske vikend razonode.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for the European Championship (w): Germany - North Macedonia / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP (ž): Nemačka - Severna Makedonija
programme.desc: Qualifications for the strongest women's continental handball competition will bring 15 out of 16 participants of this competition, given that the host has a guaranteed direct placement in the final. The qualifications themselves are divided into two phases. The first qualifying stage consists of two groups in which the winner of the group moves to the second stage. In the second and final stage of the qualification there are 28 teams divided into seven groups of four participants each. From each group, the two first-placed teams and one best-ranked team, the third of all groups, will advance to the European Championship. / Kvalifikacije za najjače žensko kontinentalno rukometno takmičenje će doneti 15 od 16 učesnika ovog takmičenja s obzirom na to da domaćin ima osiguran direktan plasman u završnicu. Same kvalifikacije su podeljene u dve faze. Prva kvalifikaciona faza se sastoji od dve grupe u kojoj pobednik grupe prelazi u drugu fazu. U drugoj i završnoj fazi kvalifikacija se nalazi 28 timova podeljenih u sedam grupa po četiri učesnika. Iz svake grupe na Evropsko prvenstvo će se plasirati dve prvoplasirane ekipe i jedna najbolje rangirana, treća od svih grupa.

programme.title: Youth sports games / Sportske igre mladih

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Monaco - Valencia / Košarka - Euroleague: Monaco - Valencia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Austrian League: Salzburg - Rapid / Fudbal - Austrijska liga: Salzburg - Rapid
programme.desc: The highest level of football competition in Austria is the Bundesliga. It was founded in 1974 and is one of the 10 best Austrian clubs. programme.desc: The 2. Bundesliga is regarded as one of the most popular non-top flight football competitions in its own country. Right next to the English Championship in viewership. The concept and format of the league changed over the years, as did the turbulent history of that country. The league became fully professional in the 1970s and was divided into several regions. The current form with a unique second division dates back to 1992. / 2. programme.title: Fudbal - Bundesliga: Werder Bremen - St.Pauli / Fudbal - Bundesliga: Werder Bremen - St.Pauli
programme.desc: Along with all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga also stands proudly. The highest rank of the football competition, founded in 1963, has 18 teams that start the race for the popular plate every August. It was won the most times by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The culture of cheering, full stands and top football is what adorns the Bundesliga from its beginnings, until today. Don't miss every possible opportunity to enjoy Bundesliga matches. You certainly won't regret it. / Uz sve ono što nam je Nemačka podarila kroz istoriju ponosno stoji i Bundesliga. Najviši rang fudbalskog takmičenja osnovanog 1963. godine broji 18 ekipa koje svakog avgusta kreću u trku za popularnim tanjirom. Najviše puta ga je osvajao minhenski Bajern, čak 24 puta. Kultura navijanja, pune tribine i vrhunski fudbal je ono što krasi Bundesligu od njenih početaka, pa sve do danas. Ne propustite svakom mogućom prilikom da uživate u bundesligaškim susretima. Sigurno nećete požaliti.

programme.title: Football - French league: Monaco - Nice / Fudbal - Francuska liga: Monaco - Nice
programme.desc: Ligue 1 is the first French professional football league with 20 teams fighting for the French championship title. It was founded in 1932 and is considered one of the most respected European leagues. The club with the most trophies with ten titles won is AS Saint Etienne, but the Greens have been waiting for a new title since long ago in 1981 and the time of the great Michel Platini. The matches of the French league are an unmissable event for every fan of this magnificent game. / Ligue 1 prva je francuska profesionalna fudbalska liga koja broji 20 ekipa u borbi za titulom prvaka Francuske. Osnovana je 1932. godine i smatra se jednom od najcenjenijih evropskih liga. Najtrofejniji klub s deset osvojenih titula je AS Sent Etjen ali Zeleni na novu titulu čekaju još od davne 1981. godine i vremena velikog Mišela Platinija. Susreti francuske lige nezaobilazan su događaj za svakog ljubitelja ove veličanstvene igre.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Onvo - Bahcesehir / Košarka - Turska liga: Onvo - Bahcesehir
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: ASVEL - Virtus Bologna / Košarka - Euroleague: ASVEL - Virtus Bologna
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Football - Dutch league: Ajax - Breda / Fudbal - Holandska liga: Ajax - Breda
programme.desc: The Eredivisie has 18 clubs and is the highest ranking competition in the Netherlands. It was founded in 1956. Throughout its history, it has often been unfairly overshadowed by more powerful financial and marketing competitions. The cradle of total football is the forerunner of the modern football game that we see today on the world's lawns. Season after season, the Dutch first league players delight with uncertain and efficient matches. With that, don't miss to watch the matches of the Dutch league and enjoy the championships. / Eredivisie broji 18 klubova te je najviši rang takmičenja u Holandiji. Osnovana je 1956. godine. Kroz svoju istoriju često je bila nepravedno u senci finansijskih i marketinški moćnijih takmičenja. Kolevka totalnog fudbala preteča je moderne fudbalske igre kakvu danas gledamo na svetskim travnjacima. Holandski prvoligaši iz sezone u sezonu oduševljavaju neizvesnim te efikasnim susretima. S toga ne propustite pogledati susrete holandske lige i uživati u majstorijama.

programme.title: Football - Europa League: Roma - Lille / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Roma - Lille
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation UEFE since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cities Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and was under that name until 2009, when it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the format of the competition has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. a group stage was introduced followed by eliminations. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the final of the Uefa Cup by the Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded every year to the winner who keeps it for a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Football - Champions League: Villarreal - Juventus / Fudbal - Liga šampiona: Villarreal - Juventus
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. Plasman u Ligu šampiona klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige šampiona postalo je televizijski najgledaniji fudbalski događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih titula prvaka Evrope ima madridski velikan Real.

programme.title: Football - UEFA League conference: Noah - Rijeka / Fudbal - UEFA Liga konferencija: Noah - Rijeka
programme.desc: From 2021, football fans enjoy the Conference League organized by UEFA. The idea for it appeared in 2015, and it involves lower-ranked national championship teams. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams enter the competition, which are divided into eight groups of four. 16 teams advance to the round of 16, then the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju u Ligi konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podeljene u dva dela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Zone of healthy sports / Zona zdravog sporta
programme.desc: Get to know outdoor sports and the people who play them. Za bavljenje ovim sportovima potrebna je dobra fizička sprema, ali često i ljubav prema prirodi.

programme.title: Basketball - KLS: Borac - Herzegovina / Košarka - KLS: Borac - Hercegovac
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest level of professional basketball in that country. The league itself was founded in 2006 and as such has 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the two-round point system, and in the matches each club is the host once and the guest once. It is interesting that the Serbian clubs that play in the regional ABA league do not participate in this part of the competition. After the first part, the four best clubs are placed in the Super League, in which only then are the clubs that played in the regional competition joined, and at that stage the champion of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Superleague depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but there are always 8 teams in that part of the competition. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: They love Serbia / Oni vole Srbiju
programme.desc: The number of players and coaches who found their happiness in Serbia is not small. They belong to different sports, and here they could see for themselves how true the stories about the famous Serbian hospitality are. Some of them found the love of their life here, found godfathers, friends for life, got citizenship. What is their attitude towards Serbia and what is their life like, find out in our show. / Broj igrača i trenera koji je svoju sreću pronašao u Srbiji nije mali. Oni pripadaju različitim granama sporta, a ovde su mogli da se uvere koliko su priče o čuvenom srpskom gostoprimstvu istinite. Neki od njih su ovde pronašli ljubav svog života, pronašli kumove, prijatelje za ceo život, dobili državljanstvo. Kakav je njihov odnos prema Srbiji i kakav je njihov život, saznajte u našoj emisiji.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league: Vienna - Mega / Košarka - ABA liga: Vienna - Mega
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian League: Napoli - Trieste / Košarka - Italijanska liga: Napoli - Trieste
programme.desc: The long history of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A dates back to 1920 and its collapse. The first winner was the team from Kostana in the same year, 1920. This league is of great importance for European club basketball as a league that has given over 35 titles to its clubs in European competitions, starting with the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saporta Cup and the Radivoje Korac Cup. The competition itself consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents in a round robin, followed by an eight-team playoff. Elimination matches are played on four won matches out of seven or in English terminology Best of seven. / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske Lega Basket Serie A datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija Best of seven.

programme.title: Basketball - German league: Bayern - Bamberg / Košarka - Nemačka liga: Bayern - Bamberg
programme.desc: The history of German club basketball dates back to 1939, but the German Basketball Bundesliga was founded in 1964, while the competition itself started two years later. The competition consists of 18 teams, and the season is divided into a regular part in which everyone plays each other in a double round and a playoff part that starts after the regular part is over. The last two teams of the regular season are relegated, while in the playoffs the winner is awarded the Best of five format, where teams must win at least 3 games out of 5 in order to eliminate the rival. The interesting thing about the league is that each team must have a hall with a minimum of 3,000 seats for the audience. / Istorija nemačke klupske košarke datira još iz 1939. godine, no Nemačka košarkaška Bundesliga osnovana je 1964. godine dok samo takmičenje je krenulo dve godine kasnije. Takmičenje se sastoji od 18 timova, a sezona je podeljena na regularni deo u kojem svako igra sa svakim dvokružno i plejof deo koji stupa nakon završenog regularnog dela. Poslednje dve ekipe regularnog dela ispadaju u niži rang, dok se u plejofu pobednik dobija Best of five formatu gdje ekipe moraju dobiti minmalno 3 utakmice od 5 kako bi izbacili rivala. Zanimljivost lige je da svaka ekipa mora imati dvoranu od minimalno 3000 mesta za publiku.

programme.title: Basketball - Turkish League: Manisa - Erokspor / Košarka - Turska liga: Manisa - Erokspor
programme.desc: The very beginnings of Turkish basketball go back far before the founding of the league in 1966. As early as the beginning of the 20th century, hooping was known in Turkey. Students from Robert College in Istanbul discovered the magic of this team sport for the first time in 1904. A year after the founding of the league, the first official competition of the best Turkish basketball clubs began. Three years later, the second league was launched. Today's competition system consists of sixteen teams that play each other twice in the regular season, followed by a playoff for the eight best teams. The two lowest placed teams are eliminated from the first league. / Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Bayern / Košarka - Euroleague: Fenerbahce - Bayern
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos. / Euroliga je takmičenje koje je svoj put u svet evropske košarke započelo pod nazivom Kup evropskih prvaka davne 1958. godine, a prvi trofej je osvojila ekipa ASK Rige iz tadašnjeg SSSR-a odnosno današnje Letonije. FIBA je vodila glavnu reč u ovom takmičenju sve do 2000. godine kada su klubovi preuzeli kontrolu nad takmičenjem preko svog udruženja Eurolegaue Basketball. Format takmičenja se kroz istoriju menjao te je sadržavao deo po grupama nakon kojeg su usledile eliminacije u plejofu. Pobednik ovog takmičenja se odlučuje na završnom turniru koji se naziva Final Four. Najuspešniji klubovi ovog takmičenja su Real Madrid, CSKA Moskva, Makabi Tel-Aviv, Panatinajkos, Vareze, Olimpijakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: London Lions - Trento / Košarka - Eurocup: London Lions - Trento
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 of the strongest European leagues participate in it. Placement in the Eurocup is secured through national championships and cups, and through invitations to the so-called wildcards. / Evrokup je nastao 2002. godine kao drugo takmičenje Evroleague Basketball. U ovom takmičenju se bore najjači košarkaški klubovi koji ne uspeju izboriti plasman u Evroligu, te u njemu sudeluju uglavnom klubovi iz top 15 najjačih evropskih liga. Plasman u Evrokup se osigurava kroz nacionalna prvenstva i kupove, te kroz pozivnice tzv. vajldkards.

programme.title: Basketball rules / Košarkaška pravila
programme.desc: Legendary basketball player and new coach of Crvena zvezda Saša Obradović. Gosti emisije biće rukometaši, treneri i stručnjaci koji će svojim komentarima gledaocima dati širu sliku o trenutnom odnosu snaga i budućnosti ovog sporta.

programme.title: Basketball - FIBA ​​Champions League: Benfica - Spartak / Košarka - FIBA Liga šampiona: Benfica - Spartak
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fibina Basketball Champions League. The goal of this league is to compete with the organization Euroleague Basketball S.L. and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, a regular part, a playoff and a final tournament of the best four, or popularly known as the Fayball Four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina Basketball Champions League. Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji Euroleague Basketball S.L. i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajbal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Oviedo - Espanyol / Fudbal - Španska liga: Oviedo - Espanyol
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspešnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Volleyball - League of Nations (W): Italy - Brazil, final / Odbojka - Liga nacija (Ž): Italija - Brazil, finale
programme.desc: The FIVB Women's Volleyball Nations League is a newly established national team competition. The competition is divided into two phases, the league phase and the final phase. 16 national teams enter the league stage, and in a total of 120 games of the league part, they are hunting for one of the first five positions that lead to the final stage of the competition. The five best national teams join the host and are divided into two groups with three teams each. The two best teams from each group advance to the semi-finals where they fight for the grand final. / FIVB ženska odbojkaška Liga nacija novoosnovano je takmičenje reprezentacija. Takmičenje je podeljeno u dve faze, ligašku fazu i finalnu fazu. U ligašku fazu ulazi 16 reprezentacija koje u ukupno 120 utakmica ligaškog dela love jednu od prvih pet pozicija koje vode u finalnu fazu takmičenja. Pet najboljih reprezentacija pridružuju se domaćinu te se dele u dve grupe sa po tri ekipe. Po dve najbolje reprezentacije iz svake grupe se plasiraju u polufinale gde se bore za veliko finale.

Get to know sportsmen and women who are already achieving exceptional results in junior competitions. / Predstavljamo vam uspešne mlade ljude koji predstavljaju budućnost sporta u Srbiji. Upoznajte sportistkinje i sportiste koji već u juniorskim takmičenjima ostvaruju izuzetne rezultate.

programme.title: Athletics - Tour Gold: Villa de Madrid / Atletika - Tour Gold: Villa de Madrid
programme.desc: Follow the athletics competition held in Madrid as part of the gold category of the World Indoor Tour. / Pratite atletsko takmičenje koje se održava u Madridu u sklopu zlatne kategorije Svetske dvoranske turneje.

programme.title: Handball - Qualification for the European Championship: Germany - North Macedonia / Rukomet - Kvalifikacije za EP: Nemačka - Severna Makedonija
programme.desc: Qualification for the European Handball Championship for Men is a handball competition organized by the European Handball Federation (EHF) to determine 20 of the 24 men's national teams that compete in the final tournament of the European Handball Championship. / Kvalifikacije za Evropsko prvenstvo u rukometu za muškarce, je rukometno takmičenje koje je organizuje Evropska rukometna federacija (EHF) radi utvrđivanja 20 od 24 muške reprezentacije, koje se takmiče na završnom turniru Evropskog prvenstva za rukometaše .

programme.title: Odbojka - CEV šampiona League: Jastrzebski - Zawiercie, semi-final / Odbojka - CEV Liga šampiona: Jastrzebski - Zawiercie, polufinale
programme.desc: We got the first winner of this competition in 1960, after the CSKA Moscow team defeated the Rapida team from Bucharest. The Russian team is also the most successful in the Champions League and the only one with a double-digit number of titles, even though all its titles date back to the USSR era. The club itself was disbanded in 2009, even though they have won 13 European championship titles. From 1959 to 2000, the name of the league was the European Champions Cup, after which it was changed to the current name. The French club Paris Volley was the first champion under the new name of the competition in 2001. / Prvog pobednika ovog takmičenja smo dobili 1960. godine nakon što je ekipa CSKA Moskve pobedila ekipu Rapida iz Bukurešta. Ruska ekipa je ujedno i najuspešnija u Ligi šampiona te jedina koja ima dvocifreni broj titula iako sve njene titule datiraju iz doba SSSRa. Sami klub je rasformiran 2009. godine iako imaju čak 13 titula prvaka Evrope. Naziv lige je od 1959. do 2000. godine bio Evropski Kup Prvaka nakon čega je sledila izmena u današnji naziv. Francuski klub Pariz Volej je bio prvi prvak pod novim nazivom takmičenja 2001. godine.

programme.title: Volleyball - Turkish league (m): Ziraat - Galatasaray, final G1 / Odbojka - Turska liga (m): Ziraat - Galatasaray, finale G1
programme.desc: The First Turkish Volleyball League or Efeler League is the highest level of Turkish club volleyball competition. It was founded in 1970 under the authority of the Turkish Volleyball Federation and in its current format, the league contains 12 clubs. The Turkish league is considered one of the best leagues in Europe, whose clubs achieve great success in continental competitions. Historically, the most successful club is Eçasibaşı with 12 championship titles of Turkey, while they are followed by Halkbank with eight titles. / Prva turska odbojkaška liga ili Efeler liga je najviši rang takmičenja turske klupske odbojke. Osnovana je 1970. godine pod ingerencijom Turskog odbojkaškog saveza i u današnjem formatu liga sadrži 12 klubova. Turska liga smatra se jednom od najboljih liga Evrope čiji klubovi ostvaruju velike uspehe na kontinentalnim takmičenjima. Istorijsko najuspešniji klub je Ečasibaši sa 12 osvojenih titula prvaka Turske dok ih u stopu prati Halkbank sa osam titula.

programme.title: Handball - EHF Champions League: Zagreb - GOG / Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Zagreb - GOG
programme.desc: Handball Champions League has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to the change of name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition, followed by eliminations, has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga šampiona svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu šampiiona uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama menjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Handball: Bundesliga - Never stop / Rukomet: Bundesliga - Never stop
programme.desc: In the last few years, the popularity of handball in Germany has been continuously growing. This show is dedicated to professionals who managed to realize their boyhood dreams and achieve great success on the handball court. Thanks to interviews, archival footage and photos, viewers have the opportunity to find out what all the challenges faced by handball players who are now cheered on by fans from all over the world! / Poslednjih nekoliko godina, popularnost rukometa u Nemačkoj kontinuirano raste. Ova emisija posvećena je profesionalcima koji su uspeli da ostvare dečačke snove i postignu velike uspehe na rukometnom terenu. Zahvaljujući intervjuima, arhivskim snimcima i fotografijama, gledaoci imaju priliku da saznaju sa kojim su se sve izazovima suočavali rukometaši koje sada bodre navijači iz celog sveta!

programme.title: Handball - EHF Champions League: Sporting - Veszprem / Rukomet - EHF Liga šampiona: Sporting - Veszprem
programme.desc: Handball Champions League has its beginnings since 1955, when the competition was founded under the name Champions Cup. We got our first winner in the 1956-1957 season. year, and that was the team from Prague, because in that season only the city's selections performed. Today that club is called Dukla Prague. Until 1993, the competition was held under that name and was played according to the knockout cup system. Since 1993, in addition to the change of name to the Champions League, a group stage of the competition, followed by eliminations, has been introduced. The group stage has changed over the years, and the Final Four was introduced for the four best handball teams in Europe, after which the champion is awarded. / Rukometna Liga šampiona svoje začetke ima još od 1955. godine kada je takmičenje osnovano pod nazivom Kup Prvaka. Prvog pobednika smo dobili u sezoni 1956.-1957. godine, a to je bila ekipa Praga jer u toj sezoni su nastupale samo gradske selekcije. Danas se taj klub zove Dukla Prag. Sve do 1993. godine takmičenje se održalo pod tim nazivom i igralo se po kup sistemu na ispadanje. Od 1993. godine osim promene naziva u Ligu šampiiona uvedena je i grupna faza takmičenja nakon koje slede eliminacije. Grupna faza se sa godinama menjala te je uveden i Fajnal for za četiri najbolje rukometne ekipe Evrope nakon koje se dobija prvak.

programme.title: Volleyball: Russian league (w): Dinamo-Ak Bars - Korabelka / Odbojka: Ruska liga (ž): Dinamo-Ak Bars - Korabelka

programme.title: Volleyball - Italian league (M): Lube Cvitanova - Trentino, G4 final / Odbojka - Italijanska liga (M): Lube Cvitanova - Trentino, finale G4
programme.desc: During the 80s of the last century, Italian men's volleyball reached world-wide popularity. Investments in volleyball are getting bigger and big multinational companies, thanks to their investments in Italian clubs, are pushing the Italian Serie A among the strongest world volleyball leagues. Series A was called the volleyball NBA, which was contributed by numerous world-famous volleyball players who played in Italian clubs. At the same time, Italian clubs dominated European competitions in that period. / Tokom 80ih godina prošlog veka italijanska muška odbojka dostiže popularnost svetskih razmera. Ulaganja u odbojku postaju sve veća i velike multinacionalne kompanije zahvaljujući ulaganjima u italijanske klubove guraju italijansku Seriju A među najjače svetske odbojkaške lige. Serija A se nazvala odbojkaški NBA čemu si doprineli brojni svjetski poznati odbojkaši koji su igrali u italijanskim klubovima. Ujedno italijanski klubovi su dominirali Evropskim takmičenjima u tom periodu.

programme.title: Football - Danish league: Silkeborg - Copenhagen / Fudbal - Danska liga: Silkeborg - Copenhagen
programme.desc: The Danish football league and its strongest Danish football ranking is known as the Superliga and was founded in 1991. programme.desc: The Russian Football League, as the successor of the Soviet Union, records its competitive beginnings in 1936, although football has been played on the territory of the Union since the 1900s. Liga se sve do sezone 2012./2013. igrala u terminu proleće - jesen zbog dugačke zime te se od tada igra klasično evropski jesen - proleće. Velika finansijska ulaganja u ruske fudbalske klubove jako su približili ligu na Uefinoj lestvici koeficijenata prvih liga po snazi u Evropi.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league: Zenit - CSKA / Košarka - VTB liga: Zenit - CSKA
programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Severne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Belorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Sport Brothers League / Sport Brothers League

programme.title: Youth sports games / Sportske igre mladih
programme.desc: The youth sports games are the biggest event for children and youth in this region, whose main goal is to promote a healthy lifestyle and friendship. We enable young people to participate completely free of charge in competitions in ten sports disciplines (soccer, beach volleyball, street basketball, handball, volleyball, game between two fires, table tennis, tennis, athletics and chess). / Sportske igre mladih najveća su manifestacija za decu i omladinu na ovim prostorima, čiji je osnovni cilj promocija zdravog načina života i prijateljstva. Pod sloganom Živimo život bez droge, jer droga uzima život, osnovcima u Srbiji omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima, u deset sportskih disciplina i najuspešniji pojedinci i ekipe putuju na besplatno mini letovanje kao učesnici VELIKOG MEĐUNARODNOG FINALA Igara u Splitu. Mladima godinama omogućavamo potpuno besplatno učestvovanje u takmičenjima u deset sportskih disciplina, (mali fudbal, odbojka na pesku, ulični basket, rukomet, odbojka, igra između dve vatre, stoni tenis, tenis, atletika i šah).

programme.title: Hockey - KHL: Traktor - Avangard / Hokej - KHL: Traktor - Avangard
programme.desc: The strongest hockey competition in Europe and Asia is called the KHL or Continental Hockey League. The competition itself originated from the Russian Super League in 2008, and since then the competition has spread to more and more European and Asian countries, becoming unofficially the second best hockey league in the world after the American-Canadian NHL. At the end of the season, the winner of the KHL playoffs receives the prestigious Gagarin Cup, while the best placed Russian team wins the title of champion of Russia. Since 2011, in addition to clubs from the former USSR, clubs from Central Europe have entered the league, while since 2016, a Chinese representative has entered for the first time. / Najjače hokejaško takmičenje u hokeju na području Evrope i Azije zove se KHL ili Kontinentalna Hokejaška Liga. Samo takmičenje je nastalo iz ruske Superlige 2008. godine i od tada se takmičenje širi na sve više evropskih i azijskih zemalja i tako postaje neslužbeno druga najbolja hokejaška liga sveta nakon američko-kanadskog NHLa. Na kraju sezone pobednik KHL plejofa dobija prestižni Gagarin Kup, dok najbolje plasirana Ruska ekipa osvaja titulu šampiona Rusije. Od 2011. ligu osim klubova iz bivšeg SSSR-a ulaze klubovi iz centralne Evrope, dok od 2016. po prvi put ulazi i jedan Kineski predstavnik.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League: Borac - Dubai / Košarka - ABA liga: Borac - Dubai
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name on several occasions depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is the Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi deo takmičenja odnosno plejof se razlikuje od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Miner - Fighter / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Rudar - Borac
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games each, against each other, one on the home field and one on the away field, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differs from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je menjala i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League. Takmičenje se igra u dva dela, prvi deo se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dve utakmice, svako, sa svakim, jednu na domaćem terenu i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. programme.title: Water polo - Regional league: Radnički - Jadran / Vaterpolo - Regionalna liga: Radnički - Jadran
programme.desc: The Adriatic Water Polo League or the sponsor name Triglav Regional League is a regional water polo competition in which Montenegrin, Croatian, Slovenian clubs compete, later also Italian and Serbian clubs. The first season, which began on September 26, 2008, gathered 12 clubs, 8 from Croatia, 3 from Montenegro and 1 from Slovenia. The year of establishment is taken as the same year 2008, when the decision was made in Dubrovnik at the qualifying tournament for the European Championship. After the first season, Italian representatives also joined the league, who soon gave up, while since 2014, the league has also included clubs from Serbia. / Jadranska vaterpolo liga ili sponzorski naziv Triglav regionalna liga je regionalno vaterpolo takmičenje u kojoj se od jeseni 2008. godine takmiče crnogorski, hrvatski, slovenački klubovi, kasnije i talijanski te srpski klubovi. Prva sezona, koja je počela 26. septembra 2008., okupljala je 12 klubova, 8 iz Hrvatske, 3 iz Crne Gore i 1 iz Slovenije. Za godinu osnutka se uzima ista ta 2008. godina kada je odluka donešena u Dubrovniku na kvalifikacionom turniru za Evropsko prvenstvo. Nakon prve sezone ligi su se priključili i italijanski predstavnici koji si ubrzo odustali, dok od 2014. godine liga broji i klubove iz Srbije.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA 2nd league: Podgorica - Borac Banja Luka / Košarka - ABA 2. liga: Podgorica - Borac Banja Luka
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: They live for football / Oni žive za fudbal
programme.desc: A show for all fans of this sport, who are fed up with industrial, high-budget football, for those who are fed up with tactics and games without goals. The show will follow the matches played in the third tier of the football competition in Serbia. Every week we will present one game from all four groups of the Serbian league, we will hear interesting interviews and see interesting contributions. / Emisija za sve ljubitelje ovog sporta, koji su se zasitili industrijskog, visokobudžetnog fudbala, za one kojima je dosta taktiziranja i utakmica bez golova. Emisija će pratiti utakmice koje se igraju u trećem rangu fudbalskog takmičenja u Srbiji. Svake nedelje predstavićemo po jednu utakmicu iz sve četiri grupe srpske lige, čućemo zanimljive intervjue i videti interesantne priloge.

programme.title: Football: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Velež - Sloga
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking football competition in Bosnia and Herzegovina. With the entry of clubs from Republika Srpska two years later, the league got a format with 16 clubs in a two-round competition system. Today, 12 teams compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and the Survival League. The first historical champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The biggest European success was the placement of Železničar in the semi-finals of the UEFA Cup in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.desc: Time for the playoffs! The season is approaching its peak - and SPORT1 is right next to it. The best eight teams from the regular season fight for the championship title in the playoffs. The reigning German champions, Schweriner SC, are once again among the favourites, as are DVV-Cup winners Dresdner SC, who proved their mettle last season. Who will retain the advantage at the end of the season and reach for the crown? The most popular women's league in German sports is precisely volleyball, whose beginnings date back to the 1976/77 season. 11 teams compete in it, of which the last-placed team is relegated to the lower league, while the top eight teams qualify for the playoffs. / Čas za končnico! Sezona se približuje svojemu vrhuncu - in SPORT1 je pri tem od blizu zraven. Najboljših osem ekip iz rednega dela se v končnici bori za naslov prvaka. Aktualni nemški prvak, Schweriner SC, je znova med favoriti, prav tako zmagovalec DVV-pokala Dresdner SC, ki je v pretekli sezoni dokazal svojo moč. Kdo bo v zaključku sezone obdržal prednost in posegel po kroni?Najpopularnejša ženska liga v nemškem športu je ravno odbojkarska, katere začetki segajo v sezono 1976/77. V njej se pomeri 11 ekip, od katerih zadnjeuvrščena pade v nižjo ligo, prvih osem pa se uvrsti v končnico.

programme.desc: A month ago, Switzerland taught the Slovenian national football team a real lesson, will anything be different in Stožice? programme.title: Environments, pon. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambienti; V bližini Olimja se s čudovitim razgledom ponašajo lične lesene hiške, ki se s svojo zasnovo navezujejo na kozjansko tradicijo. Njihova končna podoba je zasluga srčnih lastnikov z veliko občutka za estetiko.
programme.desc: Burnt wood on facades is returning to architecture as an aesthetic and sustainable solution - especially because it offers natural protection without chemicals, while at the same time creating a rustic and elegant look. Especially in Gorenjska, farmers used to deliberately burn wooden buildings to protect them from the weather and pests. When renovating the boathouse on the western edge of Lake Bled, the architects followed the materiality of the riverside buildings in this part of Slovenia. In the charming village above Litija, we visited the Green Paradise, which impresses with more than 2,000 varieties of plants from all over the world. It is spread over one and a half hectares of carefully paved steep terrain, where you can enjoy an informative walk among magnificent trees and shrubs and a stunning view of the surrounding hills. / Žgani les na fasadah se vrača v arhitekturo kot estetska in trajnostna rešitev – še posebej , ker ponuja naravno zaščito brez kemikalij, hkrati pa ustvarja rustikalen in eleganten videz. Predvsem na Gorenjskem, so kmetje nekoč lesene objekte namerno ožgali, da bi jih zaščitili pred vremenskimi vplivi in škodljivci. Arhitekti so pri prenovi čolnarne na zahodnem robu Blejskega jezera sledili materialnosti obrežnih objektov v tem delu Slovenije. V očarljivi vasici nad Litijo smo obiskali Zeleni raj, ki navdušuje z več kot 2000 sortami rastlin z vsega sveta. Razprostira se na poldrugem hektarju skrbno utrjenega strmega terena, kjer vas čaka poučen sprehod med veličastnimi drevesi in grmovnicami ter osupljiv razgled na okoliške hribe.

programme.title: Automobility: Transportation at the call or click / Avtomobilnost: Prevoz na klic oziroma klik
programme.sub-title: Objavili bomo zgodbo o novi ureditvi javnega prevoza v občini Radlje ob Dravi. Tam so namreč šolske prevoze nadomestili z električnimi Toyotinimi kombiji. Uporabljajo jih tudi za prevoze med zaselki in še za -taksi” prevoze, ki jih občani naročijo preko
programme.desc: In more than a hundred Slovenian municipalities, they have Prostoferje - volunteers who drive the elderly to the doctor, to the store or to run other errands. We hung out with the "freelancers" at the AMZS training ground in Vransko, where they had driving training. We filmed the show in Ptuj, where they installed a traffic sign equipped with radar. It stands at one of the busiest traffic spots. You will also hear a conversation with an Audi engineer about the suspension of the new Q3 SUV and a discussion about the Ford van with an asymmetrical design. / V več kot sto slovenskih občinah imajo Prostoferje - prostovoljce, ki starejše vozijo k zdravniku, v trgovino ali po drugih opravkih. S »prostoferji« smo se družili na poligonu AMZS-ja na Vranskem, kjer so imeli vozniško izobraževanje.Oddajo smo posneli na Ptuju, kjer so postavili z radarjem opremljeni prometni znak. Stoji na eni od prometno bolj obremenjenih točk.Slišali boste tudi pogovor z Audijevim inženirjem o vzmetenju novega SUV-ja, znamke Q3 in diskusijo o Fordovem kombiju z asimetrično obliko.

programme.title: A trail of millennia: Heritage of the State Museum in Ljubljana, documentary film, Mon. / Sled tisočletij: Dediščina Deželnega muzeja v Ljubljani, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Amir Muratović... Narodni muzej Slovenije je najstarejša neprekinjeno delujoča muzejska ustanova na Slovenskem. V 200 letih je shranil skoraj 100.000 let zgodovine.
programme.desc: The jubilee exhibition Zlata sled will guide visitors through the history and present of the museum. The film follows the preparation of the layout concept, the care of the restorers and conservators for the objects, the installation of the exhibition and its final appearance. When the then State Museum was founded, they turned to patriotic friends of science. The first collections were donated to the museum by counts Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, the mayor of Hradecki and bishops Wolf and Baraga. The first exhibition spaces in the lyceum were too small, and they started building a new museum building. In honor of the wedding of Crown Prince Rudolf, it was named Rudolfinum. Local artists and craftsmen participated in the plans and interior fittings, the authors of the paintings in the entrance hall and on the staircase are Janez and Jurij Šubic. The management of the museum has always been aware that it is a national museum that preserves the heritage of thousands of years. The original museum was later divided into several institutions. First, the Ethnographic Museum became independent, then the Museum of Natural History, which still has premises in the same building, and after the Second World War, the current Archives of the Republic of Slovenia became independent. The National Gallery received many works of art from the National Museum. The film highlights the most important museum items, such as the Neanderthal flute, the Koliščar finds, the jewelry of the Princess of Stis, the situla from Vača, the mummy, the statue of Emonc, Roman swords from Ljubljanica, the first photographs on glass, Prešeren's legacy. The author was interested in the stories of the objects, what they were used for, why they are important and, above all, whether they are placed in a different time than when the museum acquired them through new museum knowledge. In this way, the film also presents the valuable scientific work of curators, restorers and all others who take care of the preservation and protection of museum objects. The screenwriter and director of the film is Amir Muratović, director of photography and cinematographer Bernard Perme, editor Zlatjan Čučkov, author and music performer Boštjan Gombač. / Skozi zgodovino in sedanjost muzeja bo obiskovalce vodila jubilejna razstava Zlata sled. Film spremlja pripravljanje koncepta postavitve, skrb restavratorjev in konservatorjev za predmete, postavljanje razstave in njeno končno podobo. Ob ustanovitvi takratnega Deželnega muzeja so se obrnili na domoljubne prijatelje znanosti. Prve zbirke so muzeju podarili grofje Zois, Hohenwart, Hladnik, Erberg, Repežič, župan Hradecki ter škofa Wolf in Baraga. Prvi razstavni prostori v liceju so bili premajhni in lotili so se gradnje nove muzejske stavbe. V čast poroke prestolonaslednika Rudolfa so jo poimenovali Rudolfinum. Pri načrtih in notranji opremi so sodelovali domači umetniki in mojstri, avtorja poslikav v vhodni dvorani in na stopnišču sta Janez in Jurij Šubic. Vodstva muzeja so se v vseh obdobjih zavedala, da gre za nacionalni muzej, ki ohranja dediščino tisočletij.Prvotni muzej se je pozneje razdelil na več institucij. Najprej se je osamosvojil Etnografski muzej, nato Prirodoslovni muzej, ki ima še danes prostore v isti stavbi, po drugi vojni pa se je izdvojil še današnji Arhiv Republike Slovenije. Narodna galerija je veliko umetnin dobila iz Narodnega muzeja.Film izpostavlja najpomembnejše muzealije, kot so neandertalska piščal, koliščarske najdbe, nakit stiške kneginje, situla iz Vač, mumija, kip Emonca, rimski meči iz Ljubljanice, prve fotografije na steklu, Prešernova zapuščina. Avtorja so zanimale zgodbe predmetov, čemu so služili, zakaj so pomembni in predvsem, ali so skozi nova muzealska spoznanja umeščeni v času drugače, kot takrat, ko jih je muzej pridobil. Na ta način je v filmu predstavljeno tudi dragoceno znanstveno delo kustosov, restavratorjev in vseh drugih, ki skrbijo za ohranitev in varovanje muzejskih predmetov.Scenarist in režiser filma je Amir Muratović, direktor fotografije in snemalec Bernard Perme, montažer Zlatjan Čučkov, avtor in izvajalec glasbe Boštjan Gombač.

In 2014, the creators of the show received one of the most prestigious Slovenian media awards: the professional winner for the best entertainment TV show. / Oddaja Dobro jutro uvaja sodobne televizijske formate s poudarkom na kakovostnih vsebinah in je upoštevajoč delež televizijskih gledalcev med najbolje gledanimi oddajami nacionalne televizije. programme.title: On to the beautiful: Horse tourism, Mon. / Na lepše: Konjski turizem, pon.
programme.desc: Holidays on horseback are one of the more authentic ways to get to know the microlocations of individual regions from a completely different perspective. Equestrianism and riding have a centuries-old tradition in Slovenia, and sometimes the horse was at home as a member of the family, as it helped with farm chores, was a basic means of transport and also communication between remote and hard-to-reach villages. Today, in the light of tourism, it seems that off-road riding can be a good way of soft tourism, to keep guests in transit destinations that are not part of the tourist backbone not only for one night, but also for a whole week. In the show, more about the Pula Dolenj estate, horse trails in the Green Karst area, and the recently opened Museum of Trucking and Transportation in Senožeče. / Počitnice na konjskem hrbtu so eden bolj pristnih načinov, kako s čisto drugačne perspektive spoznavati mikrolokacije posameznih regij. Konjeništvo in jahanje imata v Sloveniji večstoletno tradicijo in včasih je bil konj pri hiši kot član družine, saj je pomagal pri kmečkih opravilih, bil osnovno prevozno sredstvo ter tudi komunikacija med oddaljenimi in težko dostopnimi vasmi. Danes pa se v luči turizma zdi, da je terensko jahanje lahko dober način mehkega turizma, kako goste v tranzitnih destinacijah, ki niso del turistične hrbtenice, zadržati ne samo eno noč, ampak tudi po cel teden. V oddaji več o dolenjskem posestvu Pule, konjskih poteh na območju Zelenega krasa ter o še sveže odprtem Muzeju tovorništva in prevozništva v Senožečah.

programme.title: Our Inattentive, Hyperactive Mind, UK Documentary, Mon. / Naš nepozorni, hiperaktivni um, britanska dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ocenjujejo, da je kar sedmina ljudi nevrorazličnih – njihovi možgani preprosto delujejo drugače kot pri večini. Vendar pogosto naletijo na nerazumevanje bližnjih, zato se številni spoprijemajo z depresijo, tesnobo in celo samomorilnimi mislimi. Televizi
programme.desc: Henry, a young tour guide who was diagnosed with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder in high school, does not get in the way of his work. His energy and imagination even help him. It's different when he has to plan his daily errands. With these, he is often completely lost and fears that he is a disgrace to those close to him. 51-year-old Jo was diagnosed with this disorder only in menopause and now regrets that she did not find out about it earlier. Now she knows why she changed as many as 14 jobs and could never settle down. The show shows how two people with attention deficit disorder prepare a short film to explain to their loved ones how their hyperactive mind works. INSIDE OUR MINDS, ADHD / Great Britain / 2025 / Director: Joe Myerscough. / Mladega turističnega vodnika Henryja, pri katerem so v srednji šoli odkrili motnjo pozornosti s hiperaktivnostjo, njegova drugačnost ne ovira pri delu. Energičnost in domiselnost mu celo pomagata. Drugače je, ko mora načrtovati vsakodnevne opravke. Pri teh je pogosto povsem izgubljen in boji se, da je bližnjim v sramoto. 51-letni Jo pa so diagnozo te motnje postavili šele v menopavzi in zdaj obžaluje, da zanjo ni izvedela že prej. Zdaj ve, zakaj je zamenjala kar 14 zaposlitev in se ni mogla nikoli ustaliti. Oddaja prikazuje, kako obe osebi z motnjo pozornosti pripravita kratek film, s katerim svojim bližnjim razložita, kako deluje njun hiperaktivni um. INSIDE OUR MINDS, ADHD / Velika Britanija / 2025 / Režija: Joe Myerscough.

programme.title: Let's Listen to the Silence: New Hope for Dementia, Mon. / Prisluhnimo tišini: Novo upanje za demenco, pon.
programme.desc: For the first time in history, drugs are available that can slow down the course of dementia. The European Commission has so far approved two, the first, lekanemab, and we expect it in Slovenia this year as well. It will be intended for people in the early stages of the disease with mild cognitive impairment. But despite new treatment options, experts emphasize that prevention is the most important. But when the disease flares up, support for people with dementia and their loved ones is crucial. Learn more about dementia, its development and ways of dealing with it in the show Listen to the silence, which will be broadcast on October 15, 2025 at 3:40 p.m. on the first program of Television Slovenia. / Prvič v zgodovini so na voljo zdravila, ki lahko upočasnijo potek demence. Evropska komisija je doslej odobrila že dve, prvo, lekanemab, letos pričakujemo tudi v Sloveniji. Namenjeno bo osebam v zgodnji fazi bolezni z blagimi kognitivnimi motnjami. A kljub novim možnostim zdravljenja strokovnjaki poudarjajo, da je najpomembnejša preventiva. Ko pa bolezen izbruhne, je ključna podpora osebam z demenco in njihovim bližnjim. Več o demenci, njenem razvoju in načinih spoprijemanja z njo v oddaji Prisluhnimo tišini, ki bo na sporedu 15. 10. 2025 ob 15.40 na prvem programu Televizije Slovenija.

programme.title: Horizons of the Spirit: Why is life a gift?, Mon. / Obzorja duha: Zakaj je življenje dar?, pon.
programme.sub-title: Danes se zaključuje 34. teden za življenje, ki z naslovom Moški + ženska = izvorni načrt opozarja na svetost življenja.
programme.desc: Recently, the Slovenian public has been talking about life and related issues, as we are witnessing tectonic shifts in its understanding. While modern man positions himself as the standard and master of life, most religious traditions teach us that life is a gift from God and therefore sacred. The Catholic Church emphasizes that every person is created in God's image and therefore has immeasurable value, regardless of age, health, abilities or circumstances. / O življenju in z njim povezanimi vprašanji se v zadnjem času v slovenski javnosti krešejo menja, saj smo priče tektonskim premikom v njegovem razumevanju. Medtem ko se sodobni človek postavlja za merilo in gospodarja življenja, nas večina verskih tradicij uči, da je življenje Božji dar in zato sveto. Katoliška cerkev poudarja, da je vsak človek ustvarjen po Božji podobi in ima zato neizmerno vrednost, ne glede na starost, zdravje, sposobnosti ali okoliščine.

And Ricko DeWilde and his children encounter dangers during a journey through the heart of Alaska. / Mitt under en global pandemi står invånarna i Alaska infor aldrig tidigare skådade utmaningar under de korta sommarmånaderna nar de forbereder sig for den kommande vintern. However, Marianne gets in touch with two elderly gentlemen, John and Pontus, who help her through all the dangers of the big city. / En komedi om den unga Marianne som vantrivs i sitt arbete på en lantgård och istallet drommer om att klara sig sjalv i storstaden. Val dar står hon utan jobb eller bostad och till råga på allt blir hon bestulen på sin resvaska. programme.desc: The vampire infection spreads when Walter transforms Dan into a thinking vampire, who quickly becomes fascinated by his new abilities. Albin and Lo pursue Edith after seeing her attack another passenger. Pia realizes that something really disturbing is happening right in front of their eyes and is forced to act in a way she didn't think she was capable of. Marianne, Goran and Vincent barricade themselves inside a club as panic spreads on the ship. / Vampyrinfektionen sprider sig nar Walter forvandlar Dan till en tankande vampyr, som snabbt blir fascinerad av sina nya formågor. Albin och Lo forfoljer Edith efter att ha sett henne attackera en annan passagerare. Pia inser att något riktigt skrammande håller på att handa mitt framfor deras ogon och tvingas agera på ett satt hon inte trodde att hon var kapabel till. Marianne, Goran och Vincent barrikaderar sig inne i en klubb nar paniken sprider sig på fartyget.
