programme.title: On a journey with Bachstad: Europe in war and peace / På resa med Bachstad: Europa i krig och fred
programme.desc: Øystein and Rune began their journey with a short visit to Cambodia, and after briefly touring the neighboring countries, they are now back where the journey began. A series of memorials from the brutal Khmer Rouge regime make a strong impression on them. The traveling companions in Team Bachstad - Øystein Bache and Rune Gokstad - are out on new adventures. Having previously, among other things, traveled to Mongolia in a fire truck and crossed India in a tuc-tuc, this time they are driving through Indochina. / Øystein och Rune inledde sin resa med ett kort besok i Kambodja, och efter att ha kort runt i grannlanderna ar de nu tillbaka dar resan borjade. En rad minnesmarken från de roda khmerernas skrackregim gor starkt intryck på dem. Reskamraterna i Team Bachstad - Øystein Bache och Rune Gokstad - ar ute på nya aventyr. Efter att tidigare bl a ha kort till Mongoliet i brandbil och korsat Indien i tuc-tuc, bilar de denna gång genom Indokina.

programme.title: New blood in the zoo / Nytt blod i djurparken
programme.desc: Tuva has to have an operation on her ankle and Marie thinks she will probably have room to run her race. But it will take more than a cast to stop Tuva. She pushes on with her big project, despite Marie's and Nils' protests. Hog season is approaching. The month of July will determine if there will be solitude in the park or not. But can the farm attract visitors without socialized wolves? Part 6 of 7. / Tuva måste operera fotleden och Marie tror att hon antligen skall få utrymme att kora sitt race. Men det skall mer till an ett gips for att få stopp på Tuva. Hon driver på sitt stora projekt, trots Maries och Nils protester. Hogsasong stundar. Juli månad avgor om det blir lonsamhet i parken eller inte. Men kan gården locka besokare utan socialiserade vargar? Del 6 av 7.

programme.title: Stromso / Stromso
programme.desc: Nicke is hosted by noise and silence researcher Outi Ampuja. She has researched noise, the history of noise and the quality of our sound environment. What is silence good for and how is silence defined? Some of the people who visited the open house at Stromso at the beginning of the summer also got their say: Which is the loudest sound there is, which is the most pleasant and can it be too quiet? In the kitchen, Julien and Elin offer mussels that will convince even the biggest mussel skeptic. Hanna and Elin show how to transform your skinny jeans into wide jeans. / Nicke gastas av buller- och tystnadsforskaren Outi Ampuja. Hon har forskat i buller, bullrets historia och kvaliteten i vår ljudmiljo. Vad ar tystnaden bra for och hur definieras tystnad? En del av manniskorna som besokte oppet hus på Stromso i borjan av sommaren får också saga sitt: Vilket ar det varsta ljudet som finns, vilket ar det mest behagliga och kan det bli for tyst? I koket bjuder Julien och Elin på musslor som fralser aven den storsta musselskeptikern. Hanna och Elin visar hur du forvandlar dina skinny jeans till vida jeans.

programme.title: The giants / Giganterna
programme.desc: As Norway's first football team for short stature, the Giants are already historic with their participation in the World Cup. But is everyone happy with it? / Som Norges forsta fotbollslag for kortvaxta ar Giganterna redan historiska med sin medverkan i VM. Men ar alla nojda med det?

programme.title: Ask the doctor / Fråga doktorn
programme.desc: Is it dangerous to take several medications at the same time? How do you know if one's physical problems are due to illness, or a side effect of the medication? And how do you know if the benefit of a medication exceeds the risk of side effects? Answering the questions are Sara Nordberg, an expert on drugs and side effects, and Bjorn Wettermark, who does research on how good - or bad - we are at taking our medications while driving. Housewives are Jens Persson and presenter Sofia Rågenklint. / Är det farligt att ata flera mediciner samtidigt? Hur vet man om ens kroppsliga problem beror på sjukdom, eller en biverkning av medicinen? Och hur vet man om nyttan med en medicin overstiger risken for biverkningar? nSvarar på frågorna gor Sara Nordberg, expert på lakemedel och biverkningar, och Bjorn Wettermark, som forskar om hur bra - eller dåliga - vi ar på att ta våra mediciner på ratt satt. Huslakare ar Jens Persson och programledare Sofia Rågenklint.

programme.title: Seven kinds of cookies / Sju sorters kakor
programme.desc: Montadar Kanbar was baker of the year 2020 and now he shares his interpretation of the ballerina cake. With flake salt and chocolate, he transforms the everyday cake into the highlight of the coffee table. / Montadar Kanbar blev årets bagare 2020 och nu delar han med sig av sin tolkning på ballerinakakan. Med flingsalt och choklad forvandlar han den vardagliga kakan till fikabordets hojdpunkt.

programme.title: Husdrommar / Husdrommar
programme.desc: Marie is passionate about interior design and Bill is the home carpenter who is always renovating. They are passionate house lovers and have renovated four houses in ten years. Shocked, the upper class realizes that all the rusted out have been waiting for their place in the Forrådet since day one. The shadow player understands that he will be exposed and a worried Daniel Paris realizes that it meant unsavory consequences for him. The group speculates, the pressure rises and distrust in the suite reaches a new level. The entire upper class is shaken and the difference to the team spirit of the lower class could not be clearer. Skuggspelaren forstår att han kommer att avslojas och en orolig Daniel Paris inser att det innebar odesdigra konsekvenser for honom. Gruppen spekulerar, pressen stiger och misstron i sviten når en ny nivå. Hela overklassen ar skakad och skillnaden mot underklassens laganda kunde inte vara tydligare. programme.desc: Drama film by Maggie Betts Cast: with Jamie Foxx, Tommy Lee Jones, Jurnee Smollett, Alan Ruck, Mamoudou Athie, Pamela Reed, Bill Camp Country - Year: USA - 2025 Due to a large debt, the elderly undertaker Jeremiah OKeefe agrees to sell part of his business to a Canadian multinational, led by cynical Raymond Loewen, who thinks he can deceive the man to obtain a lower price. OKeefe intenta, perciò, una causa contro il gruppo di Loewen e assume Willie Gary, avvocato afroamericano Willie Gary celebre per la percentuale di successi. Il processo si rivela complesso e rischioso per OKeefe e Gary e il centro dellattenzione si sposta su questioni razziali.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

Rachel irrompe nel locale vestita da sposa ha appena abbandonato sullaltare il fidanzato Barry. Monica, sua amica e compagna di liceo, la riconosce e si offre di ospitarla a casa sua.

programme.title: Patti Chiari / Patti Chiari
programme.desc: IN THE NETWORK OF HATE by Nicola Agostinetti, Lorenzo PomariWords as weapons, social media as battlefields: when hatred and violence run online. Insults, threats, expletives, blasphemies, racist comments, virtual fights: social networks and the internet are increasingly overflowing with hatred and violent speeches.Patti Chiari has immersed herself in this harsh reality, collecting the testimonies of those who have been submerged by god avalanches. Victims of stalking and victims of cyberbullying. Victims of denigrating and defamatory campaigns and simple victims of pure rudeness. Patti Chiari also tells the incredible tragedy of a boy who, unable to deal with the violence of some users, took his own life live on TikTok. Not only that, it also collected the point of view of some keyboard lions. How broad is the phenomenon? Patti Chiari has scanned hundreds and hundreds of comments from users in Italian Switzerland in search of the most violent and shocking. He spoke about it with experts and followed the work of a social media editorial team, which coexists with hatred on a daily basis. For the first time, Patti Chiari finally tried to quantify how much Ticino politics is faced with insults, threats and defamatory messages online. The results are disconcerting. / NELLA RETE DELLODIO di Nicola Agostinetti, Lorenzo PomariParole come armi, i social media come campi di battaglia: quando lodio e la violenza corrono online.Insulti, minacce, imprecazioni, bestemmie, commenti razzisti, risse virtuali: i social network e la rete traboccano sempre più dodio e di discorsi violenti.Patti chiari si è immersa in questa cruda realtà, raccogliendo le testimonianze di chi è stato sommerso da valanghe dodio. Vittime di stalking e vittime di cyberbullismo. Vittime di campagne denigratorie e diffamanti e semplici vittime di pura maleducazione. Patti chiari racconta anche lincredibile tragedia di un ragazzo che, incapace di affrontare la violenza di alcuni utenti, si è tolto la vita in diretta su TikTok. Non solo, ha raccolto il punto di vista anche di alcuni leoni da tastiera.Quanto è ampio il fenomeno? Patti chiari ha scandagliato centinaia e centinaia di commenti di utenti della Svizzera Italiana alla ricerca dei più violenti e scioccanti. Ne ha parlato con degli esperti ed ha seguito il lavoro di una redazione giornalistica social, che con lodio convive giornalmente. Per la prima volta, Patti chiari ha infine cercato di quantificare quanto la politica ticinese sia confrontata con insulti, minacce e messaggi diffamanti online. I risultati sono sconcertanti.

programme.title: Cliche / Cliche
programme.desc: In the era of post-truth, of the most extreme conspiracy theories and unbridled exhibitionism, is what saves us a lie or the truth? Because if truth is a tremendously uncomfortable and often unattainable concept, lies instead seem to give a sense of comfortable refuge, of a quick solution within everyone's reach. This is why the new episode of Cliche is dedicated precisely to the theme of "Lie". We start with the lies of the new millennium, those falsehoods in which it is impossible not to stumble: fake news, a phenomenon of contemporary but also social communication, analyzed in their complexity with the journalist and expert in the digital field, Francesco Oggiani. With the journalist and former Ticino cyclist Antonio Ferretti we move on to the field of sport, where it happens that making false claims to improve a performance becomes a polluting but not unusual practice: it is the lie of doping. Then there are cases in which the lie becomes a necessary element to investigate broader and more uncomfortable truths, it is the story of the actress Anna Foglietta, who tells us about her commitment on and off the set. A tribute to Oliviero Toscani, the well-known photographer, who in 1992 in the TSI studios told about the intrinsic lies of advertising, while "The Adversary" by Emmanuel Carrère is the text reread by the writer Tommaso Soldini. To complete the journey into the different forms of lies, the video-collage work by the artist Sir Taki and the musical interventions by DJ Yeelen. / Nell’epoca della post-verità, del complottismo più spinto e dell’esibizionismo sfrenato, quello che ci salva è una bugia o la verità? Perche se quello di verità è un concetto tremendamente scomodo e spesso irraggiungibile, la bugia invece sembra dare un senso di comodo rifugio, di soluzione rapida e alla portata di tutti. Per questo la nuova puntata di Cliche è dedicata proprio al tema “Bugia”.Si parte con le bugie del nuovo millennio, quelle falsità in cui è impossibile non inciampare: le fake news, fenomeno della comunicazione contemporanea ma anche sociale, analizzate nella loro complessità con il giornalista ed esperto del campo digital, Francesco Oggiani. Con il giornalista ed ex ciclista ticinese Antonio Ferretti si passa al campo dello sport, dove capita che fare carte false per migliorare una performance diventi una pratica inquinante ma non insolita: è la bugia del doping. Ci sono casi poi in cui la bugia diventa un elemento necessario per indagare verità più ampie e scomode, è il racconto dell’attrice Anna Foglietta, che ci racconta il suo impegno dentro e fuori dal set.Un omaggio a Oliviero Toscani, il noto fotografo, che nel 1992 negli studi TSI raccontava delle bugie intrinseche della pubblicità, mentre “L’avversario” di Emmanuel Carrère è il testo riletto dallo scrittore Tommaso Soldini. A completare il percorso nelle diverse forme della bugia l’opera di video-collage dell’artista Sir Taki e gli interventi musicali a cura della DJ Yeelen.

programme.desc: Among the series most loved by Italian children of multiple generations, many years after the classic cartoon collection, the Smurfs return with a new editorial project. Created by the Belgian author Peyo, the Smurfs represent a magical and fun world that will involve the little ones and their families. Furthermore, the new series is made in a high-quality CGI technique that maintains the warmth of the original. / Tra le serie più amate dai bambini italiani di più generazioni, a distanza di molti anni dalla classica collezione di cartoni animati, i Puffi tornano con un nuovo progetto editoriale. Creati dallautore belga Peyo, i Puffi rappresentano un mondo magico e divertente che potrà coinvolgere i più piccoli e i loro familiari. Inoltre, la nuova serie è realizzata in una tecnica CGI di alta qualità che mantiene il calore delloriginale.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep / Shaun vita da pecora
programme.desc: On the small farm in the English countryside, the life of Shaun the sheep and the flock that follows her in her exploits is disturbed by the farmer's new acquisition: a small group of very bad llamas. As always, the very strong myopia confuses the farmer about the real state of things and the warnings of the faithful dog Bitzer are of no avail. Shaun with his optimistic approach tends to underestimate new guests, until he realizes he has made them a little too comfortable... / Nella piccola fattoria della campagna inglese la vita della pecora Shaun e del gregge che la segue nelle sue imprese è turbata da un nuovo acquisto del fattore: un gruppetto di lama cattivissimi. Come sempre, la fortissima miopia confonde il fattore sul reale stato delle cose ed a nulla valgono gli avvertimenti del fedele cane Bitzer. Shaun con il suo approccio ottimista tende a sottovalutare i nuovi ospiti, finche si rende conto di averli messi un po troppo a loro agio...

programme.desc: A gunshot, a financial scam. Crimes for which a door closes behind you. It is that of the cantonal prison facilities of Lugano. Spiritual assistant Daniele Campoli accompanies us on this journey into human suffering. / Un colpo di pistola, una truffa finanziaria. Reati per i quali dietro a se si chiude una porta. È quella delle strutture carcerarie cantonali di Lugano. Nell’incontro con un detenuto e con chi ora è tornato in libertà la ricerca di un’interiorità personale e di una rinascita. In questo viaggio nella sofferenza umana ci accompagna l’assistente spirituale Daniele Campoli.

programme.title: Treasures of the world - Sukhothai - The ruins of the ancient royal city - Thailand / Tesori del mondo - Sukhothai - Le rovine dellantica città reale - Tailandia
programme.sub-title: Sukhothai - Le rovine dellantica città reale - Tailandia
programme.desc: Sukhothai is a city in Thailand, the capital of the province of the same name, located over 400 km north of Bangkok. The modern city is located about 12 km east of Sukhothai Historical Park, with the ruins of the ancient capital of the Sukhothai Kingdom, which dominated the Indochina region for about 140 years. / Sukhothai è una città della Thailandia, capoluogo della provincia omonima, posta ad oltre 400 km a nord di Bangkok. La città moderna è localizzata a circa 12 km ad est del Parco storico di Sukhothai, con le rovine della antica capitale del Regno di Sukhothai, che per circa 140 dominò la regione indocinese.

programme.title: Cases of love / Casi damore
programme.desc: Lawyer Florian Faber runs a prosperous law firm together with his elegant wife Eva. The sudden reappearance of his ex-girlfriend Sarah, a journalist, takes him by surprise. The woman is in prison, suspected of tax evasion, but proclaiming her innocence, she uses all her charm to convince Florian to help her. / Lavvocato Florian Faber gestisce un prospero studio legale insieme allelegante moglie Eva. Limprovvisa ricomparsa della sua ex fidanzata Sarah, una giornalista, lo coglie di sorpresa. La donna è in carcere, sospettata di evasione fiscale, ma proclamando la sua innocenza, usa tutto il suo fascino per convincere Florian ad aiutarla.

programme.title: Back in the game / Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: The story of a baseball talent scout, Gus (Clint Eastwood), in charge of the Atlanta Braves, who sees his career adrift: he can no longer find champions. A trip to North Carolina with his daughter Mickey (Amy Adams), with whom relations are not exactly idyllic, could solve everything. Gus, in fact, returns in the company of a promising young woman and is ready to get back into the game... / La storia di un talent scout di baseball, Gus (Clint Eastwood), in carica agli Atlanta Braves, che vede la sua carriera alla deriva: non riesce più a scovare campioni. Un viaggio in North Carolina con la figlia Mickey (Amy Adams), con la quale i rapporti non sono propriamente idilliaci, potrebbe risolvere tutto. Gus, infatti, torna in compagnia di una giovane promessa ed è pronto a rimettersi in gioco...

programme.title: Albert's Garden - Why do sharks attack? / Il giardino di Albert - Perche gli squali attaccano?
programme.desc: Three deadly attacks in less than a year in the Red Sea. A mystery that shocks tourists, biologists and authorities. Dramas that, without a doubt, leave indelible traces. The documentary proposed today by Albert's garden investigates the causes behind these rare but disturbing events, revealing a mix of factors: warming waters, tourist overcrowding, intensive fishing and hungry sharks pushing ever closer to the coast. With exclusive images, direct testimonies and scientific analyses, the film takes us between the coral reefs of Egypt, the beaches of Florida and the Australian coasts, where the coexistence between man and shark is increasingly delicate. But sharks are not bloodthirsty monsters. They are ancient predators, essential for the balance of the oceans. And perhaps, rather than fear them, we should really learn to know them. A compelling story that mixes biology, ecology and technology, and which forces us to admit perhaps the most obvious thing: we are the ones invading their world! / Tre attacchi mortali in meno di un anno nel Mar Rosso. Un mistero che scuote turisti, biologi e autorità. Drammi che, senza alcun dubbio, lasciano tracce indelebili. Il documentario proposto oggi dal giardino di Albert indaga le cause dietro questi eventi rari ma inquietanti, svelando un intreccio di fattori: riscaldamento delle acque, sovraffollamento turistico, pesca intensiva e squali affamati che si spingono sempre più vicino alla costa. Con immagini esclusive, testimonianze dirette e analisi scientifiche, il filmato ci porta tra le barriere coralline dellEgitto, le spiagge della Florida e le coste australiane, dove la convivenza tra uomo e squalo è sempre più delicata. Ma gli squali non sono mostri sanguinari. Sono predatori antichi, essenziali per lequilibrio degli oceani. E forse, più che temerli, dovremmo imparare a conoscerli davvero. Un racconto avvincente che mescola biologia, ecologia e tecnologia, e che ci costringe ad ammettere la cosa forse più evidente: siamo noi ad invadere il loro mondo!

programme.desc: After competing all her life and having won almost everything there was to win, Angelika Rainer decides to abandon racing and get back into the game on a personal journey to rediscover herself, her relationship with the past and with nature. In front of the most difficult rock and ice walls in the world, the climber faces the inflection moment of her career, looking for new stimuli and new routes to follow, in freedom. / Dopo aver gareggiato per tutta la vita e aver vinto quasi tutto quello che cera da vincere, Angelika Rainer decide di abbandonare le gare e rimettersi in gioco in un viaggio personale alla riscoperta di se stessa, del rapporto con il passato e con la natura. Davanti alle pareti di roccia e di ghiaccio più difficili al mondo, la climber affronta il momento di inflessione della sua carriera, alla ricerca di nuovi stimoli e nuove vie da percorrere, in libertà.

programme.title: The indifferent / Gli indifferenti
programme.desc: Rome today. Some aftershocks from an earthquake in central Italy make the climate suspended. Mariagrazia Ardengo (Valeria Bruni Tedeschi) and her two children, Michele (Vincenzo Crea) and Carla (Beatrice Grannò), have no more money. In the last three years, Leo Merumeci (Edoardo Pesce), a jack-of-all-trades manager, who in the meantime has become Mariagrazia's lover, has given her loans, allowing her to repay some debts and continue to lead the comfortable life she always has. Michele, who has just returned from a trip abroad, senses, also thanks to his relationship with Lisa (Giovanna Mezzogiorno), a family friend, that behind Leo's apparent generosity lies a long-thought-out plan to obtain the only asset the Ardengo family has left: the attic in which they live. Mariagrazia is too in love with Leo to listen to her son and so it is up to Carla - who at just eighteen receives some morbid attention from Leo himself - to try to shake her family from the indifference in which they had taken refuge. / Roma oggi. Qualche scossa d’assestamento per un terremoto in centro Italia rende il clima sospeso. Mariagrazia Ardengo (Valeria Bruni Tedeschi) e i suoi due figli, Michele (Vincenzo Crea) e Carla (Beatrice Grannò), non hanno più soldi. Negli ultimi tre anni, Leo Merumeci (Edoardo Pesce), un manager tuttofare, divenuto nel frattempo amante di Mariagrazia, le ha fatto dei prestiti permettendole di ripagare alcuni debiti e continuare a fare la vita agiata di sempre. Michele, appena tornato da un viaggio all’estero, intuisce, anche grazie alla sua relazione con Lisa (Giovanna Mezzogiorno), un’amica di famiglia, che dietro l’apparente generosità di Leo, si cela un piano meditato a lungo per ottenere l’unico bene che è rimasto alla famiglia Ardengo: l’attico in cui vivono. Mariagrazia è troppo innamorata di Leo per dare ascolto al figlio e allora sta a Carla - che appena diciottenne riceve delle attenzioni morbose dallo stesso Leo – tentare di scuotere la sua famiglia dall’indifferenza in cui si era rifugiata.

programme.title: Contrasts / Cuntrasts
programme.desc: Tumasch Dolf (teacher, poet, composer, co-founder and president of the Romansh Union of Schons, co-founder of Lia Romansh and Rhineland, born 1889 and died 1963) is probably the most popular Romansh composer. He created real hits - such as “Il cumun in silenzi”, “Giaveischs d'unfants”, “Allas steilas”, “Egl jester”, “La canzun dil bau”, “La stiva da filar” - which are sung throughout the Grischun rumantsch often and with pleasure. His son Benedetg, who died in 1985 in Schiers, is less well known. His work is still far from being discovered. In a tribute, Gieri Venzin presents the two composers from Val Schons and their great songs. / Tumasch Dolf (insegnante, poeta, compositore, confondatore e presidente dell’Unione romancia di Schons, cofondatore della Lia Romancia e della Renania, nato nel 1889 e morto nel 1963) è probabilmente il compositore romancio più popolare. Ha creato veri e propri successi - come “Il cumun in silenzi”, “Giaveischs d’unfants”, “Allas steilas”, “Egl jester”, “La canzun dil bau”, “La stiva da filar”- che vengono cantati in tutto il Grischun rumantsch spesso e con piacere. Suo figlio Benedetg, morto nel 1985 a Schiers, è invece meno conosciuto. La sua opera è ancora lungi dall’essere scoperta.In un omaggio, Gieri Venzin presenta i due compositori della Val Schons e le loro grandiose canzoni.

programme.desc: Experts John Weisbarth and Zack Giffin will transform very small houses into real dream homes. Small architectural tricks and great creativity will show us that size doesn't matter. / Gli esperti John Weisbarth e Zack Giffin trasformeranno case molto piccole in vere e proprie case da sogno. Piccoli astuzie architettoniche e una grande creativita ci mostreranno che le dimensioni non contano.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as the show's executive producer in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious mystery writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Psych / Psych
programme.desc: Shawn Spencer has the opportunity of a lifetime: opening a detective agency with his friend Gus. And a psychic, or rather, pretends to be one, in reality just has a great gift for noticing details at all times. / Shawn Spencer ha loccasione della sua vita: aprire unagenzia investigativa con il suo amico Gus. E un sensitivo, o meglio, si finge tale, in realtà ha solo una grande dote nel notare i dettagli in ogni momento.

programme.title: Padre Brown / Padre Brown

programme.title: Let them talk / Lasciali parlare
programme.desc: Pulitzer Prize-winning writer Alice Hughes has been invited to England to collect another prestigious literary award. But she is afraid of flying: so she decides to take the ship trip, aboard a magnificent ocean liner, and to invite her two best friends from college, Roberta and Susan, as well as being accompanied by her beloved nephew Tyler, to assist them during the cruise. / La scrittrice Alice Hughes, vincitrice del Premio Pulitzer, è stata invitata in Inghilterra per ritirare un altro prestigioso premio letterario. Ma ha paura di volare: decide così di fare il viaggio in nave, a bordo di un magnifico transatlantico, e di invitare le sue due migliori amiche del college, Roberta e Susan, oltre a farsi accompagnare dal suo amato nipote Tyler, per assisterle durante la crociera.

programme.title: Eternal phlegm / Flemma eterna
programme.desc: Antoine Pecher and Eric Jamet accompany us on an adventurous journey to the Trango Towers in the Pakistani Karakorum. Jumping from over 6000 meters in a wingsuit is their goal. They tell it to us with extreme simplicity, intertwining their crazy adventure with the story of Glenn Singleman who, at the beginning of the 90s, was the first man in the world to perform a base jump from a peak as high as that of the Great Tower of Trango. / Antoine Pecher e Eric Jamet ci accompagnano in un avventuroso viaggio fin sulle Torri di Trango nel Karakorum pakistano. Lanciarsi da oltre 6000 metri con una tuta alare è il loro obiettivo. Ce lo raccontano con estrema semplicità, intrecciando la loro folle avventura con il racconto di Glenn Singleman che, allinizio degli anni 90, fu il primo uomo al mondo a effettuare un salto base da una cima tanto alta come quella della Grande Torre di Trango.

programme.title: Too many like it / Piace a troppi
programme.desc: Drama film by Roger Vadim Cast: with Brigitte Bardot, Curd Jurgens, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jeanne Marken Country - Year: FRA - 1956 Juliette, an orphaned teenager, is hosted by an elderly couple in a fishing village. The girl's brazen beauty and her libertine personality cause havoc among the men of the town, to the point that her foster mother decides to send Juliette back to the orphanage. To avoid leaving, Juliette agrees to marry the shy Michel, who has long been in love with her, who hopes that over time the girl will fall in love with him. In reality, however, Juliette has long been in love with Michel's cousin, Antoine, who returns to the village to manage the family business. / Film drammatico di Roger Vadim Cast: con Brigitte Bardot, Curd Jurgens, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Jeanne Marken Paese - Anno: FRA - 1956 Juliette, adolescente orfana, è ospitata da una coppia d´anziani in un villaggio di pescatori. La bellezza sfrontata della ragazza e la sua personalità libertina provocano scompiglio tra gli uomini del paese, al punto che la madre affidataria decide di rimandare Juliette in orfanotrofio. Per evitare la partenza, Juliette accetta di sposare il timido Michel, da tempo innamorato di lei, il quale spera che col tempo la ragazza possa innamorarsi di lui. In realtà però Juliette è da tempo invaghita del cugino di Michel, Antoine, che torna in paese per dirigere l´azienda di famiglia.

programme.title: A pinch of love / Un pizzico damore
programme.desc: It follows Lia, who struggles to grow her nonprofit meal delivery service because she insists on doing everything herself. But with Eli's help, she will discover that business, just like love, can flourish with a little hard work and trust. / Segue Lia, che fatica a far crescere il suo servizio di consegna pasti senza scopo di lucro perche insiste nel fare tutto da sola. Ma con laiuto di Eli, scoprirà che gli affari, proprio come lamore, possono fiorire con un po di impegno e fiducia.

programme.title: Dakota / Dakota
programme.desc: Abbie Cornish in a story of friendship and heroism. A woman welcomes her husband's dog who died in Afghanistan into her home. The animal forms a bond with his daughter and saves their farm. / Abbie Cornish in una storia di amicizia ed eroismo. Una donna accoglie in casa il cane del marito morto in Afghanistan. Lanimale stringe un legame con la figlia e salvera la loro fattoria.

programme.desc: Judd literally finds himself under heavy fire when an armory catches fire and bullets fly everywhere. Owen questions Judd's promise of sobriety. programme.title: Feeling / Ramdam
programme.desc: Ramdam will tell you about a boom... That of real criminal cases which inspire the authors of novels, series or detective films. These works are also called “True Crime”. They are a hit, as if the stories based on real events with real corpses, real investigations and real monsters made us shiver even more. / Ramdam va vous parler d’un boom... Celui des affaires criminelles reelles qui inspirent les auteurs de romans, de series ou de films policiers. Ces œuvres, on les appelle aussi des “True crime”. Elles cartonnent, comme si les histoires tirees de faits reels avec de vrais cadavres, de vraies enquetes et de vrais monstres nous faisaient encore plus frissonner.

programme.title: Narwhal or almost / Narval ou presque
programme.desc: When Shark and Pilot Fish become separated, it's up to Kelp, Scallop, Cruz and Waverly to help them find each other again. / Theo, the scallop's friend, finally explains why he always rushes. / Lorsque Shark et Pilot Fish sont separes, cest à Kelp, Scallop, Cruz et Waverly de les aider à se retrouver. / Theo, lami de la coquille Saint-Jacques, explique enfin pourquoi il se precipite toujours.

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters
programme.desc: A Piou-Piou Challenge is being organized in Pom-les-Bains today! To participate, Marine must invent a dance to the latest hit from Super Piou-Piou. Wendy offers to help her by bombarding her with ideas, but Marine considers them too rotten and ends up sending her sister away. Wendy, upset, decides to also participate in the Piou-Piou Challenge, just to prove to Marine that she is serious... The chore war is declared! / Un Piou-Piou Challenge est organise à Pom-les-Bains aujourd’hui ! Pour participer, Marine doit inventer une danse sur le dernier tube de Super Piou-Piou. Wendy lui propose son aide en la bombardant d’idees, mais Marine les juge trop pourrites et finit par envoyer balader sa sister. Wendy, vexee, decide de participer elle aussi au Piou-Piou Challenge, juste pour prouver à Marine qu’elle assure grave… La guerre des chores est declaree !

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters
programme.desc: To have peace with her friends, Wendy gives her sister a catalog of toys. Except that by being ecstatic over the toys, Marine provokes some amused reactions from the teenage girls who find her too cute. They clearly take her for a baby! Annoyed, Marine sneaks up on the grown-ups, determined to prove to them that she is done with toys. / Pour avoir la paix avec ses copines, Wendy donne à sa sœur un catalogue de jouets. Sauf qu’en s’extasier devant les jouets, Marine provoque quelques reactions amusees chez les adolescentes qui la trouvent trop mignonne. Elles la prennent clairement pour un bebe ! Vexee, Marine s’incruste auprès des grandes, bien decidee à leur prouver qu’elle en a termine avec les jouets.

programme.title: The Sisters / Les Sisters
programme.desc: Marine and Wendy are fans of an online comic: the Brothers. When Marine suspects the designer of drawing inspiration from their lives to write his gags, she decides to investigate to discover his identity. And no investigation without a good assistant like Wendy! Together, the detective duo will go from surprise to surprise... / Marine et Wendy sont fans d’une BD en ligne : les Brothers. Quand Marine soupçonne le dessinateur de s’inspirer de leur vie pour ecrire ses gags, elle decide de mener l’enquete pour decouvrir son identite. Et pas d’enquete sans une bonne assistante comme Wendy ! Ensemble, le duo de detectives ira de surprise en surprise…

programme.title: Mystery Lane / Mystery Lane
programme.desc: According to Inspector McFlare, the diamond thief currently active in London will soon attack the Queen's. But how can we protect him against an enemy that the watchdogs have described as a “shaggy gnome capable of teleporting”? / Daprès linspecteur McFlare, le voleur de diamants qui sevit en ce moment à Londres va forcement sen prendre prochainement à celui de la Reine. Mais comment le proteger face à un ennemi que les chiens de vigiles ont decrit comme un « gnome hirsute capable de se teleporter » ?

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: A renowned mathematician, the Countess de la Cancoillote arrives at the Louvre to prove that someone is stealing part of her monthly donation to the Paris Orphanage. The culprit is none other than Richelieu, who does everything to discredit the Countess. Conquered by this admirable woman who stands up to Richelieu, dArtagnan and the Three Musketeers... / Mathematicienne reputee, la comtesse de la Cancoillote debarque au Louvre pour prouver que quelquun vole une partie de sa donation mensuelle à lOrphelinat de Paris. Le coupable nest autre que Richelieu, qui fait tout pour discrediter la Comtesse. Conquises par cette femme admirable qui tient tete à Richelieu, dArtagnan et les Trois mousqueta...

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: The superstitious merchants of Paris accuse a black cat of having destroyed precious goods and ask the King to judge him for his crime. In reality, it is a set-up by Milady's henchmen who want to blame the animal and enrich themselves with impunity with the stolen provisions... Richelieu, who adores cats, asks... / Les Marchands de Paris, superstitieux, accusent un chat noir davoir detruit de precieuses marchandises et demandent au Roi de le juger pour son crime. En realite, cest un coup monte des sbires de Milady qui veulent faire porter le chapeau à lanimal et senrichir impunement avec les provisions volees… Richelieu, qui adore les chats, demande l...

programme.title: The 3 Musketeers / Les 3 Mousquetaires
programme.desc: The Three Musketeers and d'Artagnan interrupt a transaction between Ademar de l'Adandur and a relic trafficker. Ladandur flees, leaving a box containing a fabulous plume, supposed to give victory to the one who wears it! Louis XIII entrusts the panache and command to dArtagnan, the time to find his enemy. But... / Les Trois Mousquetaires et dArtagnan interrompent une transaction entre Ademar de lAdandur et un trafiquant de reliques. LAdandur senfuit en laissant un coffret où se trouve un panache fabuleux, cense donner la victoire à celui qui le porte ! Louis XIII confie le panache et le commandement à dArtagnan, le temps de retrouver son ennemi. Mais...

programme.title: Abominable and the invisible city / Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.desc: As Yi, Jin and Peng try to figure out how Yi's magic works, they notice that Everest seems to be too hot. They try to freshen it up by all means, including seeking help from their old enemy Mr. Burnish. / Tandis que Yi, Jin et Peng essaient de comprendre comment opère la magie de Yi, ils saperçoivent quEverest semble avoir trop chaud. Ils tentent de le rafraîchir par tous les moyens y compris solliciter laide de leur vieil ennemi monsieur Burnish.

programme.title: Abominable and the invisible city / Abominable et la cite invisible
programme.sub-title: Carpe degout et casse au musee
programme.desc: An earthquake announces that a new creature is approaching, but Yi and Jin bicker, each convinced he will make a better leader than the other. The three friends finally discover that it is a giant "disgusted carp" which was behind the earthquakes, and which is in search of its precious pearl, which constitutes the keystone of a magical underground dam. Without this pearl, the sewer water level will continue to rise, threatening to flood the entire city! The pearl was stolen to be exhibited in the local museum; a heist is necessary to recover the pearl before it is too late. / Un tremblement de terre annonce quune nouvelle creature approche, mais Yi et Jin se chamaillent, chacun etant convaincu quil fera un meilleur chef que lautre. Les trois amis decouvrent finalement que cest une "carpe degout" geante qui etait derrière les tremblements de terre, et quelle est à la recherche de sa precieuse perle, qui constitue la cle de voûte dun barrage magique souterrain. Sans cette perle, le niveau de leau des egouts va continuer de monter, menaçant dinonder toute la ville ! La perle a ete derobee pour etre exposee au musee local ; un casse simpose pour recuperer la perle avant quil ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Welcome to the Louds / Bienvenue chez les Loud
programme.sub-title: Pour le meilleur et pour la paire / L’arche de Lana
programme.desc: The two pairs of friends vying for the title of best friends in college sow discord in the group. / Lana struggles to find a home for the shelter's exotic animals before they leave. / Les deux paires damis en lice pour le titre de meilleurs amis du collège sèment la zizanie dans le groupe. / Lana a du mal à trouver un toit pour les animaux exotiques du refuge avant leur depart.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis is excited about the release of an issue of his favorite comic book but his parents have planned to attend a show at the caterpillar's house... where they have to witness its transformation! / Louis est tout excite par la sortie dun numero de sa BD preferee mais ses parents ont prevu dassister à un spectacle chez la chenille… où ils doivent assister à sa transformation !

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: To be able to go and taste peanut butter, Louis must take the two hundred and twenty-four larvae that he keeps in the absence of his parents... programme.title: What's the weather like? / Quel temps fait-il ?

programme.title: Brokenwood / Brokenwood
programme.sub-title: Jesus, Marie, Joseph et un âne
programme.desc: An amateur theater troupe comes to stage the birth of Christ in Brokenwood church. The whole city is in turmoil. But the party is doubly spoiled when a very precious relic is stolen, while the actor who was to play Jesus is found dead. Obviously, the two events are linked, but the symbolism of this affair strikes all the inhabitants. It remains to be seen who is the author of this horrible crime, and for what purpose... / Une troupe de theâtre amateur vient mettre en scène la naissance du Christ dans leglise de Brokenwood. Toute la ville est en effervescence. Mais la fete est doublement gâchee quand une relique très precieuse est derobee, tandis que lacteur qui devait jouer Jesus est retrouve mort. A levidence, les deux evenements sont lies, mais la symbolique de cette affaire frappe tous les habitants. Reste à savoir qui est lauteur de cet horrible crime, et dans quel but...

programme.title: Top models / Top models

programme.title: More beautiful life, even more beautiful / Plus belle la vie, encore plus belle
programme.desc: After the collapse of the Mistral district, its former inhabitants had to start from scratch in a completely new district. Nouveaux voisins, nouveaux lieux et nouvelles habitudes… leur vie a doucement pris un nouveau depart dans le Panier.

programme.title: Tomorrow belongs to us / Demain nous appartient
programme.desc: An unlikely supervisor saves the boot camp by replacing a sick teacher. Without knowing it, William gets rid of a valuable item. programme.title: A Rose for Her Grave: The True Story of Cynthia Baumgartner / Une rose pour sa tombe : lhistoire vraie de Cynthia Baumgartner
programme.desc: A widow and single mother, Cindy believes she is living a fairy tale when she meets Randy. This forty-year-old, also a widower, seems to immediately fall under her spell. Their love story takes off and they get married a few months later under the somewhat worried gaze of Lori, Cindy's best friend. Once the marriage passes, Randy completely changes his attitude, becoming authoritarian and violent. / Veuve et mère celibataire, Cindy croit vivre un conte de fees lorsqu’elle rencontre Randy. Ce quadragenaire, lui aussi veuf, semble tomber aussitôt sous son charme. Leur histoire d’amour s’emballe et ils se marient quelques mois plus tard sous le regard un peu inquiet de Lori, la meilleure amie de Cindy. Une fois le mariage passe, Randy change totalement d’attitude, devient autoritaire et violent.

programme.title: Modern Family / Modern Family
programme.desc: Lilly helps Phil build a roof for the future ducklings. Cameron is ready to do anything to be accepted by the Fraternity to whom he rented the apartment. Gloria and Claire teach and receive a lesson from Jay and Manny. / Lilly aide Phil à construire un toit pour les futurs canetons. Cameron est pret à nimporte quoi pour se faire accepter par la Fraternite à qui il a loue lappartement. Gloria et Claire donnent et reçoivent une leçon de la part de Jay et Manny.

programme.title: Murdoch's plugs / Les enquetes de Murdoch
programme.desc: Golfer James Benedict dies following a putter blow to the head. When the murder weapon is found in a pond, and it appears to belong to the victim's brother, Wilbur, all suspicion falls on him, especially since James had taken out life insurance in his name... / Le golfeur James Benedict decède à la suite d’un coup de putter assene sur le crâne. Lorsque larme du crime est retrouvee dans un etang, et quil apparaît quelle appartient au frère de la victime, Wilbur, tous les soupçons se portent sur lui, d’autant que James avait souscrit une assurance-vie à son nom…

programme.title: Murdoch's plugs / Les enquetes de Murdoch
programme.desc: The marriage of Elizabeth Cummerworth and Oliver Pym turns tragic when the husband dies suddenly, electrocuted. His widow is immediately suspected when Murdoch discovers that this is his fifth marriage... / Le mariage dElizabeth Cummerworth et Oliver Pym tourne au drame lorsque le mari meurt subitement, electrocute. Sa veuve est immediatement soupçonnee quand Murdoch decouvre qu’il s’agit de son cinquième mariage…

programme.title: Rizzoli and Isles / Rizzoli and Isles
programme.desc: A man is found dead in his home, handcuffed to his bed. The team investigates, while continuing its research on Alice Sand, whose evil plans must absolutely be foiled. Although the research is intense, Jane and Maura engage in some soul-searching. As Korsak's going away party approaches, everyone makes a video to say goodbye. The group says their goodbyes and plans their next adventures. What do Jane and Maura really want? Where are their priorities now? These questions take on their full meaning after narrowly escaping a shooting... / Un homme est retrouve mort chez lui, menotte à son lit. Lequipe enquete, tout en poursuivant ses recherches sur Alice Sand, dont les plans machiaveliques doivent absolument etre dejoues. Bien que ces recherches soient intenses, Jane et Maura se livrent à une introspection. Alors que la fete de depart de Korsak approche, tout le monde fait une video pour lui dire au revoir. Le groupe fait ses adieux et planifie ses prochaines aventures. Que souhaitent reellement Jane et Maura ? Où sorientent desormais leurs priorietes ? Ces questionnements prennent tout leur sens après avoir echappe de peu à une fusillade...

programme.title: Here it all begins / Ici tout commence
programme.desc: Filmed in the Camargue, “Here it all begins” is the story of a dynasty of great chefs. Viewers will immerse themselves in the life of a school that will train the future big names in gastronomy. Ready for a new plot? / Tourne en Camargue, "Ici tout commence" est lhistoire d’une dynastie de grands chefs. Les telespectateurs plongeront dans la vie d’une ecole qui formera les futurs grands noms de la gastronomie. Pret(s) pour une nouvelle intrigue ?

programme.title: This is my question / Cest ma question
programme.desc: A general culture game reflects the diversity and passions of the French-speaking people. Everyone can ask a question related to their profession, their region or their centers of interest. Faced with a multitude of portraits, who to choose? programme.title: Pass me the binoculars / Passe-moi les jumelles
programme.desc: : Charbel El Feghali is the charismatic keeper of the “Lyzamir” grocery store. From the mountains of Beirut where he grew up, to Geneva, the grocer weaves links between cultures, reduces the distance between origins and recounts the flavors that unite souls: Jane and Etienne met thanks to their shared passion for music. Nomads at heart, they decide to adopt three donkeys and set off on the path of simplicity, to the rhythm of their hooves. A musical journey to the heart of the Dolomites, in the footsteps of bards and donkeys. / : Charbel El Feghali est le charismatique gardien de lepicerie « Lyzamir ». Des montagnes de Beyrouth qui l’ont vu grandir, jusqu’à Genève, l’epicier tisse des liens entre les cultures, reduit la distance entre les origines et raconte les saveurs qui unissent les âmes.: Jane et Etienne se sont rencontres grâce à leur passion commune pour la musique. Nomades dans l’âme, ils decident d’adopter trois ânes et de partir sur le chemin de la simplicite, au rythme des sabots. Un voyage musical au cœur des Dolomites, sur les traces des bardes et des ânes.

programme.title: Death on clay / Mort sur terre battue
programme.desc: As the first day of qualifying for the Paris Women's Tennis International is about to begin, technical director Vincent Beti discovers at the tournament venue the lifeless body of Manon Picard, French revelation of the year. / Alors que le premier jour des qualifications de lInternational de tennis Feminin de Paris va debuter, le directeur technique Vincent Beti decouvre sur le lieu du tournoi le corps sans vie de Manon Picard, revelation française de lannee.

programme.title: The profiler / La profileuse
programme.desc: Micki decided to leave the investigation and join Mark in his parents' second home. A beneficial time for her which allows her to recharge her batteries. But her professionalism pushes her to know how the investigation is going. And, learning that new evidence has been discovered, she decides to return to Durban to help arrest the suspect / Micki a decide de quitter lenquete et de rejoindre Mark dans la maison secondaire de ses parents. Un temps benefique pour elle qui lui permet de se ressourcer. Mais son professionnalisme la pousse à savoir comment se passe lenquete. Et, apprenant que de nouveaux elements de preuves ont ete decouverts, elle decide de retourner à Durban pour aider à interpeller le suspect

programme.title: The profiler / La profileuse
programme.desc: Micki is delighted to learn that the budget for her course has been approved. Her joy is short-lived because she is entrusted with a difficult investigation. A particularly precise shooter increases the number of shootings in the village of Phoswa. To make matters worse, this killer is proving particularly difficult to pin down. / Micki a la joie dapprendre que le budget de son cours a ete approuve. Sa joie est de courte duree car elle se voit confier une enquete difficile. Un tireur particulièrement precis multiplie les fusillades dans le village de Phoswa. Pour ne rien arranger, ce tueur savère particulièrement difficile à cerner

programme.title: The profiler / La profileuse
programme.desc: The rifle killer remains untraceable and serial murders are increasing in the country, so much so that Micki is on the verge of mental breakdown. But perhaps it is by coming close to a nervous breakdown that she will come closest to the killer's state of mind... / Le tueur à la carabine reste introuvable et les meurtres en serie se multiplient dans le pays, tant est si bien que Micki est sur le point de craquer mentalement. Mais cest peut-etre en frôlant la crise de nerfs, quelle se rapprochera le plus de letat desprit du tueur...

programme.title: You Are Not My Mother / You Are Not My Mother
programme.desc: One evening, Angela, Char's depressed mother, doesn't come home. She reappears the next day, but offers no explanation for her absence. From then on, Char and his grandmother noticed that his behavior had changed. The young girl initially thinks that her mother's new treatment is the cause of this situation, but she eventually considers a more sinister explanation. / Un soir, Angela, la mère depressive de Char, ne rentre pas. Elle reapparaît dès le lendemain, mais ne livre aucune explication quant à son absence. Dès lors, Char et sa grand-mère constatent que son comportement a change. La jeune fille pense tout dabord que le nouveau traitement de sa mère est la cause de cette situation, mais elle finit par envisager une plus sinistre explication.

programme.title: Sullivan, little explorer / Sullivan, petit explorateur
programme.desc: Sullivan is passionate about maps and aspires to become a cartographer and explorer. Les yeux rives sur son atlas, Sullivan se cree un monde à lui, debordant de nature, d’aventure et de couleurs…

programme.sub-title: La Pat Patrouille des Airs : Le sauvetage de lavion royal
programme.desc: A group of rescue dogs led by a child sets out to protect the members of their community, each member of the group possessing special skills and different objects and vehicles that allow them to carry out their mission. / Un groupe de chiens de sauvetage dirige par un enfant part proteger les membres de sa communaute, chaque membre du groupe possedant des competences particulières et differents objets et vehicules qui leur permettent de mener leur mission à bien.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Louis and Abacus want to play a game of their favorite game but they can't find a comfortable, calm and quiet place, despite having tried everything. / Louis et Abacus veulent faire une partie de leur jeu prefere mais ils ne trouvent pas de place confortable, calme et tranquille, malgre avoir tout essaye.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: Gena has just finished writing her outdoor survival guide for flies and offers to give her son Louis advice by organizing a training course. / Gena vient de terminer lecriture de son guide de survie en plein air destine aux mouches et propose à son fils Louis de lui donner des conseils en organisant un stage.

programme.title: Welcome to the Mouche / Bienvenue chez les Mouche
programme.desc: A self-proclaimed spider "The Enemy of Woodlice" wants to attack Abacus. A game of hide and seek begins. But Abacus has many friends ready to defend him. / Une araignee auto-proclamee "lEnnemie des Cloportes" veut sen prendre à Abacus. Une partie de cache-cache sengage. Mais Abacus a beaucoup damis pret à le defendre.

programme.title: Trollstopia / Trollstopia
programme.sub-title: A la Conquete de le Crete / Cest quoi ton surnom ?
programme.desc: When gum ends up in Dante's Crescendo's wings, he and Val attempt to use other means of transportation to reach Classical Crete before the long-awaited bloom of the legendary Orchid Organ ends. / When Bra / Lorsque du chewing-gum se retrouve dans les ailes de Dante Crescendo, Val et lui tentent dutiliser dautres moyens de transport pour atteindre la Crete du classique avant la fin de la floraison tant attendue de la legendaire Orgue Orchidee. / Lorsque Bra

programme.title: Trollstopia / Trollstopia
programme.sub-title: Prets, partez, Calendrier ! / Les Echangeurs de Bamboche
programme.desc: When Poppy asks Dolly and Guy Diamond to take photos for the very first TrollsTopia calendar, will their desire to make a big splash leave them all wet? / When Val and Smidge stumble upon the children's table at one of Dante's official parties, they discover a way to enjoy both parties by switching places using the bamboo changer. / Lorsque Poppy demande à Dolly et Guy Diamond de prendre des photos pour le tout premier calendrier TrollsTopia, leur desir de faire un gros plouf va-t-il les laisser tout mouilles ? / Lorsque Val et Smidge tombent sur la table des enfants à lune des fetes officielles de Dante, ils decouvrent un moyen de profiter des deux fetes en changeant de place grâce à lechangeur de bamboche.

programme.title: The Weasy family / La famille Weasy
programme.desc: The girls are playing bubbles. They decided to make a giant bubble by combining several small bubbles together, to be able to perform an aerial ballet. But their father goes crazy when he sees bubbles and can't stop himself from bursting them. It is so fast that they never have time to complete their game. They decide to teach him a good lesson. / Les filles jouent aux bulles. Elles ont decide de fabriquer une bulle geante en agregeant plusieurs petites bulles ensemble, pour pouvoir faire un ballet aerien. Mais leur père devient comme fou lorsqu’il voit des bulles et ne peut s’empecher de les eclater. Il est tellement rapide qu’elles n’ont jamais le temps de mener leur jeu à son terme. Elles decident de lui donner une bonne leçon.

programme.title: The Weasy family / La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Weasy is jealous of the latest creation of the cans, straw sculptures in their likeness, which are admired by the Eagle family. He tries to attract attention by making an even more impressive sculpture of himself, but he fails. Discovering computerized bush trimming equipment at the farm of the future, Weasy decides to use it to pass himself off as a genius sculptor. / Weasy est jaloux de la dernière creation des canettes, des sculptures sur paille à leur effigie, qui font l’admiration de la famille aigle. Il tente de capter l’attention en faisant une sculpture de lui-meme encore plus impressionnante mais il fait un fiasco. Decouvrant du materiel de taillage de buisson informatise à la ferme du futur, Weasy decide de l’utiliser pour se faire passer pour un sculpteur de genie.

programme.title: The Weasy family / La famille Weasy
programme.desc: Weasy forgot the cans’ anniversary! Weasy rushes to make a gift so the girls don't realize he's forgotten. The girls understand the maneuver and are very disappointed. They decide to go get a gift themselves. / Weasy a oublie l’anniversaire des canettes ! Weasy se depeche de fabriquer un cadeau pour que les filles ne se rendent pas compte de son oubli. Les filles comprennent la manœuvre et sont très deçues. Elles decident daller se chercher un cadeau ellesmemes.

programme.title: Welcome to the Casagrandes / Bienvenue chez les Casagrandes
programme.desc: Anxious to invite his friends to his house, Laird, Ronnie Anne's aide, pretends that he lives at Arturo's house. // To get Carlotta off her phone, Carlos arranges an appointment for her with a private teacher. / Anxieux dinviter ses amis chez lui, Laird, aide de Ronnie Anne, fait croire quil vit chez Arturo. // Pour decoller Carlotta de son telephone, Carlos lui arrange un rendez-vous avec un prof particulier.

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.sub-title: La balade d’Elliot et de Cleo
programme.desc: Elliot and Cleo are both on Lake Boogabooga when Cleo's yacht collides with Elliot's motorboat, leaving the more expensive of the two vessels more damaged. Cleo has no choice but to accept Elliot's offer and boards Camp's motorboat, it's that or sink with his yacht. The fog falls on the lake and through bickering the two friends find themselves lost, without knowing how to return safely. Quickly, the current takes them to a river where they will have to face many dangers together, such as, for example, a starving wild wolf. When the animals of the Palais Paradis and the inhabitants of the camp realize that one of theirs has disappeared, they launch rescue operations to find and bring back their friends safe and sound. Will they arrive in time or will Cleo and Elliot's inability to get along jeopardize their chances of survival? / Elliot et Cleo sont tous deux sur le lac Boogabooga lorsque le yacht de Cleo entre en collision avec le bateau à moteur dElliot, cest le plus cher des deux navires qui se retrouve le plus endommage. Cleo na dautre choix que daccepter loffre dElliot et monte à bord du bateau à moteur du Camp, cetait ça ou couler avec son yacht. Le brouillard tombe sur le lac et à force de se chamailler les deux compères se retrouvent perdus, sans savoir comment rentrer en toute securite. Rapidement, le courant les entraîne sur une rivière où ils devront affronter ensemble de nombreux dangers comme, par exemple, un loup sauvage affame. Lorsque les animaux du Palais Paradis et les habitants du camp se rendent compte que lun des leurs a disparu, ils lancent des operations de sauvetage retrouver et ramener sains et saufs leurs amis. Arriveront-ils à temps ou lincapacite de Cleo et dElliot à sentendre compromettra-t-elle leurs chances de survie ?

programme.title: The Rebels of the Forest, the series / Les rebelles de la foret, la serie
programme.desc: McSquizzy invites Ham Turtleston to teach predator defense classes to the camp residents. Ham is a famous animal actor who will show them how to convincingly play dead. As an amateur actor with professional aspirations, Elliot is both upset and offended that he was not asked to lead this workshop. When he discovers that he and Ham don't get along, he decides to challenge the aging turtle's acting skills. Ham, rather ironically, is turned upside down by his confrontation with Elliot and, instead of playing dead, he seems to actually die. Elliot is horrified. Thinking that he's not acting (even though, in reality, he is!), Elliot decides to do the only thing possible: take Ham's place and pretend to be him. But how long can Elliot be able to pretend? To achieve this, he will have to give the representation of his life. / McSquizzy invite Ham Turtleston à donner des cours de defense contre les predateurs aux habitants du camp. Ham est un celèbre acteur animalier qui va leur montrer comment faire le mort de manière convaincante. En tant quacteur amateur et ayant des aspirations professionnelles, Elliot est à la fois contrarie et offense quon ne lui ait pas demande danimer cet atelier. Lorsquil decouvre que Ham et lui ne sentendent pas, il decide de remettre en question les talents dacteur de la tortue vieillissante. Ham, de façon plutôt ironique, est chamboule par sa confrontation avec Elliot et, au lieu de faire le mort, il semble mourir pour de vrai. Elliot est horrifie. Pensant quil ne joue pas la comedie (meme si, en realite, cest le cas !), Elliot decide de faire la seule chose possible : prendre la place de Ham et se faire passer pour lui. Mais combien de temps Elliot pourra-t-il faire illusion ? Pour y parvenir, il devra donner la representation de sa vie.

programme.title: Dragons: Beyond the Shores / Dragons : Par-delà les rives
programme.desc: Once the fifth lens is in place, the eye of Dragon 2 reveals where the King of Dragons would be. Fishlegs, understanding what it is, also knows what to do. / Une fois la cinquième lentille en place, lœil de Dragon 2 devoile où se trouverait le Roi des Dragons. Varek, comprenant de quoi il sagit, sait aussi quoi faire.

programme.title: Dragons: Beyond the Shores / Dragons : Par-delà les rives

programme.title: The superpowers of life / Les super pouvoirs du vivant
programme.desc: To attract the favor of his lady, the male peacock spider pulls out all the stops: he performs a swaying dance while his abdomen reflects a myriad of bright colors. “Show must go on”! / Pour sattirer les faveurs de sa belle, le mâle araignee-paon sort le grand jeu : il execute une danse chaloupee tandis que son abdomen reflète un myriades de couleurs vives. « Show must go on » !

programme.title: The superpowers of life / Les super pouvoirs du vivant
programme.sub-title: LAxolotl : Le monstre des lacs Mexicains
programme.desc: This little salamander has an extraordinary capacity for regeneration: it can rebuild its own limbs in record time! “Did you eat your eye again? It doesn't matter my darling, you will get a new one next month. » / Cette petite salamandre detient une capacite de regeneration extraordinaire : elle peut reconstruire ses propres membres en un temps record ! « Tu t’es encore fait manger un oeil ? C’est pas grave mon cheri, tu en auras un nouveau le mois prochain. »

programme.title: #DansLaToile / #DansLaToile
programme.desc: Master Pong explains to Noah and Mitzi that there are five large American firms that dominate the digital market. These “web giants” are called GAFAM. This word is formed from the initials of Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon and Microsoft. They are said to be giants because they are everywhere and the whole world knows them. The tools they offer are very well known and practical. So much so that we feel like we can't do without it. So we agree to comply with their way of doing things. What is free software? However, there are other tools to do the same thing. These are free alternatives, such as the Firefox browser, Framasoft software, GNU. These alternatives are sometimes less powerful, but they also impose fewer rules! So GAFAM or free software, you can choose! / Maître Pong explique à Noah et Mitzi qu’il existe cinq grandes firmes americaines qui dominent le marche du numerique. Ces « geants du Web » sont appeles les GAFAM. Ce mot est forme des initiales de Google, Apple, Facebook, Amazon et Microsoft. On dit que ce sont des geants car ils sont partout et le monde entier les connaît. Les outils qu’ils proposent sont très connus et pratiques. Si bien qu’on a l’impression qu’on ne peut pas s’en passer. Alors on accepte de se plier à leur façon de faire. Qu’est-ce qu’un logiciel libre ? Pourtant il existe d’autres outils pour faire la meme chose. Ce sont les alternatives libres, comme le navigateur Firefox, les logiciels Framasoft, GNU. Ces alternatives sont parfois moins puissantes, mais elles imposent aussi moins de règles ! Alors GAFAM ou logiciels libres, tu peux choisir !

programme.title: #DansLaToile / #DansLaToile
programme.desc: Chef Pong calls out to Noah and the cat who want to go play! Big data, or Big data in English, is all the data produced on the web: The publications, the information we give, everything that everyone shares. But that's not all! Today, many devices are connected to the Internet and provide lots of other information, on car traffic, the time street lights come on, or the weather around the world! What to do with all this data? By comparing all this data, we can predict someone's tastes, or even sometimes their actions, but there are errors, because ultimately, not everyone is the same! As for this icy wind, nothing to do with the weather, it's to cool down the mega data. They are stored in large warehouses all over the planet and we must prevent them from overheating! / Chef Pong interpelle Noah et le chat qui veulent partir jouer ! Les megadonnees, ou Big data en anglais, ce sont toutes les donnees produites dans la toile : Les publications, les informations que l’on donne, tout ce que tout le monde partage. Mais ce n’est pas tout ! Aujourdhui, beaucoup d’appareils sont connectes à internet et fournissent des tas d’autres informations, sur la circulation des voitures, l’heure d’allumage des lampadaires, ou la meteo du monde entier ! Que faire de toutes ces donnees ? En comparant toutes ces donnees, on peut prevoir les goûts de quelqu’un, ou meme parfois ces actions, mais il y a des erreurs, car finalement, tout le monde n’est pas identique ! Quant à ce vent glacial, rien à voir avec la meteo, c’est pour refroidir les mega donnees. Elles sont stockees dans des grands entrepôts partout sur la planète et il faut eviter qu’ils surchauffent !

programme.desc: “Nicolas Cage, the mad scientist of Hollywood”? Yes, an actor-mad scientist: that’s what Nicolas Cage is. His deep nature as a mad scientist, which explains him entirely, is the means through which the all-archive documentary “Nicolas Cage, the mad scientist of Hollywood” chooses to portray the actor, to tell his story and to celebrate him. / « Nicolas Cage, le savant fou d’Hollywood » ? Un comedien un peu cingle entièrement voue à l’experimentation, menant sur le jeu d’acteur d’inlassables recherches, determine à en mettre au point de nouvelles formules et utilisant chacun de ses films comme autant de laboratoires. Sa nature profonde de savant fou, qui l’explique tout entier, c’est le biais par lequel le documentaire tout-archives « Nicolas Cage, le savant fou d’Hollywood » choisit de faire le portrait de l’acteur, de le raconter et de le celebrer

Des milliers d’hommes ont ete tues, des milliers de femmes et enfants ont ete kidnappes, martyrises, violes, des centaines de milliers de Yezidis ont ete contraints à l’exil. Daech est desormais reconnu coupable d’avoir commis un genocide. Une equipe de Tataki, le media en ligne de la RTS, est allee à la rencontre de ces jeunes femmes violees, reduites à l’esclavage et qui aujourdhui reviennent dans leurs villages après s’etre enfuies des camps ou après avoir echappees aux mains de leur geôliers.

programme.title: The Swiss Miracle / Le Miracle Suisse
programme.desc: In 2024, Switzerland won the Eurosong competition with the artist Nemo, whose song highlighted non-binarity. But the theme of gender fluidity has been addressed by Swiss television since the 60s and 70s, with incredible and courageous testimonies. We will also see our two avant-garde comedians François Silvant and Joseph Gorgoni, who created female characters, and we will meet Greta Gratos, a drag queen who appeared on our screens in 1998. We will also listen with pleasure to the many fluid artists who have passed through Switzerland from David Bowie to Boy George via Elton John. The Swiss Miracle, a show for coughs! / En 2024, la Suisse remportait le concours de l’Eurosong avec l’artiste Nemo, dont la chanson a mis en lumière la non-binarite. Mais le thème de la fluidite de genre a ete aborde par la television suisse depuis les annees 60-70, avec des temoignages incroyables et courageux. Nous verrons egalement nos deux humoristes avant-gardistes François Silvant et Joseph Gorgoni, qui ont cree des personnages feminins, et nous retrouverons Greta Gratos, drag queen apparue sur nos ecrans en 1998. On reecoute aussi avec plaisir les nombreux artistes fluides qui sont passes par la Suisse de David Bowie à Boy George en passant par Elton John. Le Miracle Suisse, une emission pour touxtes !

programme.desc: Christoph Betschart, 35, is a professional crystal hunter and has been a passionate crystal hunter for over ten years. De fin mai à septembre, il parcourt les montagnes autour dAndermatt (UR), seul ou avec son frère et dautres chercheurs amateurs, à la recherche de cristaux.

programme.title: At altitude / En altitude
programme.sub-title: L’Alpiniste aveugle - Le reve du sommet
programme.desc: Laila Grillo is blind and she has a dream. She wants to climb the Allalinhorn, at an altitude of 4,027 meters. With his mountain guide, the mountaineer prepares meticulously - because it is only as a team that they will achieve their goal. / Laila Grillo est aveugle et elle a un reve. Elle veut gravir lAllalinhorn, à 4’027 mètres daltitude. Avec son guide de montagne, lalpiniste sy prepare meticuleusement - car ce nest quen equipe quils atteindront leur but.

programme.title: At altitude / En altitude
programme.sub-title: Dans la face nord de lEiger - En souvenir d’amis disparus
programme.desc: On the north face of the Eiger, 3 professional mountaineers, Stephan Siegrist and Thomas and Alexander Huber, embark on a new route. It's a path into the unknown, and they dedicate it to their fallen mountaineer friends who have fallen. This path they call: “In Memoriam”. / Dans la face nord de lEiger, 3 alpinistes professionnels, Stephan Siegrist ainsi que Thomas et Alexander Huber, se lancent dans une nouvelle voie. programme.desc: Rebekka Frieden is 30 years old. She is a lifeguard at Air Zermatt and is the first woman to hold this position. In this episode, “At Altitude” accompanies her and reveals how she lives her dream job in the mountains of the Zermatt region. Rebekka highlights the daily challenges she faces, aware of the role of model that she embodies in a largely masculine environment. / Rebekka Frieden a 30 ans. Elle est sauveteuse chez Air Zermatt et c’est la première femme à occuper ce poste. Dans cet episode,«En altitude» l’accompagne et devoile comment elle vit son travail de reve dans les montagnes de la region de Zermatt. Rebekka met en lumière les defis quotidiens auxquels elle est confrontee, consciente du rôle de modèle qu’elle incarne dans un environnement largement masculin.

programme.title: The aquarium professionals / Die Aquarium-Profis
programme.desc: Big, bigger, biggest! Commercially available indoor aquariums are also nice, but Wayde King and his partner Brett Raymer have little to do with 10-liter tanks. Her specialty is breathtaking underwater worlds! From the octagonal ecosystem with morays and stingrays to the telephone booth aquarium to the shark tank for the doctor's office: there is almost no idea that the boys don't dare to try. Accordingly, the motto of the two New Yorkers is: What others dream of, we make it happen! And their super aquariums not only appeal to the underwater inhabitants, but also to the public. Wherever Brett and Wayde present their impressive custom-made products to the public, people cannot help but be amazed. / GroSS, groSSer, am groSSten! Handelsubliche Zimmer-Aquarien sind auch nett, doch mit 10-Liter-Becken haben Wayde King und sein Partner Brett Raymer wenig am Hut. Ihr Spezialgebiet sind atemberaubende Unterwasserwelten! Vom achteckigen Ökosystem mit Muranen und Stachelrochen uber das Telefonzellen-Aquarium bis zum Haifisch-Tank fur die Arztpraxis: Es gibt fast keine Idee, an die sich die Jungs nicht herantrauen. Dementsprechend lautet das Motto der beiden New Yorker: Wovon andere traumen, setzen wir in die Tat um! Und ihre Super-Aquarien gefallen nicht nur den Unterwasserbewohnern ausgesprochen gut, sondern auch dem Publikum. Wo immer Brett und Wayde ihre beeindruckenden Spezialanfertigungen der Öffentlichkeit prasentieren, kommen die Leute aus dem Staunen nicht heraus.
